raw.description:
About UBQ.io
UBQ.io is a global technology service provider dedicated to building a more sustainable, independent, and equitable future. We partner with global companies across industries, including AI, blockchain, software, biotech, and education, to transform bold ideas into real, meaningful solutions.

Our expertise spans technology consulting, AI and Machine Learning development, Blockchain integration, and global team collaboration. With a worldwide network of specialists, we help organizations stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

At UBQ.io, we don’t just advise, we collaborate. Our commitment to innovation, sustainability, and social responsibility guides everything we do as we help clients build technologies that empower people, communities, and industries to thrive.

About the role

We are looking for a Finance Developer to join our team and help build an internal web platform that supports portfolio management for our finance and operations teams. Working at the intersection of

finance and technology, you will turn financial data and business requirements into accurate, reliable tools. You will own features from end to end, from data queries and calculation logic through to the user interface.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain platform features, including summary metrics, interactive tables and data visualisations.

  • Translate financial methodologies such as valuation, P&L attribution, exposure and cost basis into clean, well-tested backend logic.

  • Make sure every figure reconciles accurately against source systems and existing reporting.

  • Write and optimise SQL queries against our cloud data warehouse.

  • Keep the platform fast and reliable through caching, performance tuning and robust error handling.

  • Work closely with finance and operations stakeholders to gather requirements, validate results and deliver improvements.

Our stack

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, Google BigQuery, Redis

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query, Recharts, Tailwind CSS

  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud (Cloud Run), Google sign-in

Requirements

  • Solid professional experience with Python, including building backend services or data applications.

  • A good understanding of financial concepts: positions, P&L (daily, MTD, YTD, ITD), NAV, exposure and cost basis.

  • Comfort writing non-trivial SQL, ideally on BigQuery or another cloud warehouse.

  • A strong eye for detail and a habit of testing and reconciling numbers until they're right.

  • Clear communication, and the confidence to challenge and clarify requirements with finance teams.

  • A MSc in Finance, or progress towards a professional qualification such as CFA or CAIA (Level I or above), or equivalent.

Advantageous

  • Front-end experience with React and TypeScript, especially data-heavy UIs.

  • Experience with BI and reporting tools, or building analytics dashboards.

  • A background in asset management, fund administration, treasury or fintech.

  • Familiarity with multi-asset portfolios, e.g. equities, fixed income, digital assets and commodities.

  • Experience with Google Cloud and caching strategies.

Disclaimer: Stay safe from recruitment scams
We only hire through , using TestGorilla assessments, video interviews and reference checks. We may contact you first on LinkedIn, but after that we only email from Teamtailor (@ / ) or @ addresses.
We will never ask you for money, interview you on Telegram or WhatsApp, or ask you to install software, connect a wallet or run code.
Not sure if a message is really from us? Ask us through our LinkedIn page before you reply.

You know Bitrefill, and you’ve probably watched a search result or an app listing turn into revenue. You get that search no longer means just Google: people ask Claude and ChatGPT, and agents shop on their behalf. You want to own how 1M+ customers across 180+ countries find us. If that’s you, hit the apply button and let’s talk.

If you need more info to decide, keep reading. We kept the corporate fluff out, so it won't take long.

About the roleOrganic discovery is changing fast. Programmatic SEO still matters, and so do the app stores. Now there’s a third channel: AI answer engines and AI agents that research, compare, and buy without ever opening a browser tab. We want Bitrefill to be the default answer in all three.

You’ll have real freedom here. You choose where to build pages at scale, which experiments to run, and how to make us readable for machines. You’ll work closely with product, design, and engineering to get it shipped.

What you'll do

  • Own Bitrefill’s organic growth strategy across search, app stores and AI

  • Build and scale programmatic SEO: find the page types worth generating, then ship, measure and iterate

  • Optimize our iOS and Android app listings with product and design: keywords, screenshots, store tests

  • Make Bitrefill show up in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and whatever comes next)

  • Make Bitrefill easy for AI agents to find and buy from: structured product data, machine-readable pages, and our agentic commerce work

  • Write and shape content, and get your hands dirty in the front end when it’s faster than waiting on a ticket

  • Track what’s working, kill what isn’t, and share findings with the team

What we're looking for

  • Be based in a timezone that aligns with Europe or the Americas

  • 5+ years in growth, SEO, or performance marketing, with a track record of moving organic numbers

  • Deep, hands-on programmatic and technical SEO experience. You’ve built pages at scale, not just audited them

  • You’ve done hands-on GEO / AI visibility work and can show what it changed;

  • AI is part of how you work (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar). This is non-negotiable for us

  • Comfortable with front-end basics. Some React is great, and vibecoding the rest is fine

  • Strong writer with a good eye for design

  • Data-driven. You read Search Console and analytics like a P&L

  • Self-driven. You spot the opportunity and push it forward instead of waiting for a roadmap

Bonus points

  • Real ASO experience on iOS and Android

  • Experience with structured data, llms.txt, or agent-facing APIs and MCP

  • Crypto-native. You use it, and nobody needs to explain Bitcoin to you

  • Experience in e-commerce or marketplace SEO with large catalogs

  • Design chops in Figma for store assets and landing pages

Why Bitrefill

We've been quietly right about something since 2014: internet money should just work. Fully remote since day one. Team across 30+ countries. Get paid in crypto if you want. No bullshit meetings. Twice a year, we meet up to build together in person. The rest of the time: work hard, get shit done.

Navitus Health Solutions is seeking a Account Executive (AE) to join our team!

The Account Executive (AE) is an individual contributor responsible for managing client relationships and supporting account strategy for employer, health plan, and PBM clients across a range of account sizes and complexity. This role serves as a primary point of contact for clients, broker consultants, and advisors, ensuring client needs are understood, addressed, and aligned with organizational capabilities. The Account Executive partners closely with Sales, Clinical Account Executives, Analytics, and Operations teams to support renewals, deliver strategic insights, and drive client satisfaction and retention.

The Account Executive role is a critical development position within company. It builds foundational skills in account ownership, strategic thinking, negotiation, and executive‑level communication while supporting the organization’s goals of delivering value‑driven, sustainable client solutions within the health benefits space.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Resolve client issues by coordinating with internal partners, applying appropriate judgment, and escalating matters when necessary.
  • Develop negotiation skills by balancing client expectations with company priorities and participating in discussions with senior client and consultant leaders.
  • Utilize company reporting systems, analytics tools, and platforms to support account management, performance monitoring, and client communications.

Qualifications

  • 3 years of experience managing or supporting client accounts within PBM, health plan, healthcare, or related benefits environments required.
  • 3 years of experience working directly with clients, brokers, or consultants, including participation in renewal discussions and strategic meetings required.
  • 3 years of experience supporting or contributing to account planning, renewals, and performance discussions, including exposure to utilization, financial, or service data required.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining professional client relationships and supporting executive‑level interactions required.

Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
As a Senior Security Services Sales Specialist at NTT DATA, you'll utilize your advanced expertise to identify, develop, and close managed service and outsourcing deals. By collaborating with service teams and using your consulting-led sales skills, you'll become a trusted advisor for our clients, guiding them through the intricate landscape of managed cloud services. Your day will involve working directly with clients, helping them understand the value we bring and ensuring they transform into long-term managed services clients.

You'll build and nurture strong relationships with stakeholders at various levels, diving deep into client needs and industry specifics to align our solutions with their business outcomes. You'll lead the charge in constructing managed services deals, negotiating terms, and ensuring that both our clients and we achieve win-win outcomes. Your role involves working cross-functionally with internal teams such as client managers, pre-sales architects, and delivery teams to ensure seamless integration and customer satisfaction.

Besides driving the sales process, you'll contribute to the growth of our services practice by sharing best practices and insights with both internal teams and clients. You'll maintain a high level of service knowledge to facilitate meaningful conversations and address any objections related to moving to managed services solutions. Your ability to craft commercial solutions that meet clients' needs while achieving our business goals is crucial.

Additionally, you'll manage a pipeline of opportunities, ensuring all proposals are tracked, managed, and delivered on time. By collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you'll implement opportunity plans, provide regular check-ins with primary contacts, and ensure DATA is accurate for insightful sales reporting. Your efforts will help us convert clients to managed services clients, leading to multi-year renewals and fostering deeper client relationships.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:

Key Responsibilities:

    • Ensures the generation of demand and selling Security Managed Services solutions -
    • Ensures the generation of demand by assisting clients to identify and qualify current needs and effectively articulate how the company can add value through its services and solutions offering.
    • Guides on addressing the objections that a client may pose in moving to a managed services solution.
    • Guides on allocating and deciding sales time between assigned clients and new prospect opportunities; yet ensure focus remains on the top clients/prospects and balance opportunity size with likely outcomes.

Sales partnership:

Managed Services industry trusted advisor :

    • Develops the knowledge base of company's services solutions within a services practice by sharing best practices with internal teams as well as client teams; ensuring that internal teams are aware of typical client challenges.

Deal construct:

    • Owns the build and supports commercial solutions for Managed Services solutions and design deals that meet client’s needs and ensure win/win solutions for both client and the organization.
    • Guides on constructing the managed services deal including the commercial modelling, negotiate contractual terms, mitigate legal risk and obstacles, and move the proposal to close to meet assigned quota.

Drives the sales process:

    • Guides on managing a pipeline of opportunities and creating and documenting a shared strategy to meet sales target such as net new customer pursuit plans to land new logos, activities to achieve client satisfaction, minimize churn, cross-sell, upsell, revenue, and margin goals.
    • Works with cross functional sales teams and commercial architects to successfully position the service and see the opportunity through to closure.
    • Works with cross functional internal teams to ensure scope of work and proposals are tracked, managed and delivered on time.
    • Develops and owns the implementation of an opportunity plan, to provide regular check-ins with the primary point of contact and have an established process for getting buy-in from all stakeholders
    • Guides on ensuring DATA is accurate based on sales reporting standards to provide DATA-driven insights.
    • Advises on the negotiation of deals with clients and lead the internal account management team to enable conclusion of services deals.
    • Advises on the knowledge base of company’s solutions and services by sharing best practices, industry and technology trends with internal stakeholders and clients.
    • Leads on regional reporting cadence as it relates to regional performance and major deal reviews.

Knowledge and Attributes:

    • Excellent understanding of cybersecurity concepts, including different types of threats, attack vectors, and common security vulnerabilities
    • Familiarity with a wide range of security solutions
    • Excellent knowledge of best practices for securing networks and systems, including secure network architecture, access controls, and authentication mechanisms
    • Excellent understanding of and the ability to position company's services offerings that may span multiple technology domains across Managed Services, Support Services, Consulting Services and Technical Services
    • Significant understanding of platform delivered services and how to articulate the value of standardized, centralized and optimized services.
    • Conversant with a business outcome led approach to sales.

    • Significant understanding of financial statements and metrics, including revenue, expense control, and growth relative to market in order to hold strategic client conversations.

    • Client-centricity coupled with problem solving.

    • Excellent ability to pro-actively and independently identify and qualify opportunities, an entrepreneurial mindset if key.

Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

  • Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

  • Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

  • Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

Ensemble Health Partners is seeking a strategic and operationally focused Senior Director, Provisioning Operations to lead and advance provisioning operations supporting new client integrations and ongoing client needs. This role will provide experienced leadership across healthcare revenue cycle operations, access provisioning, client integrations, operational readiness, risk management, and process improvement.


The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in revenue cycle management, cross-functional operations, provisioning, client integrations, and people leadership. This leader will partner closely with Human Resources, Operations, Technology, client-facing teams, and other stakeholders to build scalable processes, strengthen operational controls, improve the employee and client experience, and ensure individuals receive appropriate access when needed.

The successful candidate will be a seasoned, hands-on leader who can operate strategically while remaining willing to support detailed operational work. This individual must demonstrate sound judgment, executive presence, adaptability, and the ability to build trusted relationships across all levels of an organization.

Key Responsibilities

Provisioning Operations

  • Provide strategic leadership and operational oversight for provisioning activities supporting new hires, existing employees, organizational changes, new client integrations, and ongoing client operations.
  • Develop scalable provisioning processes, standards, controls, and best practices that support business growth and operational consistency.
  • Oversee access provisioning workflows to help ensure individuals receive appropriate and timely access based on their roles and business responsibilities.
  • Assess current provisioning processes, workflows, and operational structures to identify risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead efforts to centralize and standardize provisioning activities across applicable business functions and client environments.
  • Establish operating procedures, performance expectations, escalation processes, and accountability measures for provisioning operations.
  • Support the development of a growing provisioning function, including establishing team structures, responsibilities, and leadership practices.

Client Integrations

  • Lead provisioning-related activities for new client implementations, conversions, acquisitions, and operational transitions.
  • Serve as a strategic operational partner throughout client onboarding and integration efforts.
  • Collaborate with client stakeholders and internal teams to understand access requirements, operational workflows, timelines, and potential risks.
  • Develop and oversee provisioning plans that support client readiness and successful operational transitions.
  • Identify and resolve provisioning concerns that may affect implementation timelines, employee readiness, security, or the client experience.
  • Provide ongoing leadership for provisioning activities supporting established client operations.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Human Resources, Revenue Cycle Operations, Technology, Implementation, Client Services, and operational leadership teams.
  • Connect cross-functional activities to create a coordinated, end-to-end provisioning experience.
  • Lead stakeholders through complex operational decisions involving access, workflow dependencies, risk, and business requirements.
  • Build trusted partnerships across internal teams and client organizations.
  • Facilitate clear communication, accountability, and alignment among stakeholders with different operational responsibilities.
  • Present provisioning updates, risks, recommendations, and performance insights to senior leadership and other key stakeholders.

Operational Excellence & Risk Management

  • Evaluate operational workflows to identify access-related risks, process breakdowns, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
  • Apply healthcare revenue cycle knowledge to understand access requirements and their impact on operational performance.
  • Develop and implement solutions that improve provisioning speed, accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
  • Establish metrics and reporting that provide visibility into service levels, risks, backlogs, quality, and operational performance.
  • Support automation and technology initiatives that reduce manual work and improve the provisioning experience.
  • Monitor process performance and lead corrective action plans when operational expectations are not met.
  • Balance business needs, client expectations, security considerations, and risk-management requirements when making decisions.

People Leadership

  • Build, develop, and lead a high-performing provisioning operations team.
  • Establish a collaborative culture focused on accountability, continuous improvement, service, and operational excellence.
  • Coach and develop team members while creating future leaders and scalable team capabilities.
  • Lead effectively across all organizational levels, including individual contributors, operational leaders, executives, clients, and cross-functional partners.
  • Remain willing to support both strategic initiatives and detailed operational work as the function grows.
  • Promote a humble, confident, and solutions-oriented leadership approach that strengthens partnerships and minimizes organizational friction.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in healthcare operations, revenue cycle management, provisioning, access management, client integrations, implementation, technology operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive people-leadership experience, including responsibility for developing teams and other leaders.
  • Previous experience operating at the Director level or in a comparable senior leadership role with responsibility for complex, cross-functional operations.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle operations and the systems, workflows, and access requirements that support revenue cycle functions.
  • Experience leading provisioning, access-management, client-integration, implementation, operational-transformation, or centralized-operations initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and scale operational processes, controls, standards, and teams.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing stakeholders across Human Resources, Operations, Technology, and client-facing functions.
  • Strong understanding of operational risk and the ability to evaluate access needs, workflow dependencies, and business impact.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex initiatives with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and organization-wide impact.
  • Strong executive presence, communication skills, judgment, and relationship-management capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a growing environment where responsibilities and processes continue to evolve.
  • Willingness to remain hands-on and support detailed operational work when necessary.
  • Ability to travel based on business and client needs.

Manager to Director AI Knowledge

Demonstrated advanced usage of AI and experience managing teams that use AI to support process and technology improvements. This includes encouraging the responsible exploration, experimentation, and application of AI to reduce friction, improve operational efficiency, and enhance employee, patient, and client experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading provisioning or access-management operations within a healthcare revenue cycle organization.
  • Experience supporting large-scale healthcare client integrations, acquisitions, implementations, or operational transitions.
  • Experience building or expanding a centralized operational function.
  • Experience with identity and access management, role-based access, user lifecycle management, or access-governance processes.
  • Experience supporting enterprise healthcare platforms, revenue cycle technologies, or client-specific systems.
  • Knowledge of healthcare privacy, security, compliance, and minimum-necessary access principles.
  • Experience leading teams in multi-state, national, or complex client-based healthcare environments.
  • Experience with workflow automation, reporting, Power BI, Copilot, or other AI-enabled productivity and process-improvement tools.
  • Project management, process improvement, technology, security, or healthcare revenue cycle certifications.

This position pays between $122,900- $184,350


Join an award-winning company


Five-time winner of “Best in KLAS” 2020-2022, 2024-2025

Black Book Research's Top Revenue Cycle Management Outsourcing Solution 2021-2024

22 Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) MAP Awards for High Performance in Revenue Cycle 2019-2024

Leader in Everest Group's RCM Operations PEAK Matrix Assessment 2024

Bottom line, we believe in empowering people and giving them the tools and resources needed to thrive. A few of those include:

  • Associate Benefits – We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial health of you and your family, including healthcare, time off, retirement, and well-being programs.
  • Our Culture – Ensemble is a place where associates can do their best work and be their best selves. We put people first, last and always. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth, and innovation.
  • Growth – We invest in your professional development. Each associate will earn a professional certification relevant to their field and can obtain tuition reimbursement.

Job Title: Area Business Manager- Rhinology Cumberland MD

About the job:

The Area Business Manager (ABM) is responsible for engaging Otolaryngologists & Rhinologists (ENTs), and other key customers within an assigned geography and presenting clinically focused selling messages to create and grow revenue and to consistently deliver product goals related to atopic dermatitis and asthma indications. The ABM will demonstrate initiative, drive, independence, and take ownership for meeting and exceeding individual business goals. This will be accomplished by driving performance and delivering results in a compliant manner with a high degree of integrity strictly following all Sanofi Genzyme US policies and in compliance with all policies and procedures governing the promotion of pharmaceutical/biological products in the US.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and Specialty Care neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Engage ENT customers within assigned geographical territory and deliver clinically focused message to introduce, launch, grow brand-share and revenue and to consistently deliver on product goals for atopic dermatitis and asthma indications.
  • Collaborate and coordinate with other key field-based stakeholders such as Regeneron Sales Professional counterparts, Medical Science Liaisons, Field Reimbursement and Market Access teammates, Thought Leader Liaisons, and others in their territory to proactively address customer needs, identify market dynamics and trends, develop strategies which support brand and corporate objectives, and ensure optimal account success within their assigned geography.
  • Develop strong working relationships with ENT experts in assigned geography as well as biologic coordinators, office staff and other important health care personnel and key patient advocacy support groups as directed.
  • Drive results by identifying key opportunities and developing strategic business plans to generate product utilization and grow territory business.
  • Plan, organize, and execute local promotional speaker programs and activities.
  • Maximize budget allocated to the geographic territory to support execution of strategies and tactics and generate/grow the business.
  • Participate and help lead initiatives to support sales success as assigned (e.g. participate in industry related congresses, local and regional meetings and medical conferences).
  • Own business opportunities within respective geographic area, which includes coordination and calling upon large group practices and other key targets to drive overall product results.
  • Establish relationship with thought leaders in assigned territory. Primary objective is to drive industry leading customer value.

About You

Basic Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university.
  • 3+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device sales experience or other relevant life science or clinical experience strongly preferred.

Preferred:

  • Demonstrated ability to learn and apply technical and scientific product-related information.
  • Proven success and positive track record of consistent sales performance in complex markets with diverse customer segments operating with a high degree of integrity within compliance guidelines.
  • Ability to operate as a “team player” in cooperation with collaboration partners and internal colleagues to reach common goals.
  • 2+ years selling sub-cutaneous self-injectable (or office administered IV) biologics in a complex and competitive market strongly preferred.
  • 2+ years selling experience calling on ENTs, Allergists or Dermatologists strongly preferred.
  • Alliance/matrix partnership experience strongly preferred.

Why Choose Us?

  • Make your work count by supporting a company that brings life-changing treatments to millions — and is committed to doing right by patients, communities, and the planet.
  • Drive progress from within by helping simplify, scale, and modernize how a global biopharma business delivers smarter, faster, and more sustainably.
  • Support teams across science, medicine, and operations by building better systems, shaping bold strategies, and enabling innovation at speed.
  • Make an impact across borders and functions, collaborating with leaders to turn complex challenges into real-world solutions.
  • Advance your career through stretch roles, cross-functional moves, and development opportunities designed to match your ambition.
  • Thrive in inclusive, high-performing teams where every role matters and every voice helps shape what’s next.

Finance and Accounting Assistant

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our Mission and guided by our Values, which includes a Commitment to Diversity and Respect for People, Communities, and Cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s lots of reasons to love life #insideTNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube or on Glassdoor.

Our goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging, and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. We know we’ll only achieve our Mission by hiring and engaging a diverse workforce that reflects the communities in which we work. In addition to the requirements in our postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and a culture of inclusion! Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a myriad of TNC staff members, “you’ll join for our mission, and you’ll stay for our people.”

What We Can Achieve Together:

The Finance and Accounting Assistant provides finance and accounting support activities for a department or business unit. The position performs clerical, administrative, and transactional duties related to accounting functions while supporting controlling and compliance processes within established policies and procedures. Responsibilities include processing invoices and payments, preparing routine journal entries, maintaining financial records, supporting account reconciliations and close activities, and assisting with audits and financial documentation. The position helps ensure the timely and accurate processing of financial transactions in accordance with organizational policies, fund accounting requirements, established accounting practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Follow our Code of Conduct and consistently demonstrate our Values
  • Process vendor invoices, payments, employee reimbursements, and other regular accounting transactions.
  • Prepare and post routine journal entries and maintain accurate accounting records.
  • Verify transaction coding, supporting documentation, and compliance with established policies and procedures.
  • Perform routine account reconciliations and assist with month-end and year-end close activities.
  • Maintain financial records, vendor files, and supporting documentation in accordance with retention requirements.
  • Support audits, reporting activities, and compliance reviews by providing requested documentation and information.
  • Assist with financial data validation and provide support for accounting, controlling, and compliance activities as assigned.

We’re Looking for You:

Have you ever asked yourself, “How can I make a difference?”, but you don’t know where to go or have the time to do it? Welcome to The Nature Conservancy!

You have found the solution and now you can make a difference every day! By joining our Finance team, you will become part of a group that is a force for nature and people. We´re looking for someone with strong experience in accounting/finance and experience working in a diverse, multi-disciplinary team. The ideal candidate will have exceptional communication and collaboration skills and experience in accounting and finance. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to our mission of environmental conservation by supporting our Argentina and Southern Andes business units. Come join TNC and apply today!

What You’ll Bring:

  • Associate’s degree in accounting or related field and 2 years' related work experience or equivalent combination.
  • Experience using automated accounting systems
  • Experience working with basic principles in accounting or in analyzing financial figures.
  • Experience in database management or producing reports, or in the use of automated systems and Microsoft Office tools.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bi-lingual Spanish/English abilities are preferred (at least a working level of reading and writing in English is needed)
  • Attention to detail, accuracy in work product.
  • Ability to organize tasks, prioritize competing demands, and meet established deadlines.

What We Bring:

Since 1951, The Nature Conservancy has been doing work you can believe in protecting the lands and waters that all life depends on. Through grassroots action, TNC has grown to become one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff, we impact conservation throughout the world!

The Nature Conservancy offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including: health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, 401(k) plan including employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work wellbeing benefits. Learn more about our benefits at in the Culture Tab on nature.org/careers.

Candidates will complete an AI interview to assess their clinical expertise and experience.

Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Data Engineer I perform development activities with the guidance of another member of the data engineering team. This position sits within one of our analytics and reporting teams and will work closely with account management, data warehouse, product and other teams as you develop data pipelines and enhancements and investigate and troubleshoot issues.

In this role you will wear many hats, but your knowledge will be essential in the following:

  • Extracting, cleansing, and loading data.
  • Building data pipelines using SQL and Python
  • Triage incoming bugs and incidents.
  • Perform technical operation tasks.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot issues with data and data pipelines.
  • Help monitor areas of the data pipeline and raise awareness to team when issues arise.
  • Performing quality assurance work to verify the accuracy of code and data results

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

  • 1 – 2 years experience in data engineering
  • SW certification or degree in IT related field
  • Solid grasp of modern relational and non-relational models and differences between them.
  • Proficiency in writing SQL
  • Creating and maintaining PowerPoint Templates for standardized reporting
  • Familiarity with AI Tools (Claude, Coco) preferred
  • Detail oriented and able to examine data and code for quality and accuracy
  • Knowledge of Agile environments, including Scrum and Kanban methodologies
  • Python experience preferred
  • ETL experience preferred
  • Git and Snowflake experience preferred

Benefits

The Highlights:

  • Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
  • Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
  • Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
  • Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
  • Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture? Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

Compensation: This position offers a base salary range of $68,800 - $95,000, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

Our Commitment: Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

Stay Safe: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. All official communication comes from verified company email addresses and or our secure applicant tracking system. Suspicious requests? Report them to . View all legitimate openings at personifyhealth.com/careers.

raw.description:
Job Title: Sales Development Representative 

Compensation Range: 40k base + 20k commission potential (Depending on Experience) 

Remote anywhere in the UK. 

Become one of the changemakers. At Quid, you will not just be joining a team but contributing to a culture of innovation, where every challenge becomes an opportunity to learn and grow. When you join our team, you are not just stepping into a job; you are embracing a future where we lead the game with the unmatched advantage of foresight. 

Position Overview 

This role blends targeted account research with high-activity prospecting. You will identify high-potential opportunities through structured research and convert those insights into qualified meetings through proactive outreach. 

You will work closely with Marketing and Account Executives to align efforts with campaign initiatives, territory priorities, and strategic account plans. In addition to proactive outbound pipeline generation, you will engage and qualify Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) generated through campaigns and inbound programs. 

This role requires confidence initiating cold conversations with senior decision-makers and maintaining consistent, disciplined activity across phone, email, and LinkedIn. 

Role Objectives 

  • Partner with Account Executives to identify priority accounts and proactively build outbound pipeline aligned to territory and revenue goals 

  • Conduct targeted account research to identify high-potential prospects aligned to Quid’s ideal customer profile 

  • Execute consistent multi-channel outreach, including daily cold calling, personalized email campaigns, and LinkedIn prospecting and engagement 

  • Engage and qualify inbound and outbound prospects using structured frameworks (e.g., BANT, MEDDICC) 

  • Convert qualified conversations into meetings and sales opportunities for assigned Account Executives 

  • Meet and exceed defined monthly and quarterly meeting and pipeline targets 

  • Analyze outreach metrics and conversion data to continuously refine targeting and messaging strategy 

  • Partner closely with Marketing to provide feedback on messaging, targeting, and campaign effectiveness 

  • Use CRM and prospecting platforms to track activity, engagement, research insights, and pipeline performance 

Requirements 

  • Proven experience in outbound sales development, lead generation, or prospecting 

  • Demonstrated success cold calling senior-level decision-makers 

  • Experience executing multi-channel outreach across phone, email, and LinkedIn 

  • Proven experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesloft (or equivalent sequencing tools), and Salesforce to build and manage pipeline 

  • Experience qualifying opportunities using structured methodologies (e.g., BANT, CHAMP, MEDDICC) 

  • Comfortable analyzing outreach performance metrics and adjusting approach based on data 

  • Competitive, quota-driven mindset with resilience and strong follow-through 

  • Strong organization, consistency, and CRM discipline 

  • Interest in AI, social media, digital marketing, or emerging technologies is a plus 

Total Rewards!      

  • Competitive compensation with commission or bonus structure

  • 9 Bank Holidays

  • 28 days of PTO

  • 4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years  

  • Axa Medical Cover available at no cost for employee and shared cost for dependents

  • Gym Discounts with Hussle and Nuffield Health

  • Travel Cover

  • Life Insurance 

  • Income Protection

  • EAP

  • SmartHealth Mobile 

  • Pension through Scottish Widows

Still Not Sure?     

We understand many candidates tend to only apply for jobs if they meet every single requirement listed. However, if you happen to be genuinely enthusiastic about this particular position and feel confident in your ability to excel at it, we strongly urge you to submit your application! You might just be the perfect fit for this role, or even another exciting opportunity within our company.     

 

Remote Work!     

Remote-first; We're thrilled to say that we've been passionate about remote work since day one! Being remote is simply who we are. At Quid, we're all about connecting with people from all corners of the globe. Our team is made up of individuals who are comfortable working remotely and collaborating with others across different time zones. We’re looking forward to future growth and expansion, however, certain legal restrictions dictate that we are only able to accept candidates who possess eligibility to work in the United States of America.    
 

ABOUT QUID  

Quid helps business leaders turn complexity into clarity, and clarity into outcomes. 

We leverage our proprietary AI to listen to the market at scale, leveraging billions of conversations, articles, and signals, and translates that noise into clarity. Then we go further: we show you our customers how to act on it. 

Whether it’s protecting brand health, driving in-season sales, fueling product innovation, or shaping company strategy, Quid raises the bar for what business leaders should demand.   

We’re not a dashboard company. We’re an outcome engineering organization, relentless in our focus on helping organizations make smarter and bolder decisions that drive positive outcomes for their business. 

Quid has been featured in Forbes, Fortune, The Stanford AI Index, and more, highlighting our leadership in the consumer and market intelligence space, and illustrating  how Quid helps organizations achieve their business outcomes to stay ahead of their competition.

raw.description:
About FCM

FCM is more than a global travel management company with 24/7 support in 100+ countries. We’re a movement—6,500+ changemakers, travel experts, and performance drivers redefining corporate travel. We don’t just keep the world’s biggest companies moving—we make it smoother, smarter, and bolder. Certified as a great place to work and fuelled by an alternative mindset, we embrace change, challenge convention, and do things differently. This is FCM—where different happens.

About the role

Are you a highly experienced Global Travel Manager with a proven background working within a Travel Management Company environment?

We're seeking a strategic and commercially focused travel professional to lead and elevate a global corporate travel programme. This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of travel strategy, supplier management, traveller safety, policy development, and programme performance across a complex international organisation.

As the Global Travel Manager, you'll act as the driving force behind the company's travel programme, partnering with senior stakeholders, global business units, travel suppliers, and the TMC to deliver an exceptional travel experience whilst optimising costs and ensuring compliance.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Developing and implementing global travel policies and strategies that support business objectives.
  • Managing the relationship with the Travel Management Company (TMC) and key travel suppliers.
  • Leading sourcing initiatives, RFPs, supplier negotiations, and performance reviews across airlines, hotels, ground transport and other travel partners.
  • Driving programme adoption and consolidation across multiple regions and business divisions.
  • Owning traveller safety, duty of care, and risk management initiatives.
  • Analysing travel spend, reporting on programme performance, and identifying opportunities for savings and continuous improvement.
  • Influencing stakeholders at all levels to ensure engagement with the global travel programme.

This is a highly visible role that combines strategy, supplier management, stakeholder engagement, traveller experience, and operational excellence.

About you

To be successful in this role, you'll be an experienced travel industry professional who understands what world-class corporate travel management looks like on a global scale.

We are specifically seeking candidates who have managed global travel programmes from within a TMC environment and can demonstrate expertise in supplier management, programme optimisation, stakeholder engagement, and corporate travel strategy.

You'll bring:

  • 7+ years' corporate travel management experience with global responsibility.
  • Proven experience as a Global Travel Manager, Global Travel Program Manager, or equivalent role within a Travel Management Company (TMC).
  • Experience managing multinational client travel programmes and engaging with senior corporate stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of corporate travel operations, travel policy development, programme governance, and traveller experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing airline, hotel, car rental, ground transport, and other travel supplier relationships.
  • A successful track record of leading RFPs, strategic sourcing initiatives, supplier negotiations, and delivering measurable cost savings.
  • Strong understanding of traveller risk management, duty of care, and global travel compliance requirements.
  • Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to interpret travel data and turn insights into actionable business improvements.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to influence at all levels of an organisation.

What's in it for you

  • Exclusive Travel Discounts: As part of Flight Centre Travel Group, you gain access to exclusive industry rates and discounts through our in-house travel team.
  • Career Development: With Flight Centre Travel Group’s global presence, spanning 30+ brands in over 20 countries, you’ll have clear career pathways and the resources you need to achieve your professional goals, including training and support.
  • Vibrant Culture & industry-renowned social events: Experience our fun, industry-renowned culture with exciting social events such as monthly awards nights, global conferences, end-of-financial-year balls, and more.
  • Active Hour: Prioritise your well-being with an hour dedicated each week to focus on your fitness or personal wellness.
  • Comprehensive Health Cash Plan: Get reimbursed for a variety of medical services, including dental, optical, and chiropractic care, with our bronze-level health cash plan.
  • Health & Wellbeing Challenges: Stay engaged with monthly health and wellbeing challenges designed to keep you motivated and healthy.
  • Financial Wellbeing Support: Access expert financial services, including mortgage advice, regulated financial guidance, and money coaching to help you manage your finances.
  • And Much More: Enjoy a range of additional benefits, including company-matched charitable donations, an excellent pension scheme, share options, an electric vehicle scheme, and a variety of salary sacrifice benefits.

Our number one philosophy is Our people. Flight Centre Travel Group's promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which reflects the diversity of our society.

PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THE ROLE: To triage calls to assess needs, giving appropriate care advice and disposition to appropriate level of care treatment while promoting cost-effective outcomes and safely facilitate return to work.


ARE YOU AN IDEAL CANDIDATE? We are looking for enthusiastic candidates who thrive in a collaborative environment, who are driven to deliver great work.


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBLITIES MAY INCLUDE:

  • Applies all phases of the nursing process, i.e., assessment, planning, implementation and evaluation when triaging calls.
  • Identifies the needs of caller by triaging, obtaining general health information and/or physician services referral.
  • Evaluates need for alternative treatment through telephonic contact and assessment with service provider.
  • Triages patient using defined triage protocols to obtain pertinent data; and enters data into computer system.
  • Identifies life-threatening emergencies and recommends appropriate interventions.
  • Refers issues requiring physician interventions to physician in a timely manner; directs patients to appropriate level of care including but not limited to the nearest emergency room, urgent care facility, primary treating physician or selfcare. Demonstrates effective verbal communications skills.
  • Adheres to quality assurance standards.
  • Serves as resource to triage team members.

EDUCATION AND LICENSING

  • Bachelor's degree in nursing (BSN) preferred.
  • Active unrestricted RN compact licensure required along with two (2) years of recent clinical practice experience.
  • Should be proficient in multiple screens and multiple computer applications.

TAKING CARE OF YOU

  • Seeks innovative customer solutions.
  • Craves cutting edge opportunities.
  • Wants dynamic company culture.
  • Passion about creativity.
  • Seeks ongoing learning as a person and professional.
  • Thrives when solving challenging problems.
  • Wants achievements to be celebrated.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts au télétravail


Rejoindre Deloitte, c'est dire oui à une expérience qui a du sens, celle où les rencontres et les missions vous poussent à grandir chaque jour. C’est évoluer dans un environnement de travail fondé sur la confiance, la transmission et l’intelligence collective pour construire l’avenir de nos clients. Un avenir que nous voulons plus responsable, plus durable et respectueux de l’environnement en prenant des initiatives concrètes à notre échelle. Nous rejoindre, c’est aussi dire oui à une entreprise Great Place to Work, attachée au bien-être, et à l’inclusion sans distinction de nos collaborateurs.

Et vous, prêt à dire #ISayYes à votre futur chez Deloitte ?


Quel sera votre rôle dans la #TeamDeloitte ?


Rejoignez l’équipe Sustainability Audit & Assurance (SAAT), qui accompagne des entreprises françaises et internationales de l’industrie et des services dans l’audit, la fiabilisation et la mise en œuvre de leur reporting ESG. Conjuguez expertise ESG et fibre entrepreneuriale : pilotez des missions, développez la relation commerciale et créez des offres innovantes. Dans l’équipe managériale, contribuez à la croissance de l’activité et au développement des collaborateurs.

Vos missions :


  • Entreprendre et développer l’activité : détecter les opportunités, développer votre réseau et piloter propositions commerciales et réponses aux consultations. Transformer les besoins clients en offres différenciantes et concrétiser vos initiatives. Contribuer à la visibilité, au recrutement et à la formation.
  • Piloter les audits de durabilité : apprécier la matérialité, examiner les politiques et le contrôle interne, superviser la vérification des informations ESG et préparer les rapports réglementaires ou volontaires. Garantir la qualité et la documentation des travaux, revoir les livrables et coordonner associés, directeurs, équipes d’audit financier et autres auditeurs.
  • Transformer les exigences ESG en leviers de performance et de résilience : opérationnalisation des réglementations ESG et mise en conformité, analyse de résilience climat et nature, mesure d’impacts financiers, dialogue investisseurs et taxonomie verte européenne, fiabilisation des données et processus, chaine de valeur et vigilance. Déployer des solutions et mobiliser l’IA et la data pour enrichir les analyses et mieux éclairer les décisions.
  • Manager les équipes et la relation client : organiser les missions, suivre calendriers et budgets, assurer la qualité des livrables et construire une relation de confiance. Former les collaborateurs, accompagner leur progression et assurer le suivi RH de consultants.

Des déplacements ponctuels en France et à l’étranger sont à prévoir.

Et si c’était vous ?

  • Vous êtes titulaire d’une formation Bac +5 (Ecole d’ingénieurs ou Ecole de commerce, Master 2 universitaire)
  • Vous disposez d’au moins 5 années d’expérience (hors stages et alternances) en reporting ESG ou financier, en audit, conseil ou entreprise, dont au moins 3 ans en cabinet
  • Habitude du dialogue avec des interlocuteurs de niveau comité de direction
  • Intérêt marqué pour le développement durable, les transitions écologique et sociale, la réglementation ESG et le reporting
  • Capacité à encadrer et accompagner une équipe, avec rigueur, organisation, initiative, clarté de communication et esprit collectif
  • Fibre entrepreneuriale, goût de l’innovation et du développement commercial : proposer, convaincre et concrétiser vos idées
  • Maîtrise d’Excel et PowerPoint, aisance avec les outils d’intelligence artificielle
  • Anglais maîtrisé à l’écrit et à l’oral ; français avancé, équivalent au niveau C1

#ALLIN : tous les candidats ont leur place chez Deloitte. Nous croyons en un environnement inclusif dans lequel les personnes se sentent impliquées, respectées, valorisées, et capables d’apporter leur « soi authentique ». La lutte contre toute forme de discrimination, l’égalité des chances, le respect et la mise en valeur de la diversité sont les pierres angulaires de notre politique RH. Ainsi, toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

Why Merit?

At Merit Medical, our mission is to create innovative medical devices that improve lives. Our goal is to hire and develop people who want to build something special through hard work, team effort, and commitment. Together, we are making a difference in the lives of patients around the world.

SUMMARY OF DUTIES

Job Title: Strategic Accounts Coordinator

Location: UK & Ireland

Department: EMEA Commercial Success & Pricing

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Strategic Accounts Coordinator to support our activities in the regional market. This role is critical in managing key administrative processes, assisting in ensuring smooth execution of Tender/Contract submissions and maintaining volume agreements that support our commercial success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Revenue Management: Monitor and update volume-based agreements, ensuring accurate reporting and timely renewals.
  • Price Management: Upload and maintain pricing data across relevant systems, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
  • Credit/Debit Note Review: Validate and reconcile credit and debit notes, working closely with sales, pricing and customer service teams as required in the Region
  • Membership List Ownership: Maintain and update applicable lists for relevant customer groups, ensuring data integrity and accessibility.
  • Administrative Coordination: Provide general administrative support to the commercial team, including documentation, reporting, and internal communications.
  • Catalogue Management: Keep e-catalogues and product classifications up to date and accurate.
  • Ongoing improvement of commercial processes to drive efficiency.
  • Maintain and develop strong stakeholder relationships with Regional Strategic Accounts, Pricing, Sales and Customer Service Teams.

Qualifications

  • Education or experience in commercial operations, pricing, or administrative roles equivalent to Associate’s Degree.
  • Strong organisational and analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Advanced in Excel.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate well--verbally and in writing--with others.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

We are Global

Founded in 1987, Merit Medical Systems, Inc. is a leading manufacturer and marketer of proprietary disposable medical devices used in interventional, diagnostic and therapeutic procedures, particularly in cardiology, radiology, oncology, critical care and endoscopy. Merit serves client hospitals worldwide with an international sales force and clinical support team totalling in excess of 500 individuals. Merit employs approximately 6,300 people worldwide.

Merit Medical EMEA currently has over 300 employees, spread over more than 20 countries in the EMEA region.

Merit Maastricht (The Netherlands) is the European Headquarters and Distribution Center of Excellence. Much of Merit Medical’s world-class customer service happens here along with our excellent physician training courses. More than 100 employees work at this growing Merit campus and enjoy many benefits, such as flexible working hours and competitive salaries as well as learning opportunities and internships.

Culture

A supportive and collaborative environment make Merit Medical a friendly, enjoyable place to work. We are proud of our energetic and dynamic culture. Diversity & Inclusion is evident here with a 50/50 ratio of male and female employees and more than 30 nationalities. We value every employee as an individual.

To learn more about our companies and how we spark a lifelong love of reading, please visit our website at

Position Summary

First and foremost, you are a pragmatic builder of products. You care about solving problems for a large variety of internal users through technology. You find joy in working closely with stakeholders throughout the company to help them achieve their goals. You prefer simplicity and maintainability to complexity in your approach to building software and you prefer done to perfect. We’re working every day to build and refine digital products that delight users and streamline business processes. Our products will help the company to scale effectively with its rapidly growing product lines that will ultimately allow us to put more books into kid’s hands. We see an opportunity to further leverage our tech stack by enabling broader use through AI toolsets. You will be responsible for scoping and delivering key elements of this approach.

Backend Development for AI Enablement

Internal solutioning and training

  • Lead, coach, and develop a distributed team of SOC Analysts working across multiple regions in a follow-the-sun model.

  • Own the SOC schedule and shift rotations, including weekend coverage, ensuring continuous coverage across all time zones.

  • Define and enforce the shift handover process, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Act as the primary escalation point for the team and as incident lead for major security incidents, coordinating triage, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident reviews with relevant teams.

  • Perform hands-on triage, investigation, and threat hunting alongside the team across the security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Review the quality of investigations and incident documentation, providing structured feedback and ensuring consistent standards across shifts and regions.

  • Define, track, and report SOC metrics and KPIs, such as alert volumes, mean time to detect, mean time to respond, and false positive rates.

  • Drive the improvement of detection content together with security engineering, prioritizing the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules, and mapping coverage to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, incident response playbooks, and escalation matrices.

  • Contribute to the hiring, onboarding, and training of new SOC Analysts.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams, as well as management, to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience in Security Operations, including at least 1 year as a SOC Lead or in an equivalent team lead role.

  • Proven experience triaging alerts, investigating security incidents, and leading the response to major incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience leading or working in a 24/7 or follow-the-sun SOC, including managing shift schedules and remote teams across time zones.

  • Strong experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, GSOM, CISSP, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong leadership, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to report to management and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders during incidents.

About You

You are an experienced SOC practitioner who has moved into leadership without losing your hands-on edge. You know what good triage and investigation look like, and you know how to build a team that delivers them consistently across shifts and time zones. You stay calm during major incidents, communicate clearly with both engineers and management, and make sound decisions under pressure. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools your team relies on, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable leading a fully remote team, and you enjoy coaching analysts, improving processes, and raising the security bar across the environment.

raw.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We've grown 2-3x year over year for three years running, and we're now building the operations, systems, and teams to scale without sacrificing quality or culture. We're fully remote, and we value ownership, open communication, and speed. If you want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel at home here.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior DataOps Engineer to own the operations, security, and cost of our data platform. We're migrating from BigQuery to Snowflake, and you'll be the hands-on Snowflake expert who runs the platform and makes sure it stays secure, observable, and well managed as our data footprint grows with machine learning, AI, and structured and semi-structured data from AWS S3 and external vendor files.

This is a tactical, hands-on role supporting the data team and application teams across multiple business verticals. You'll bring data operations practices together in one place, and over time that scope will grow to include the Postgres and NoSQL databases our application teams use. We need deep Snowflake expertise combined with the breadth to look beyond it: how all of our data tools, vendors, access, and costs fit together, and opportunities to improve platform practices. You bring demonstrated experience managing complex data platforms and improving their operations.

What You Will Own

Data Platform & Operations

  • Run the platform. Own administration and day-to-day operations of Snowflake, including environments, warehouses, performance, and the operational side of our migration from BigQuery.
  • Standardize data operations. Define consistent operating practices for data ingestion from S3 and vendor files, structured and semi-structured data, and ML and AI workloads, using infrastructure as code and CI/CD for data.
  • Extend platform practices to operational databases. Extend consistent operational practices to the Postgres and NoSQL databases used by application teams, including backups, performance, and access.

Security & Access

  • Secure the data. Apply least-privilege permissions, design appropriate data access roles, and integrate our data tools with SSO, with encryption and auditing for sensitive data.
  • Manage data vendors and tools. Manage the external vendors and tools used by our data team, covering access, SSO integration, configuration, and licensing.

Reliability & Cost

  • Keep it observable and reliable. Build monitoring and observability across our data pipelines and platform, and define and run the incident management process, from response through root cause and follow-up.
  • Improve cost transparency. Track and attribute spend across Snowflake and data tooling, provide teams with clear cost visibility, and drive optimization.

Support Across Teams

  • Support multiple teams. Serve as the data operations point of contact for teams across business verticals, helping resolve operational challenges and establishing reusable practices and documentation.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in data platform engineering, DataOps, or DevOps, with a track record of operating production data platforms.
  • Deep Snowflake expertise, including administration, role-based access control, warehouse management, performance, and cost.
  • Strong security and access management skills, including least-privilege role design, SSO integration, encryption, and audit logging.
  • Experience with AWS data storage and access, including S3, IAM, and the networking that governs data access.
  • Experience building monitoring, observability, and incident management for data pipelines and platforms.
  • Experience with cloud data cost visibility and management, including reporting spend clearly to technical and non-technical teams.
  • Experience administering data vendor tools, such as ingestion, orchestration, BI, and data quality platforms.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD for data workloads (e.g., Terraform, dbt deployments).
  • Working experience operating relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres).
  • Broad understanding of the data ecosystem, including how platforms, tools, and processes integrate and where improvements are needed.
  • Strong communication skills and a track record of supporting multiple teams and helping teams adopt shared practices.

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Experience migrating a data warehouse to Snowflake, or working knowledge of BigQuery.
  • Snowflake certifications.
  • Experience supporting data infrastructure for machine learning and AI workloads.
  • Experience with orchestration and transformation tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt).
  • Experience with data governance, catalog, or compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, or in a regulated or document-heavy industry such as legal or financial services.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

About TRG and Clarity

TRG develops intelligence technology that helps organizations make sense of complex data and support critical investigations. Our Intellectus ecosystem is trusted by more than 150 agencies across 20 countries.

Built on this ecosystem, Clarity is our AI-powered anti-fraud investigation platform for corporate, financial organizations , regulators and critical national enterprises. It brings together banking, crypto, open-source and internal data into a single investigative view, helping users uncover hidden connections, trace sources of funds and identify problematic entities in minutes rather than weeks.

We are now scaling Clarity into new sectors—including financial sector, government, commodities trading companies and critical infrastructure—and expanding into new geographies.

The opportunity

We are looking for a Head of Commercial to lead the commercial development and growth of the Clarity business line.

This is an opportunity for a hands-on commercial leader who enjoys building: someone who can define a go-to-market strategy, open doors, lead important deals and, over time, build the team and processes needed to scale.

You will work closely with TRG’s leadership and product teams to bring Clarity to the right customers, shape its positioning and ensure that market feedback informs its evolution.

What you’ll do

Build the commercial strategy

  • Develop and execute Clarity’s go-to-market strategy, including target markets, customer segments, positioning and routes to market.
  • Define the commercial approach for each priority segment, working with leadership on pricing, proposals and contractual models.
  • Identify opportunities to grow through direct sales, partnerships, resellers and other relevant channels.
  • Build a clear commercial plan with measurable goals, priorities and milestones.
  • Define the product needs and work with the development pillar

Generate opportunities and drive revenue

  • Build and manage a pipeline of opportunities across financial services, government and other relevant sectors.
  • Personally lead business development and manage strategic opportunities from initial engagement through to closing.
  • Build relationships with senior stakeholders, including leaders in compliance, risk, investigations, technology and procurement.
  • Represent Clarity in customer meetings, demonstrations, tenders and executive presentations, supported by relevant TRG teams.
  • Understand customer needs and translate them into a compelling business case for Clarity.

Build the go-to-market engine

  • Lead marketing to develop messaging, campaigns and materials that generate awareness and qualified opportunities.
  • Define and build the business development, sales and pre-sales capabilities needed as Clarity grows, including an SDR function where appropriate.
  • Establish practical sales processes, playbooks and reporting to track pipeline and support predictable growth.
  • recruit, onboard and lead commercial team members as the business develops.

Bring the market into the product

  • Develop a strong understanding of customer needs, market trends and the competitive landscape in fraud, AML and financial crime investigations.
  • Gather and share customer feedback with the product team, helping inform product priorities and the Clarity roadmap.
  • Work across product, marketing and leadership to ensure the offering and its positioning remain aligned with market needs.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • Track proven record of building a B2B team and carrying out GTM in multiple regions.
  • Proven track record selling anti-fraud investigation, AML, financial crime, compliance, or similar risk/intelligence software in a B2B environment
  • Experience selling into financial sector, corporates, regulators, or large enterprises (public sector or critical national industry experience a strong plus)
  • Demonstrated success building or scaling a sales function or go-to-market motion — not just carrying a quota, but designing the team and process around it
  • Strong understanding of the financial crime / fraud investigation market/ reputation sectors : buyer personas, procurement cycles, competitive landscape
  • Comfortable owning both strategy and hands-on execution — this role requires building the plane while flying it
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to operate credibly with senior compliance, risk, and technology leaders

Nice-to-haves

  • Existing network within financial sector compliance, AML, financial intelligence units, corporates
  • Experience with AI-powered or data-fusion investigative/analytics platforms
  • Prior experience in a scale-up or product-line-leadership capacity within a larger organization

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

  • A clear, TRG-approved go-to-market strategy and team structure for Clarity
  • A qualified, growing pipeline of enterprise and public-sector opportunities
  • First hires made into the Clarity commercial team, with playbooks and processes in place
  • Closed deals demonstrating Clarity's value in at least one new account or vertical beyond current reference customers

Want to learn more? Visit our website at and our LinkedIn page.
