raw.description:
Duties & Responsibilities

Enrolment & Seat Utilisation

  • Steer importers and dealers to nominate participants and achieve their training targets; promote scheduled courses to the markets.

  • Manage training bookings and seat utilisation for every course.

  • Act as the primary contact for the markets on scheduling: handle enquiries, and communicate schedules, updates and requirements.

  • Support the Analyst with enrolment, registration, cancellation and rescheduling updates in TMSi, and with keeping importer and learner details current.

  • Support the Training Co-ordinator with collecting quarterly training requirement requests from the importers.

  • Support the Training Co-ordinator with maintaining the training calendar and managing changes, and support the Analyst with publishing training events in TMSi in line with the approved calendar.

Fill-Rate & Attendance (SLA)

  • Run the contractual fill-rate checkpoints for every course: the early-warning review 21 calendar days before start, the formal measurement 14 calendar days before start, and the final attendance check 5 to 3 business days before delivery.

  • Act on shortfalls: send participant reminders, escalate to importers and dealers, manage waiting lists and backfill places.

  • Document every contact attempt and escalation, so that the evidence is available for Deviation Requests and Legitimate Cause claims.

  • Support the Programme / Project Manager with preparing Deviation Requests before the 14-day measurement date, and Legitimate Cause claims with supporting evidence.

  • Monitor attendance and completion against agreed requirements, and help resolve differences between planned and actual attendance.

  • Support markets with visa applications for training participants.

Course Logistics & Readiness

  • Book and schedule training with suppliers, confirm the internal and variable trainers allocated to each course, and co-ordinate their logistics.

  • Support the Training Co-ordinator as an operational contact for external training vendors.

  • Prepare the venue for each course with the training centre reception: room set-up, catering, tools, vehicles and equipment; assist with procurement.

  • Ensure physical and soft-copy training materials are ready, available, shared with participants and compliant with BMW Corporate Identity before delivery; correct any gap within 48 hours of notice.

  • Support the Analyst in mapping course materials in TMSi so that they are accessible before delivery.

  • Prepare logistics for product launches, special programmes, events and conferences.

  • Take part in the Programme / Project Manager's briefing for each launch or event, and support the Training Co-ordinator with planning and delivering product launch training events.

Certification

  • Create certificates from training results and share them with the markets.

Market Communication

  • Organise the monthly market calls and prepare presentation materials.

  • Inform the markets of periodic webcasts.

  • Distribute the Importer Training Achievement reports, produced by the Analyst from TMSi data, to each importer at the end of every month, showing progress against the training requirements for the quarter.

  • Act as the first point of contact for importers on issues and queries about their Importer Training Achievement reports, and resolve them with the Analyst where the data needs to be checked or corrected.

  • Track each importer's progress towards achieving the training standards during the quarter, and highlight shortfalls to the importers and the Programme / Project Manager early enough for action to be taken.

  • At each quarter end, issue the final Importer Training Achievement reports to the importers and submit them to the BMW RO by the agreed deadline, confirming with the Analyst that the data is complete, accurate and reconciled with attendance and completion records.

  • Prepare an overview of the monthly and quarterly Importer Training Achievement results for the Programme / Project Manager, with support from the Analyst.

Compliance & Operating Standards

  • Maintain the compliance register of vendor agreements, work permits, licences, sub-supplier documents and their expiry dates.

  • Flag renewals to the Training Co-ordinator ahead of expiry, keeping the Programme / Project Manager informed as the accountable owner, so that no document lapses.

  • Support the Training Co-ordinator with vendor onboarding documentation, PO requests and invoice checks.

  • Develop and maintain the Operating Standards Manual, documenting the processes agreed by the training team.

  • Introduce and manage the agreed processes in the Operating Standards Manual across the team, and keep them current as processes change; report on the manual and process adoption to the Programme / Project Manager.

Data Integrity & Confidentiality

  • Keep enrolment, attendance and contact records complete and accurate; falsification of records is a potential Material Breach under the BMW contract.

  • Protect the confidentiality of participant and training data.

  • Support the Analyst's data-integrity checks.

Team Support

  • Take part in the weekly operations meeting and maintain action logs.

  • Support audits and BMW programme reviews with records and documentation.

  • Contribute to improving tools, templates and processes.

Ad Hoc Duties

  • Undertake additional duties associated with the successful delivery of the BMW ME training programme, as reasonably required by the Programme / Project Manager.

Key Performance Measures

  • Course fill-rate of at least 95% (minimum 8 participants where applicable) at the 14-day measurement, unless an Approved Deviation applies.

  • Fill-rate checkpoints completed and documented on time for every course.

  • Materials and venue ready before every delivery, with no content-readiness Non-Compliance Events.

  • Certificates issued to markets within the agreed time.

  • Importer Training Achievement reports distributed at every month end, and quarter-end reports submitted to the BMW RO complete, accurate and on time.

  • No lapsed vendor agreements, permits or compliance documents.

  • Timely, accurate responses to market scheduling enquiries.

Professional Competence

No day is the same, so it is important that you can prioritise, manage your time successfully, and work both proactively and reactively.

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail across many concurrent courses.

  • Confident follow-up and escalation with importers and dealers to secure attendance.

  • Logistics and event co-ordination experience.

  • Accurate record-keeping and document control.

  • Experience using a learning management system; working knowledge of TMSi is an advantage.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint and Teams.

  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is an advantage.

Personal Competence

  • Persistent and resourceful in getting things done.

  • Calm and composed under pressure and tight deadlines.

  • Service-minded, courteous and professional with all stakeholders.

  • Culturally aware across diverse Middle East markets.

  • Takes ownership of tasks and follows through.

  • Discreet with confidential information.

  • Collaborative team player.

The role

As a Senior AP Accountant you will own the most complex and business-critical AP activities within your scope. You will be a senior point of contact for business stakeholders, apply judgment to non-standard situations that have no established precedent, and actively support the development of the broader team. You will also be a hands-on contributor to continuous improvement - bringing operational knowledge to improvement projects led by the Continuous Improvement Specialist.

  • 6+ years of experience in Accounts Payable or Finance Operations, including experience with complex or business-critical entities
  • Demonstrated ability to handle non-standard situations independently and apply senior judgment

  • Strong experience with month-end close, reconciliations and AP controls
  • Solid working knowledge of NetSuite and Blackline; familiarity with Zip is a strong advantage
  • Experience in multi-currency, multi-entity or multi-country AP environments
  • Track record of informally developing or mentoring more junior colleagues

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

We are a fast-growing B2B SaaS company transforming how hospitality businesses operate through technology. Mapal Group provides an integrated platform that helps restaurants, hotels, and contract catering brands optimize operations, empower their teams, and scale efficiently. Operating across Europe, the UK, and LATAM, we continue to expand our footprint as we accelerate our growth.

💡Our Culture

Our culture is shaped by six core values: Commitment, Customer Obsession, One Team, Ownership, Resilience, and Think Big. These values drive everything we do, from how we support our customers to how we work together as a team. We seek individuals who embody these values, bringing passion and creativity to their work, taking ownership of their contributions, and embracing collaboration and innovation to achieve ambitious goals.

🎯Role Overview

We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong analytical mindset to join our team at Mapal and take ownership of Mapal Operating System (MoS) — the core platform that connects and powers all Mapal products.

MoS acts as the source of truth for our global ecosystem: it hosts shared data, global services, and cross-product functionalities that make the entire Mapal suite work seamlessly together. This role is ideal for someone who understands technology deeply and enjoys transforming technical foundations into scalable, valuable product experiences.

🛠 Key Responsabilities

You will define and drive the product strategy for MoS, ensuring it provides a robust, unified backbone for all Mapal applications. You’ll collaborate with engineering to design scalable services and APIs, with other product teams to define shared functionalities, and with data and operations to ensure MoS evolves as a true global platform.

  • Define and own the product vision and roadmap for MoS.

  • Partner with engineering to translate architectural and infrastructure needs into clear product goals and deliverables.

  • Ensure data consistency and interoperability across all Mapal products.

  • Drive the development of shared services (notifications, authentication, integrations, analytics, etc.) that can be reused across the ecosystem.

  • Collaborate with other Product Managers to identify and prioritize cross-product functionalities that should live in MoS.

  • Establish metrics and dashboards to measure the adoption, stability, and performance of MoS.

Requirements

✅ Qualifications

  • Experience in product management within a SaaS or platform-based environment.

  • Solid understanding of APIs, system architecture, and data modeling.

  • Ability to translate complex concepts into clear product narratives.

  • Proven collaboration skills with engineering and cross-functional teams.

  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • A passion for building the invisible layers that make complex ecosystems work smoothly.

At Mapal, we’re building the technology that powers hospitality worldwide. As the Product Manager for MoS, you’ll shape the foundation on which all our products depend — ensuring consistency, scalability, and global impact. This is a unique opportunity to work on the connective tissue of an entire platform and to influence how thousands of businesses experience Mapal every day.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Developer Productivity organization works to make Stripe the most productive place of an engineer’s career. The Code Review team builds the tools and processes that help Stripe engineers review and ship code safely and efficiently. We treat engineers’ attention as a valuable resource, building tools that help them understand changes and focus on the decisions that need human judgment.

Our goal is to build an AI review agent that outperforms human review at preventing problems after changes merge, while helping developers move quickly. We are also moving code review from GitHub to Orbit Diffs, Stripe’s own review interface, and enabling Stripe’s migration from legacy source control infrastructure to new systems, including infrastructure built at Stripe.

What you’ll do

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will take ownership of problems across the code review domain, set technical direction, and build alignment across Stripe. You will combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering to build the systems that determine which changes can be approved by agents and when human judgment is needed. Your decisions will influence both the pace and safety of changes across Stripe.

You will work across user interfaces, backend services, source control integrations, and agent harnesses. Our team works primarily in Go, Ruby, and TypeScript, and you will use the technologies each problem requires. As AI capabilities evolve, you will experiment with new approaches and turn them into reliable, maintainable tools for developers.

Responsibilities

  • Set technical direction for code review, build alignment across Stripe, and mentor engineers as you lead complex projects from problem definition through delivery and adoption
  • Build and improve agent harnesses that enable review agents to exercise judgment and safely approve pull requests
  • Develop evaluations that compare agent and human review decisions, assess the safety of merged changes and the impact on developer velocity, and guide improvements to approval decisions
  • Evaluate and apply advances in AI and agent orchestration to accelerate engineering delivery across Stripe while maintaining review quality, maintainability, reliability, and change safety
  • Build and maintain Orbit Diffs and the surrounding code review tools, helping engineers understand changes and focus their attention where their judgment is most valuable
  • Improve code ownership, intelligent reviewer assignment, stacked pull request workflows, and controls for change management
  • Support Stripe’s migration to new source control infrastructure by adapting code review workflows and integrations
  • Partner with security, compliance, infrastructure, reliability, and language and runtime teams to improve how software changes are evaluated and approved across Stripe

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including designing, building, and operating reliable production software across languages and system boundaries
  • Experience owning a technical domain, setting technical direction, and leading complex projects from ambiguous problems through delivery
  • Experience using data and user feedback to evaluate quality, understand user needs, and guide engineering decisions
  • Experience building alignment across teams, explaining technical tradeoffs, and adapting your approach as technologies evolve

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building agent harnesses, orchestrating agents, or designing evaluations for agent behavior
  • Experience building developer productivity tools, especially code review or related workflows
  • Experience with software change management and compliance, including designing, implementing, or maintaining controls

Location: Santiago, Chile

Contract Type: Short-term contract


YOUR POSITION WITH TNC

The Conservation Practitioner develops, manages and advances conservation programs, plans and methods for large-scale geographic areas.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The Conservation Practitioner provides technical leadership and support to a business unit or Ocean Division by planning, directing and implementing preserve management programs and stewardship. They address critical ocean threats to natural systems and individual species, fosters cross-site learning among an international conservation community, and supplies conservation planning teams (formerly called “eco regional” planning teams) with site or ocean large scale geographic areas information relevant to the planning process. They develop and implement conservation strategies, employ a full range of protection tools to acquire varying degrees of legal interest in ocean and implement a variety of strategies to secure public and private support for TNC conservation priorities. They coordinate community, and others key stakeholders support in ocean conservation and marine management resources programs.


RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

  • Support and facilitate the development of multidisciplinary teams, contributing to staff training, mentoring, performance feedback, and professional growth opportunities as needed.
  • Track project implementation, budgets, HUB milestones and deliverables, and MEL (Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning) plans to support adaptive management, performance assessment, and reporting; prepare and review technical and financial reports; support financial forecasting; and
  • Contribute directly to donor proposals, work plans, and internal and external reporting.
  • Gain cooperation from outside parties to accomplish program goals.
  • Financial responsibility may include working within/managing a budget to complete projects, negotiating and contracting with vendors, assisting with budget development, and meeting fundraising targets.
  • Ensures program compliance with internal policies and external requirements.
  • Under minimal supervision, makes independent decisions based on analysis, experience and context.
  • May work in variable weather conditions, at remote locations, on difficult and hazardous terrain and under physically demanding circumstances.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in biology, marine science, environmental studies, conservation, or similar field and 5 years’ experience in natural resource management or related field required.
  • Experience working with fisheries management, marine science and/or marine conservation.
  • Knowledge of current political and socioeconomic trends and practices that affect the marine environment in Chile, particularly fisheries, and ability to work at the nexus of science and policy.
  • Ability and willingness to apply science to decision-making and guide activities.
  • Experience in working with a broad variety of stakeholders related to the marine environment, including government officials, fishing communities, academia, NGO’s, others in Chile.
  • Experience completing tasks independently with respect to timeline(s).
  • Experience using common software applications such as Word, Excel, web browsers, etc.
  • Fluent with communication via written, spoken and graphical means in English and Spanish
  • Experience negotiating agreements.
  • Experience communicating with the public and/or media both in writing and verbally.
  • Possession of a valid Chilean Class B driver's license

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to explain conservation practices to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Completing tasks independently with respect to timeline(s).

This position requires a valid driver's license and compliance with TNC’s Auto Safety Program. Employees may not drive Conservancy-owned/leased vehicles, rental cars, or personal vehicles on behalf of the Conservancy if considered "high risk drivers." To learn more about the Auto Safety Program, visit the Auto Safety information page. Employment in this position will be contingent upon completion of a Vehicle Use Agreement, which may include a review of the prospective employee's motor vehicle record.

Grade: 6

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is an opportunity to contribute to technology initiatives in a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth.

Job Title: Cypress Automation Engineer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2 - [Not open to C2C or 1099]

Salary Range: $115,000–$165,000 Annually

Experience Required: 4+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, EAD holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. Bright Vision Technologies is unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a Cypress Automation Engineer to create dependable automated tests for web applications and services. This position focuses on designing maintainable Cypress test suites, validating application behavior across user workflows and APIs, integrating automation into delivery pipelines, and partnering with developers to identify defects early in the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Cypress end-to-end and component tests using JavaScript or TypeScript.

  • Build reusable commands, fixtures, test data utilities, and test patterns that improve automation consistency.

  • Validate user workflows, application states, API requests, and integrations across supported browsers.

  • Configure automated test execution in CI/CD workflows and communicate failures with clear diagnostic evidence.

  • Analyze test failures, reduce flaky automation, and collaborate with developers to improve testability and release quality.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience Required: typically 4+ years in software quality assurance or test automation; align the final threshold with the approved requisition.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Cypress and JavaScript or TypeScript.

  • Understanding of browser architecture, DOM selectors, asynchronous behavior, assertions, and test isolation.

  • Experience testing REST APIs, network requests, authentication, and data-driven application workflows.

  • Ability to design reusable automation components, fixtures, test data, and readable test cases.

  • Working knowledge of Git, Agile delivery, and CI/CD automation practices.

  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Experience working in iterative software delivery teams, participating in planning, defect triage, and release validation as appropriate to the assignment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Cypress component testing, visual validation, or accessibility automation.

  • Exposure to TypeScript, Node.js, Docker, or cloud-based browser test execution.

  • Familiarity with test reporting tools and quality metrics for continuous delivery.

  • Cypress or other recognized software-testing certification.

How to Apply

Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact Jennifer at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Marketing Manager, Communications & Content

Location: Remote – Mexico
Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Employment Type: Independent Contractor (ongoing)
Industry: Marketing & Advertising
Compensation: $1,000–$1,300 USD/week
Schedule: Self-directed; you set your own schedule and methods, with weekly or biweekly updates
English Proficiency: C1 (Excellent spoken and written English)
Start Date: November 16, 2026

About the Role

A leading independent PR, creative, and digital agency is seeking an experienced marketing and communications professional to support the agency's own brand, content, and visibility on a contract basis. The firm combines earned media, digital marketing, and generative engine optimization (GEO) with the agency's own research and studies, to help brands show up wherever buyers search, scroll, or ask, including in AI search and answer engines. Its communications work is done in house, spanning earned media, content, social, video, performance marketing, and AI-driven visibility.
This engagement covers a broad mix of work: PR and communications for the agency's own research and studies, social media, video, press release distribution, agency awards, paid search, and content built for generative AI search. It also includes applying AI automation to make the agency's marketing workflows more efficient.
You will deliver on an agreed-upon scope and content calendar while setting your own schedule and methods. This remote role is ideal for a self-directed marketer who is equally comfortable writing a press release, editing a video, and building an automated workflow.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Broad ownership of the agency's own brand, content, and visibility, not a narrow single-channel brief.
  • A mix of PR, social, video, awards, paid search, and AI-search content, plus marketing automation.
  • Real autonomy: you set your own schedule and methods, and deliver against an agreed scope and content calendar.

What You'll Do

Communications, PR & Research Visibility

  • Manage all communications for the agency's own research, studies, and related content.
  • Lead PR outreach to secure media coverage for that research and those studies.
  • Write, format, and distribute press releases through PR Newswire.

Social, Video & Content

  • Create and publish social media content according to the content calendar.
  • Produce and edit short-form video for social, blogs, and other channels.
  • Write GEO-friendly (generative engine optimization) content so the agency's research surfaces in AI search and answer engines.

Awards, Paid Search & Automation

  • Manage the awards program: identify opportunities, write and submit entries, promote wins, and coordinate trophy orders.
  • Plan, manage, and optimize PPC campaigns, with performance and spend reporting.
  • Build and maintain AI-powered automations for content production, distribution, and reporting.
  • Provide weekly or biweekly updates on progress and results.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, communications, or PR, ideally with or for an agency.
  • Strong writing across press releases, award submissions, social, and long-form content.
  • Experience with media pitching and securing coverage.
  • Hands-on video production and editing (Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, or similar).
  • Hands-on PPC experience (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads).
  • Familiarity with PR Newswire or other wire services.
  • Experience with GEO/AEO and SEO for AI search.
  • Experience building marketing automations with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Zapier, Make, or similar).
  • Self-directed and organized, able to manage a broad scope without close day-to-day supervision.
  • C1 English (excellent spoken and written English).
  • Based in Latin America or North America, and able to work fully remotely.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field.

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:
  • Strong writing across press releases, award submissions, social, and long-form content.
  • Experience with media pitching and a track record of securing coverage.
  • Hands-on video production and editing.
  • Hands-on PPC experience (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads).
  • Familiarity with PR Newswire or other wire services.
  • Working knowledge of GEO/AEO and SEO for AI-driven search.
  • Experience building marketing automations with AI tools.
  • Ability to work in a self-directed way and manage a broad, multi-channel scope without close day-to-day supervision.
  • At least 3 years of experience in marketing, communications, or PR, ideally in an agency setting.
  • C1 spoken and written English.
  • Availability to work fully remotely from Latin America or North America.

How Success Is Measured

  • The agency's research and studies earn consistent media coverage and stay visible.
  • Social content stays on calendar, and short-form video supports the right channels.
  • Press releases are accurate, well formatted, and distributed on time through the wire.
  • The awards program runs smoothly: opportunities are captured, entries are submitted, wins are promoted, and trophy orders are coordinated.
  • PPC campaigns improve over time, with clear performance and spend reporting.
  • GEO-friendly content helps the agency's research surface in AI search and answer engines.
  • Marketing workflows become more efficient as AI-powered automations are built and maintained.
  • Stakeholders stay informed through clear, timely weekly or biweekly updates, and the agreed scope and content calendar are delivered.

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote opportunity from Latin America or North America.
  • Competitive compensation: $1,000–$1,300 USD/week, depending on experience.
  • An ongoing contract supporting the brand and visibility of a leading independent agency.
  • A results-focused culture that values adaptation, impact, and people who want to create what comes next.

Important Notes

Applications may not be considered if candidates:
  • Are not based in Latin America or North America.
  • Do not have at least 3 years of experience in marketing, communications, or PR.
  • Do not have C1 spoken and written English, or cannot show strong writing across press releases, social, and long-form content.
  • Do not have hands-on video production and editing experience, or hands-on PPC experience.
  • Are not comfortable working in a self-directed way, without close day-to-day supervision.
This is a remote/telecommute position.

Marathon is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work®, reflecting the company's commitment to building an inclusive, high-trust culture where all employees can thrive. Learn more at

ABOUT THE JOB

Perform accounting and clerical duties related to the efficient maintenance and processing of accounts payable transactions.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Monitor the AP mailbox and sort, log, and route incoming invoices and vendor inquiries to the appropriate team member.
  • Scan, index, and attach invoices and supporting documents in the invoice processing system.
  • Check invoices for basic required information (vendor name, invoice number, date, amount, site/location) and follow up when information is missing.
  • Process high-volume vendor invoices accurately and in a timely manner for approval routing.
  • Follow up with approvers on pending invoices and follow up with vendors re invoices that are past due.
  • Respond to routine internal and external questions about invoice and payment status, and escalate complex issues to a senior team member.
  • Assist with collecting vendor setup documents, such as W-9 forms, and maintaining vendor records.
  • Responding to inquiries from vendors and internal staff.
  • Monitor and record all corporate credit card activity.
  • Assist with Concur expense review.
  • Assist with filing of 1099 and 1096 annually.
  • Assist with vendor statement reviews and research of discrepancies.
  • Participate in team projects and continuous improvement efforts to enhance accounts payable processes and service delivery.
  • Perform other related duties and special assignments as required to support business needs.

QUALIFICATIONS

Associate's degree in accounting, business, or a related field preferred and 1-2 year of experience in accounts payable, accounting, or office administration, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Internship or coursework in accounting may substitute for experience. Experience with invoice automation or accounting systems (such as NetSuite, Beanworks, or Ramp) is a plus but not required.

DESIRED ATTRIBUTES

  • Results-driven with strong persistence and follow-through; demonstrates initiative, accountability, and a sense of urgency
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while meeting deadlines.

  • Ability to work independently and within a team environment and prioritize tasks.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and account reconciliation skills.

raw.description:
Cerro Wire LLC

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

At Marmon Electrical, we power a bright future for millions of people around the world. From homes to industries that shape lives, we deliver solutions that keep people connected and energized—and it all starts with you. We’re doing things that matter. Our electrical engineering solutions impact millions worldwide through safe and dependable energy supply. We deliver electrical solutions from the ocean depths to outer space. As part of Marmon, you’re helping keep millions worldwide healthy, connected and safe.


Cerrowire®, a Marmon/Berkshire Hathaway company, is a leading U.S. copper wire supplier for residential, commercial and industrial applications. In addition to rugged and dependable, guaranteed products, including MC cables and aluminum wires, the Cerrowire focus is on customer service and delivering on time and in full from our wire manufacturing plants in Alabama, Georgia, Indiana, and Utah. We create our quality products in our new, state-of-the-art MC cable plant. As part of the Marmon Electrical family of companies, Cerrowire benefits from the financial strength, operational discipline, and long-term ownership philosophy of Berkshire Hathaway while maintaining the focused, entrepreneurial operating culture of a market leader in its category.


The Enterprise Data Solutions Manager builds the governed data products, Power BI solutions and applied AI tools that Cerrowire teams use to make decisions. Working in Microsoft Fabric and Azure AI Foundry, this role turns established business requirements into production solutions and owns technical delivery from design through support.


The role’s primary focus is the gold layer: semantic models, standardized metrics and the BI and AI experiences built on them. The Senior Data Engineer owns ingestion through the silver layer; this role owns everything users consume from there. The successful candidate brings solid Fabric, SQL and Python skills, hands-on generative AI experience, and the judgment to build AI that is secure, measurable and cost-aware.


Why Join Us?

  • Health Benefits effective day one (Life, Health, Dental, Vision)
  • Holiday pay effective day one
  • Vacation and Personal Time Off (prorated & accrued)
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Employee Discount Program
  • Six Sigma & Lean Training
  • Learning & Development Training
  • 401k with company matching

Key Responsibilities:

Data & Analytics

  • Build and maintain gold-layer data products, semantic models and standardized business metrics in Microsoft Fabric, partnering with the Senior Data Engineer on upstream pipelines.
  • Develop Power BI reports and Copilot-enabled experiences that let users securely interact with governed datasets.
  • Implement usage telemetry and adoption dashboards for BI, automation and AI tools, and recommend improvements based on usage patterns.

Applied AI & Automation

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions and agentic workflows using Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot and other approved enterprise AI platforms.
  • Build and maintain embeddings, vector stores and grounding strategies that connect AI solutions to governed data.
  • Evaluate AI solutions for retrieval quality, groundedness, reliability, latency and usability, and build in monitoring, logging, error handling and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Automate business processes with Power Automate and Power Apps where they are the right fit.

Security & Governance

  • Apply data classification, PII handling and access controls, including row-level security and Entra ID, to every BI and AI solution.
  • Design AI solutions to resist prompt injection and limit agent permissions to the minimum required.
  • Serve as a technical resource in Data & AI governance and use-case reviews.

Delivery & Standards

  • Own technical delivery once requirements are approved: design, development, testing, deployment, documentation and production support.
  • Follow SDLC practices, including Git version control, Fabric deployment pipelines, testing, release management and documentation of designs, data definitions, lineage and runbooks.
  • Build reusable components, templates and prompt patterns that speed future development.
  • Run proofs of concept and make evidence-based technology recommendations covering fit, security, scalability and cost, including Fabric capacity and AI consumption.

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Work with analysts, the Senior Data Engineer, plant and business stakeholders, and vendors on design, implementation and knowledge transfer.
  • Mentor peers through design and code reviews, and lead demos and office hours that build practical adoption of data and AI.

What Success Looks Like:

First 6 months

  • A gold-layer semantic model and Power BI solution in production on Fabric, adopted by its business users.
  • A first AI solution (RAG or agent) piloted with defined evaluation metrics and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Documented development, testing and deployment standards for the team’s Fabric and AI work.

First 12 months

  • Governed data products in use across Cerrowire’s plant sites.
  • At least one AI solution in production with monitored quality, cost and adoption.
  • A library of reusable components and patterns used by the Reporting & Analytics team.

Requirements:

  • Work Authorization Requirement: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. The company is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3–5 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics engineering, data engineering or software development.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric or a comparable cloud data platform.
  • Strong SQL, including developing and troubleshooting complex queries and data structures.
  • Working proficiency in Python, including notebook-based or PySpark data work.
  • Power BI experience, including semantic modeling, DAX and report development.
  • Hands-on development of at least one generative AI solution, such as a RAG application, agent or LLM-integrated workflow.
  • Experience with Git-based version control.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate.
  • Production experience with AI agents, RAG, embeddings or vector databases, including Azure AI Foundry.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
  • Experience with row-level security, Entra ID or Microsoft Purview.
  • Experience in manufacturing, or with Sage X3 or Salesforce data.

Pay Range:

80,000.00 - 120,000.00

Role Title: Physics Expert (Quantum Optics and Atomic Physics)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Physics Experts (Quantum Optics and Atomic Physics) to contribute to a customer's ambitious research-driven benchmarking project at the frontiers of quantum science. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. This engagement focuses on quantum optics and atomic physics, encompassing quantum sensing and metrology, trapped and levitated particles, ultracold atom platforms, atomic structure, and precision measurement. raw.description:
About the Role

The QA Specialist leads the quality review work instead of doing every review. You will source, onboard, support, and audit a network of independent (1099) reviewers, define the rules our QAi tool checks on each claim, and act as the account expert and client escalation point. You use your own judgment to set the quality standard, decide whether work meets it, and decide how files are assigned.

You complete reviews yourself only after the leading work is done, and none during busy periods.

What You'll Do

  • Build the reviewer network: source and vet independent (1099) reviewers, working with leadership and recruiting, including confirming licensing and qualifications.
  • Onboard: create and maintain onboarding materials on carrier guidelines, account requirements, and our quality standards for independent reviewers.
  • Be the point of contact: answer independent reviewer questions on carrier guidelines and account requirements so files keep moving.
  • Audit and evaluate: audit completed 1099 work product against quality standards, give feedback on deliverables, and use quality and turnaround data to decide how files are assigned, including offering more files or ending an engagement.
  • Assign files: offer and assign files across the independent reviewer network so carrier deadlines are met, including in busy periods.
  • Set the QAi rules: define the rules QAi checks on each claim. You work with IT, who build and configure the tool.
  • Own your accounts: be the knowledge expert for the accounts you handle, including carrier guidelines, authority limits, and preferred systems.
  • Handle escalations: be the escalation point for files for the client, taking the load off field leaders and account executives.
  • Work the file: update the estimate based on the carrier rules and the photos provided, using your license in that state and the carrier's preferred system, such as Xactimate.
  • Review last: complete reviews when everything else is done. In busy periods, none. In slow periods or on tight timelines, you may review.
  • Measure the work: track process and time to complete tasks. This role manages quality and cycle time, not cost.

Availability

  • You are available during core business hours and peak periods, so reviewer questions and client escalations get answered while files are moving.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Strong quality judgment on residential property claims.
  • Working knowledge of carrier guidelines and account requirements.
  • Estimating skill in Xactimate or the carrier's preferred system, and an active adjuster license.
  • Comfort auditing work product and giving quality feedback to independent reviewers.
  • Ability to use data to judge quality and time in process.
  • Clear communication and accountability with clients, leaders, and 1099 reviewers.
  • Interest in how rules and systems drive automation.

How success is measured

Measures for leading the independent reviewer network and QAi are being built with leadership and will be shared before the roles go live.

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Strategic Sourcing Senior Manager - Capital Construction


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will report to the strategic sourcing team in the Construction, Equipment, Facilities and Utilities vertical within the Global Procurement Organization (GPO). The Senior Manager will develop and manage the category’s sourcing strategy and supplier management processes in collaboration with key stakeholders across the Operations organization, developing long-range sourcing plans and forecasts to support innovative value creation strategies for capital projects across the USA and elsewhere as project organization needs require.

This role will lead the definition and execution of strategies that shape how Amgen sources and contracts for capital construction projects. It will focus on identifying productivity opportunities and supporting speed to market, quality, compliance, and effective project delivery. The Senior Manager will partner with stakeholders earlier in the capital project lifecycle to help define sourcing needs, assess delivery and contracting approaches, and integrate procurement considerations into project planning and execution.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the global capital sourcing strategy and portfolio roadmap.

  • Act as the primary procurement lead and category ambassador.
  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard qualified suppliers.

  • Support construction contracts and commercial frameworks, including pricing, scope, risk, and performance management.
  • Promote compliant and consistent sourcing practices.
  • Monitor and communicate sourcing performance, risks, and opportunities.
  • Develop long-term sourcing strategies aligned with capital investment plans.
  • Lead stakeholder engagement across global and cross-functional teams.
  • Build and execute a pipeline of value-generating sourcing initiatives.
  • Maintain industry expertise and identify best practices and innovations.
  • Develop sourcing strategies based on project needs, supplier capacity, market conditions, and regulatory requirements.
  • Assess construction market trends, supplier capabilities, and pricing dynamics.
  • Advance procurement transformation through earlier stakeholder engagement.
  • Drive process improvements using portfolio insights, market intelligence, and cross-project learnings.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The strategic sourcing professional we seek is a collaborative leader with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 2 years of Capital Engineering, Construction, and Equipment

OR

Master’s degree and 4 years of Capital Engineering, Construction, and Equipment

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of Capital Engineering, Construction, and Equipment

OR

Associate’s degree and 10 years of Capital Engineering, Construction, and Equipment

OR

High school diploma / GED and 12 years of Capital Engineering, Construction, and Equipment


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven knowledge and experience in Capital Engineering, Construction, and Equipment.
  • Experience delivering projects for a pharmaceutical or biotechnology company.
  • Experience interacting and collaborating with Project Management, Engineering, Project Estimating and Controls, Finance, and Legal.
  • Understanding of the planning, development, and execution of capital projects.
  • Broad knowledge of the Capital Construction industry, supplier base, and legal and regulatory environment.
  • Experience with construction sourcing and contracting models, such as CMAR, CMGMP, EPCM, and A&E services.

  • Familiarity with project cost, schedule, scope, change management, and supplier performance considerations.
  • Solid understanding of procurement, sourcing, and category management methodologies.
  • Ability to drive value for customers by selecting and applying appropriate sourcing levers.
  • Strong negotiation skills and the ability to create value for business partners and suppliers through strategic supplier agreements.
  • Ability to analyze spend data and present insights suited to the needs of the audience.
  • Experience using market intelligence, benchmarking, and supplier information to inform sourcing and contracting recommendations.
  • Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct benchmarking to address cost, quality, risk, and innovation considerations.
  • Ability to lead teams in a matrix organization across geographies, enabling successful transition and operational change for the business.
  • Demonstrated track record of identifying root causes and proactively solving complex organizational needs.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across a global portfolio of projects and stakeholders.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Integrate applicable Zero Trust and access-control requirements into service workflows, staff training, and coordination with cybersecurity.

Job Description: Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineer

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineers to contribute their expertise to a project focused on advanced inspection and measurement solutions.

In this role, you will help train and evaluate next-generation AI systems by providing high-quality, real-world metrology expertise. You will review and produce first-article inspection (FAI) deliverables using 3D scanning and advanced metrology software. Your work will involve validating scan-to-CAD comparisons, datum setups, and profile and position callouts while ensuring dimensional accuracy.

You will also assess whether measurement deviations result from actual part discrepancies or from fixturing and alignment artefacts, providing valuable technical insights to support FAI report reviews and sign-off decisions. Prior AI experience is not required; relevant industry expertise is what matters.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Review and validate first-article inspection (FAI) reports generated from 3D scan data.
  2. Perform detailed scan-to-CAD comparisons and analyze dimensional deviations and their potential causes.
  3. Establish, interpret, and document datum structures, profile tolerances, and position callouts in accordance with applicable industry standards.
  4. Apply Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) techniques and conduct measurement uncertainty analysis.
  5. Distinguish actual part deviations from artefacts caused by fixturing, alignment, or measurement setup issues.
  6. Provide clear, detailed written and verbal feedback to support FAI review and sign-off decisions.
  7. Contribute accurate and specialized metrology insights to support AI system development and evaluation.

Required and Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) and first-article inspection processes within manufacturing or quality environments.
  • Proficiency with 3D scanning equipment and inspection software such as PolyWorks, GOM Inspect, or equivalent tools.
  • Solid experience with CMM measurement techniques and measurement uncertainty analysis.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, and technical specifications.

Working at NLR

NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development.

Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.

At NLR, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.



Job Description

The Geospatial Data Science (GDS) team within the Strategic Energy Analysis Center at the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) is seeking a 6–12-month intern to support modeling and analysis. The GDS group conducts research at the intersection of energy deployment, big data science, and geospatial modeling and visualization. Our team of researchers develops and applies geospatial algorithms and methods to evaluate the deployment potential for energy technologies, including geothermal, hydropower, transmission, bioenergy, wind, and solar. Geospatial modeling at NLR enables detailed techno-economic assessment, capacity expansion, and power systems modeling of energy resources under a variety of regulatory, sociopolitical, and environmental factors from local to continental scales.

The successful intern candidate will support a large and diverse modeling portfolio with activities involving geospatial analyses, literature reviews, cartography, scientific programming, and tasks focused on data preparation, processing, and validation. This position will assist geospatial scientists in developing novel analytical solutions to complex challenges in energy siting, deployment, and adoption. Candidates should be interested in working in an interdisciplinary field, together with geospatial data scientists, software developers, and policy analysts, which will require excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Duties will include:

  • Manipulating multiple data sources, models, and software tools with scientific and engineering workflows for decision support and data analysis
  • Preparing and processing geospatial data using open-source desktop software and programmatic approaches
  • Conducting background research on data sets, current modeling approaches, and existing tools
  • Developing literature reviews under the guidance of research scientists
  • Programming and scripting in Python to conduct analysis and visualize data
  • Working in distributed computing environments including internal servers, NLR's high-performance computing (HPC) system and the Cloud

.

Graduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a master’s degree program from an accredited institution.
Post Graduate: Earned a master’s degree within the past 12 months. Eligible for an internship period of up to one year.

Alternatively, please explain in your cover letter why your application does not include a code repository and/or several examples of previous projects

raw.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we help improve the quality and reliability of clinical trial data by providing specialized clinical assessment, training, and quality oversight solutions to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies around the world.

Our team partners with sponsors and research sites to support the consistent administration, scoring, and review of clinical outcome assessments across global clinical trials. Through services including central scoring, central review, image-based review, rater training and certification, calibration, and quality review and remediation, we help reduce variability, strengthen data quality, and ensure greater confidence in clinical trial endpoints.

Our work spans multiple therapeutic areas, including dermatology, where we engage experienced clinicians to bring indication-specific and scale-specific expertise to clinical trial programs. Our experts help ensure assessments are performed and evaluated consistently, from training and certifying site raters to centrally reviewing scores and images and identifying opportunities for remediation.

Our global team brings together clinical, scientific, operational, data, and technology expertise to solve complex challenges in clinical trials. At Cogstate, our goal is simple: to help sponsors generate high-quality, reliable data that supports confident decision-making throughout clinical development.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

About the Role

Cogstate is seeking experienced Dermatologists to support clinical research studies through a range of centralized assessment and quality oversight services. In this fully remote, contract-based role, clinicians may perform Central Scoring, Central Review, Image-Based Review, Site Rater Training & Certification, Calibration Activities, and Quality Review & Remediation across a variety of dermatology clinical trials.

Cogstate provides comprehensive, fully compensated training on study protocols, scoring methodologies, review processes, and operational requirements before clinicians begin study work. Ongoing calibration exercises and quality oversight activities help ensure consistency, reliability, and regulatory compliance across all study assessments.

Depending on study needs and individual expertise, consultants may contribute to one or more service areas, including:

  • Central Scoring: Independent scoring and interpretation of dermatology-specific clinician-reported and observer-reported outcome measures.
  • Central Review: Secondary review of completed assessments to ensure accuracy, consistency, and protocol adherence.
  • Image-Based Review: Evaluation of clinical photographs and imaging data to assess disease severity, treatment response, and endpoint compliance.
  • Site Rater Training & Certification: Training, certifying, and supporting site-based raters on proper scale administration and scoring procedures.
  • Calibration Activities: Participating in ongoing calibration exercises to maintain inter-rater reliability and scoring consistency across global studies.
  • Quality Review & Remediation: Identifying assessment quality issues, providing corrective feedback, and supporting remediation efforts to improve data quality and protocol compliance.

These are fully-remote, contract positions. Work is provided on an as-needed basis and scheduled according to clinician availability.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD or DO with specialization in Dermatology.
  • Board-certified or board-eligible Dermatologist preferred.
  • Active and unrestricted medical license in a relevant jurisdiction.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of post-training clinical practice experience in dermatology.
  • Experience evaluating and managing patients with dermatologic conditions in clinical, academic, or research settings.
  • Demonstrated experience with dermatology clinical outcome assessments, disease severity scales, and clinician-reported outcome measures.
  • Experience with one or more dermatology indications such as atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, vitiligo, hidradenitis suppurativa, alopecia areata, prurigo nodularis, eczema, chronic pruritus, or other inflammatory and rare dermatologic disorders.
  • Familiarity with dermatology rating scales and assessments such as EASI, IGA, SCORAD, PASI, DLQI, VASI, PP-NRS, HiSCR, CDLQI, and other study-specific outcome measures.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to consistently apply scoring criteria and identify assessment quality issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide training, feedback, and remediation guidance to site personnel.
  • Proficiency with telehealth platforms, Microsoft Office applications, and web-based clinical trial systems.

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

Short Description:

Under general supervision, provides professional level category support in a variety of procurement activities. Participates in on-going category and vendor performance management.

Complete Description:

This position is responsible for providing customer service focused assistance with the planning, organizing, and coordination of purchasing and procurement of Information Technology related goods/services accomplished by following procurement and purchasing policies and procedures. This includes acquiring resources following best practices, within time constraints, and facilitating communication between the agency and its providers to deliver products and services according to the departmental strategic business plan. This position will be responsible for assisting with the implementation of and supporting of processes that provide timely, cost-effective, high quality goods/services through cooperative and proactive procurement practices.

Role and Responsibilities:

Works under supervision of the Purchasing Manager, with latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.

Coordinates the purchase of merchandise, supplies, and equipment and services using established guidelines, rules and regulations, policies and laws; prepares, reviews, tracks and expedites purchase orders; reviews quotes, proposals, agreement and purchase orders for conformance to agency policy, regulations and laws.

Generates reports and maintain records of goods ordered and received.

Assists in the maintenance of the procurement database and coordinates with departments and vendors to make purchases; monitor and track vendor performance; discuss defective or unacceptable new goods or services with users, vendors and others to determine cause of problem and take corrective action; develop and maintain relationships with key vendors.

Administer purchasing policies and procedures in conjunction with Office of Information Technology specific requirements, regulatory guidelines and state and federal laws in order to support business needs; assist with training of staff regarding purchasing and procurement practices and policies.

Develops and applies professional knowledge of the procurement field to include the Georgia Procurement Manual (GPM) and related rules and regulations. Develops an awareness and understanding of legal implications and possible complications. Attends appropriate training.

Obtain/maintain the Georgia Certified Purchasing Associate (GCPA) certification.

Other duties as assigned within the purchasing & procurement team.

Skills/Qualifications:

Able to self-motivate and work with minimal supervision to complete task which require daily follow up and follow through.

Experience using Microsoft Office Suite, PeopleSoft 9.0, Team GA Marketplace e-Procurement.

Experience with electronic data record-keeping, reports, etc.

Effective writing skills.

Strong reading comprehension.

Strong evaluations skills.

Excellent interpersonal skills; customer service focused.

Job Title: Area Business Manager-Allergy Los Angeles, East

Location: Remote, US

Sanofi focuses on developing specialty treatments for debilitating diseases that are often difficult to diagnose and treat, providing hope to patients and their families.

Sanofi has pioneered the development and delivery of transformative therapies for patients affected by rare and debilitating diseases for over 30 years. We accomplish our goals through world-class research, collaboration with the global patient community, and with the compassion and commitment of our employees. With a focus on rare diseases, oncology, immunology and multiple sclerosis, we are dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of the patients and families we serve. Sanofi Genzyme's portfolio of transformative therapies, which are marketed in countries around the world, represent groundbreaking and life-saving advances in medicine.

At Sanofi, we are committed to the growth of our people, connected in purpose by career, life and health.

About the job:

The Area Business Manager (ABM) is responsible for engaging Allergists, and other key customers within an assigned geography and presenting clinically focused selling messages to create and grow revenue and to consistently deliver product goals related to atopic dermatitis and asthma indications. The ABM will demonstrate initiative, drive, independence, and take ownership for meeting and exceeding individual business goals. This will be accomplished by driving performance and delivering results in a compliant manner with a high degree of integrity strictly following all Sanofi Genzyme US policies and in compliance with all policies and procedures governing the promotion of pharmaceutical/biological products in the US.


Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.


About Sanofi:

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

Main Responsibilities:


· Engage Allergy/Immunology customers within assigned geographical territory and deliver clinically focused message to introduce, launch, grow brand-share and revenue and to consistently deliver on product goals for atopic dermatitis and asthma indications.

· Collaborate and coordinate with other key field-based stakeholders such as Regeneron Sales Professional counterparts, Medical Science Liaisons, Field Reimbursement and Market Access teammates, Thought Leader Liaisons, and others in their territory to proactively address customer needs, identify market dynamics and trends, develop strategies which support brand and corporate objectives, and ensure optimal account success within their assigned geography.

· Develop strong working relationships with Allergy experts in assigned geography as well as biologic coordinators, office staff and other important health care personnel and key patient advocacy support groups as directed.

· Drive results by identifying key opportunities and developing strategic business plans to generate product utilization and grow territory business.

· Plan, organize, and execute local promotional speaker programs and activities.

· Maximize budget allocated to the geographic territory to support execution of strategies and tactics and generate/grow the business.

· Participate and help lead initiatives to support sales success as assigned (e.g. participate in industry related congresses, local and regional meetings and medical conferences).

· Own business opportunities within respective geographic area, which includes coordination and calling upon large group practices and other key targets to drive overall product results.

· Establish relationship with thought leaders in assigned territory. Primary objective is to drive industry leading customer value.

About You:

Minimum Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university.
  • 3+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device sales experience or other relevant life science or clinical experience strongly preferred.

Preferred:


  • Demonstrated ability to learn and apply technical and scientific product-related information.
  • Proven success and positive track record of consistent sales performance in complex markets with diverse customer segments operating with a high degree of integrity within compliance guidelines.
  • Ability to operate as a “team player” in cooperation with collaboration partners and internal colleagues to reach common goals.
  • 2+ years selling sub-cutaneous self-injectable (or office administered IV) biologics in a complex and competitive market strongly preferred.
  • 2+ years selling experience calling on Allergists or Dermatologists strongly preferred.
  • Alliance/matrix partnership experience strongly preferred.

Why Choose Us?


• Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

• Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it's through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

• Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

• Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks' gender-neutral parental leave.

Our Newest Opportunity:

Summary:

This role is responsible for managing and growing a book of retirement plan clients while developing the depth of expertise and client ownership that defines a senior consulting career. This position involves designing and implementing retirement plan structures, building trusted plan sponsor relationships, and actively communicating the broader OneDigital value proposition to both prospective and existing clients. This role works with internal service teams to deliver an exceptional client experience and drive long-term retention.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities (includes but is not limited to):


Client Relationship Management & Retention

This role is expected to develop and maintain direct ownership of client relationships, building toward a fully independent book of business.

  • Serve as the relationship owner for an assigned book of clients, building accountability for client satisfaction, retention, and overall relationship health.
  • Develop and execute relationship strategies tailored to each client's goals, plan design, and organizational objectives, with increasing independence over time.
  • Lead or participate in client meetings, strategic reviews, and plan sponsor communications, coordinating with other internal specialists to ensure seamless delivery.
  • Maintain continuity of client relationships through transitions in team structure, plan design, or business conditions.

Plan Consulting & Advisory Services

The degree to which this role personally delivers versus coordinates consulting services will vary based on team structure and market model.

  • Provide retirement plan consulting to clients — including plan design, benchmarking, investment menu analysis, and fiduciary guidance — performing this work directly and/or coordinating delivery through Investment Consultants and other internal specialists as the team model supports.
  • Leverage market, regional, and national resources to support participant education and engagement; coordinate with Employee Engagement Managers for group education delivery and connect participants to Financial Advisors for individual financial planning needs where applicable.
  • Advise clients on regulatory and legislative developments affecting their plans, drawing on internal compliance resources and plan administration specialists to support analysis and recommendations.
  • Facilitate fiduciary training for plan sponsors, leveraging national resources and best-practice frameworks where available.
  • Where applicable, utilize OneDigital's internal retirement plan administration team to support testing, plan amendments, compliance strategies, and other plan administration needs.

Team Coordination & Specialist Leverage

Incumbents are expected to actively develop proficiency in OneDigital's team-based service model, learning to leverage specialists to increase capacity and client impact.

  • Coordinate the activities of the client service team — including Client Relationship Managers, Investment Consultants, Employee Engagement Managers, and Financial Advisors — to deliver a cohesive, high-quality client experience.

  • Build proficiency in OneDigital's team-based service model, actively developing the ability to leverage specialists to increase capacity and client impact.

Compliance & Regulatory Expertise

  • Conduct or coordinate benchmarking due diligence to ensure clients' plans remain competitive and compliant with industry standards.

  • Growing track record of success in retirement plan consulting and/or sales.
  • Strong understanding of ERISA regulations and fiduciary best practices.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work and make decisions independently.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
  • Demonstrated discipline in maintaining client and pipeline information in CRM; Salesforce preferred.
  • Proven success with multitasking and managing priorities effectively.
  • Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing business and technology environment.
  • Continual learner mentality, able to adopt new solutions and interpret the impact of new laws for clients.
  • Must be able to maintain confidentiality of highly sensitive client information, including personnel and financial data.
  • Regular and predictable attendance is required.

  • Must be licensed to allow registration as an IAR of OneDigital Investment Advisors (Series 65 preferred).

Education, Training and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field (preferred), or relevant experience in retirement plan services.
  • Must possess a valid relevant securities license.
  • 5+ years of retirement plan related experience required.
  • 2–5 years of industry-related sales or consulting experience preferred.
