raw.excerpt: About CogstateAt Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
raw.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- MADRS Administration Experience Required
- Dutch Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD, DO, MBBS or PhD, PsyD in Psychology or RN, APRN, PA, MA/MS/MSW in Psychiatry (or equivalent)
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Dutch Fluency
  • MADRS Administration Experience Required

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

The Senior Risk Management Professional supports the effective intake, assessment, and implementation of Medicare and PBM pharmacy regulatory guidance. Partners with key stakeholders to promote timely implementation, appropriate risk management, and ongoing compliance with applicable requirements.

Validates high-ranked and major implementations for completeness and readiness and manages Risk Acceptances for identified gaps or residual risks. Partners with key stakeholders to ensure guidance is implemented accurately, documented appropriately, and completed within required timelines.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional implementations, projects, or initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.

raw.description:
About the job

The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

  • Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

  • Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

  • Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

  • Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You

You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

About Us

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

About the Role

As a Tax Staff Accountant supporting the Accounting team, you will own aspects of tax-related accounting activities ranging from reviewing sales tax exemption certificates, compiling data required for various tax & compliance filings, and helping to reconcile tax-related accounts. The ideal candidate has excellent problem-solving and communication skills and enjoys working in a challenging and complex environment. In this role, you will:

  • Review incoming sales tax exemption and resale certificates from customers for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with state-specific requirements.
  • Follow up with customers and internal teams to obtain missing, expired, or deficient certificates.
  • Research and resolve sales tax exemption-related inquiries from customers & internal team members.
  • Support sales tax audits by assembling certificates and supporting documentation for state auditors.
  • Assist with tax-related requests from internal and external sources, investigating issues and following up on deliverables.
  • Provide outside consultants with the financial information needed to prepare and file various tax and business returns.
  • Contribute to the efficiency of the accounting team by participating in cross-training, sharing job responsibilities, and serving as position backup for other team members.
  • Document policies, procedures and workflows for assigned areas of responsibility.
  • Develop and implement process improvement initiatives, to reduce errors, improve efficiency, remove redundancy, expedite reporting and enhancing business reporting initiatives.

Who You Are:

You are an experienced staff accountant who loves being hands-on and digging into the details. You get excited about problem-solving and improving processes and procedures. You love numbers and understand the complexities of various types of taxes. You enjoy being part of a team that works together to support the continued success of the company as a whole.


  • A proven background in tax accounting encouraged but not required.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP.
  • Minimum of 1 years’ accounting experience.
  • Familiarity with Avalara is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to work well in a team-oriented and intensely deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to relate and communicate effectively across all levels of staff inside and outside the department.
  • Ability to prioritize projects, quickly determine the requirements to accomplish them, and analyze the processes to figure out how to simplify, automate and improve them for increased efficiency.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information and a sense of strong business ethics.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to interpret documentation against regulatory requirements.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (lookups, pivot tables, data validation)

At this time, we are unable to consider candidates who require current or future sponsorship for employment authorization.


Our Culture

At Bonterra, we’re innovating with a higher purpose: to increase giving to 3% of US GDP by 2033, creating $573 billion more in global impact every year. At Bonterra, we foster an inclusive, equitable culture where every team member belongs and contributes to meaningful impact. Read more about our values and culture here.


Compensation & Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, well-being and growth - explore full details here.


Compensation and benefits for this U.S. role apply to regular full-time and part-time employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours a week. Pay reflects location, skills, experience, and education, and is one part of Bonterra’s total rewards package, which may include bonuses, incentives, and equity. Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with employer-subsidized premiums, unlimited Flexible Time Off (FTO), paid holidays, and dedicated time off to volunteer. All regular and part-time employees are eligible for the Bonterra 401(k) plan with a 3% company match.

Application Period: Open until November 27, 2026
Location: Philippines (Remote/Home-Based)

Travel: Approximately 30-40%


At Compassion, stories help connect people to the impact of releasing children from poverty in Jesus' name.


We're looking for a Multimedia Field Producer who can uncover and tell those stories through compelling photography, short-form video, and authentic relationship-building. Working alongside local churches, program teams, and children and families in the Philippines, you'll identify story opportunities, capture meaningful moments, and create content that supports global marketing, fundraising, and engagement efforts.


What You'll Do

  • Capture high-quality photography and short-form video content in the field.
  • Identify, develop, and pitch story ideas aligned with ministry and marketing priorities.
  • Build strong relationships with church partners, program staff, and communities.
  • Produce content that supports digital campaigns, fundraising initiatives, and supporter engagement.
  • Conduct interviews and appear on camera when needed.
  • Handle sensitive stories with dignity while upholding Compassion's child protection standards.

Who We're Looking For


We're less concerned with finding someone who knows every production tool and more interested in finding someone who is a skilled storyteller, a strong collaborator, and a great fit for the team.


You may be a great fit if you have:

  • Strong photography skills and a keen visual eye.
  • Experience creating visual content for digital platforms.
  • The ability to identify, develop, and pitch compelling story ideas.
  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills.
  • Confidence conducting interviews and appearing on camera when needed.
  • A collaborative mindset, with a willingness to learn and contribute to the growth of others.
  • The ability to work independently in field environments.
  • Willingness to travel throughout the Philippines approximately 30-40% of the time.

Experience in nonprofit, ministry, fundraising, marketing, or community development environments is an advantage, but not required.


Why Compassion?

This is an opportunity to combine creativity, ministry, and impact. You'll help tell stories that inspire action, strengthen connections with supporters, and help release children from poverty in Jesus' name.


Please submit your CV and portfolio with your application.

Senior Support Network Engineer – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Support Network Engineer to support and maintain ISP and fixed wireless network infrastructure while delivering exceptional technical support to U.S.-based B2B customers.

This is a customer-facing role requiring strong networking expertise, excellent communication skills, and hands-on experience with wireless networking technologies, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting. You’ll play a key role in maintaining high network availability, resolving technical issues, and supporting mission-critical connectivity solutions.

What You’ll Do

Network Operations & Support

  • Provide technical support to U.S.-based B2B customers.
  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot MikroTik and Cisco routers and switches across core and edge ISP networks.
  • Monitor network performance, resolve outages, and ensure high network availability.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex network issues in a timely manner.

Fixed Wireless Infrastructure

  • Plan, deploy, and troubleshoot Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) infrastructure.
  • Support Point-to-Point (PTP) and Point-to-Multipoint (PTMP) wireless links.
  • Work with wireless platforms including:
    • Cambium
    • Ubiquiti / UniFi
    • Aviat
    • Siklu / Ceragon
  • Support fixed wireless, managed Wi-Fi, Starlink, and wireless mesh/backhaul solutions.

Routing & Network Management

  • Implement and maintain dynamic routing protocols, including:
    • OSPF
    • BGP
  • Maintain reliable routing across ISP network infrastructure.
  • Support network performance optimization and stability.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Flawless written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Previous experience in customer-facing technical support roles.
  • Hands-on experience with fixed wireless/WISP technologies, including:
    • Starlink
    • Managed Wi-Fi
    • Cambium
    • Ubiquiti / UniFi
    • Siklu / Ceragon
  • Strong experience configuring and troubleshooting MikroTik and Cisco networking equipment.
  • Experience implementing and supporting OSPF and BGP.
  • Experience deploying and troubleshooting PTP and PTMP wireless networks.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud networking in AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar platforms.
  • ITSM experience, preferably with Salesforce.
  • Experience with:
    • Starlink
    • 4G/5G networking
    • Peplink SD-WAN
  • Network certifications such as:
    • CCNA
    • Network+
    • Equivalent certifications

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Monitor network health and respond to customer support requests.
  • Troubleshoot routing, switching, and wireless connectivity issues.
  • Configure and maintain MikroTik and Cisco network devices.
  • Support fixed wireless infrastructure and resolve outages.
  • Work directly with customers to diagnose and resolve technical issues.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to maintain reliable network operations.

In short: You’ll support, troubleshoot, and optimize ISP and fixed wireless network infrastructure while delivering exceptional technical support to B2B customers.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Technical Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your networking experience, and highlight your expertise with fixed wireless technologies, MikroTik, Cisco, routing protocols, and customer support. Your video will be reviewed before moving forward in the interview process.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about networking, wireless infrastructure, and delivering outstanding customer support, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and join a team dedicated to building and maintaining reliable network solutions.

raw.description:
Fourth is the world’s largest and fastest-growing global leader of end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management technology solutions. We pride ourselves on delivering a world-class SaaS experience for our clients by building long-term partnerships starting from the first phone call. We know our recipe for success at Fourth is our amazing team... and that starts with hiring the right people!

Interested in joining our smart, fun, and talented team?

Position Overview

Independent and small multi-unit restaurants run their restaurants on HotSchedules. This role makes sure they get value fast, use more of what they already own, and become fanatical advocates of our product.

You will own adoption and retention marketing for our SMB base, from first week to fifth year, as a joint plan with our Customer Success and Customer Care teams, and you will share the product adoption target with Customer Success. In SMB, retention is won at scale, so you will build programs that run without a person on every account.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Onboarding and adoption. In-app messaging, lifecycle email and journeys, built with Product, that get new customers live and using the modules that predict they stay.

  • Retention programs. Save and win-back plays, renewal communications and at-risk outreach, built with Customer Success and Customer Care on shared data.

  • Customer contact calendar. Own the calendar of every marketing touch to customers, so they hear from us at the right moments. You decide which customers get asked for reviews, references or new products, and when.

  • Customer communications. Product updates, release notes and the customer newsletter, written for a busy owner on a phone between shifts.

  • Customer voice. Regular surveys and NPS, with themes routed to Product, Customer Success and Product Marketing.

You will work closely with our two demand generation managers. One runs reviews, referrals and case studies to win new customers; the other owns cross-sell and up-sell pipeline. You own adoption, retention and the customer calendar that keeps all of it coordinated.


Key Skills and Competencies

  • 4+ years in B2B customer marketing, lifecycle marketing or retention, ideally with SMB or high-volume customer bases.

  • Hands-on with marketing automation and in-app messaging tools, and comfortable building journeys yourself.

  • Strong, plain-spoken writing for non-technical owners and managers.

  • Comfort with data: you can pull a cohort, read a churn curve and explain what changed.

  • A builder mindset. Some of these programs do not exist yet.

Preferred Experience and/or Qualifications

  • Restaurant or hospitality experience, either working in one or marketing to them.

  • Experience driving feature adoption in a multi-product SaaS customer base.

  • Experience with Braze or similar customer engagement platforms.

  • Experience with fintech or payroll products used by hourly workers.

Measures of Success

Your first 90 days

  1. Map the current SMB customer journey and every message a customer gets in year one. Kill what does not help.

  1. Launch an adoption journey for one module customers underuse, with a measured baseline.

  1. Agree retention and adoption targets with Customer Success and Customer Care, stand up the customer contact calendar, and set up a monthly reporting rhythm.

What success looks like at 12 months

  • Product adoption at target, shared with Customer Success, with measurable gains in the cohorts your programs touch.

  • Lower early-life churn and better gross retention in those cohorts.

  • One customer calendar every team uses, with fewer, better-timed customer touches.

Fourth Benefits

🏖 Unlimited PTO!

🏥 Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance!

🏦 401k Match!

👥 Parental Leave

💻 Laptop and equipment.

Remote employment limited to: AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MS, NC, NE, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, & WA


Our Story

In July 2019, Fourth joined forces with HotSchedules to become the global leader in end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management technology solutions. Together, the merged company now represents the world’s largest and only provider of end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management solutions for customers across the globe and of all sizes—from a single location or franchisee restaurant to a global restaurant or hotel chain. The combined company’s complete software-as-service (SaaS) solution suite, including scheduling, time & attendance, applicant tracking, training, inventory management/procurement, HR/benefits, and payroll services, now serves customers in 120,000 locations worldwide and is supported by a dedicated, unified team across offices in the US, UK, Bulgaria, China, Australia, and UAE.

***AWARD PENDING***

Zen Strategics, a Titan Technologies company, is seeking an RMF Quality Gate Analyst to support TSA's Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) mission. The position will assist in safeguarding the availability, integrity, and confidentiality of information systems through cybersecurity governance, risk management, security assessment, and compliance activities that support TSA's Information Assurance and Cybersecurity Division.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Conduct quality gate reviews for RMF activities and provide compliance recommendations to support authorization and risk management efforts.
  • Review RMF documentation, security artifacts, and supporting system records to ensure completeness, accuracy, and alignment with established requirements.
  • Analyze security, privacy, and compliance-related documentation and provide recommendations to stakeholders regarding findings, risks, and required updates.
  • Review Requests for Change (RFCs), Security Impact Assessments (SIAs), and proposed system changes to evaluate potential cybersecurity impacts.
  • Support the development, review, and improvement of Security Authorization (SA) and Ongoing Authorization (OA) procedures and processes.
  • Assess emerging technologies, technical implementations, and system designs for compliance with cybersecurity requirements and federal mandates.
  • Support security control assessment activities and standardized processes used to evaluate control effectiveness and compliance.
  • Review network and technical assessment information and collaborate with stakeholders to support cybersecurity risk evaluations.
  • Analyze scan results and assessment data to support compliance monitoring and reporting activities.
  • Document meeting outcomes, recommendations, findings, decisions, and follow-up actions.

You MUST have:

  • Active Secret clearance required; Must be able to obtain TSA clearance
  • Knowledge of the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), cybersecurity compliance, and risk management principles.
  • Experience reviewing and validating RMF artifacts, security documentation, and authorization-related deliverables.
  • Experience conducting compliance reviews, risk assessments, and security control evaluations.
  • Ability to analyze technical, security, and governance documentation and provide risk-based recommendations.
  • Experience supporting authorization activities, change reviews, and cybersecurity compliance efforts.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

It’s GREAT if you also have:

  • Familiarity with Security Authorization (SA) and Ongoing Authorization (OA) processes.
  • Knowledge of NIST Special Publications 800-30, 800-37, and 800-53A.
  • Experience reviewing security plans, contingency plans, configuration management documentation, privacy artifacts, and related RMF deliverables.
  • Familiarity with FISMA compliance activities and cybersecurity assessment processes.
  • Experience evaluating technical designs, implementation approaches, and security architectures for compliance purposes.
  • Knowledge of network assessment activities and technical risk analysis.

Education:

  • BA/BS degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related discipline

Company Description:

Titan Technologies, LLC and our wholly owned subsidiaries, TelaForce, LLC, Titan Facilities, Inc. and Zen Strategics, design, build, integrate, and manage innovative solutions and software applications. Our remarkable people, working collaboratively under a shared vision, have earned a reputation with our customers for delivering results with maximum impact. Sound intriguing? Consider Titan Technologies for the next step in your career journey and be part of an impactful team!

Titan is proud to be a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Business.

Recognized as a KLAS® Top Performer, GeBBS combines innovative technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to excellence to deliver measurable results for clients across the healthcare industry. We are dedicated to being a trusted healthcare partner by upholding the highest standards of quality, information security, and compliance.

At GeBBS, we foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture where employees are empowered to develop their skills, advance their careers, and make a meaningful impact in transforming healthcare.

Description

GeBBS Healthcare Solutions, an industry leader in Health Information Management (HIM) and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) solutions, is seeking highly motivated individuals with a passion for excellence & collaboration, for careers in the healthcare industry. We are looking for a part-time Inpatient Facility Coder (with swing bed experience). This is a remote W-2 position with flexible work schedules.

This position will be responsible for medical coding for one of facility clients. Coder will be responsible for reviewing charts, coding appropriate charges and ensuring high quality standards are achieved.

  • The Inpatient Coder is responsible for assigning diagnostic and procedural codes to patient charts using ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS or any other designated coding classification system in accordance with coding rules and regulations. The coder will abstract required clinical information. This position requires a thorough knowledge of medical terminology, disease processes, pharmacology, Medicare’s Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS), Official Coding Guidelines for ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS codes, and documentation requirements for correct and accurate coding.
  • Experience with trauma and highly complex cases, orthopedic, and cardiology preferred

Requirements

Requirements

  • RHIA, RHIT, CCS certification through AHIMA required
  • Minimum 3 years inpatient coding experience in facility setting (recent)
  • Experience coding Swing beds.
  • Maintain standard industry productivity rates for Inpatient coding (3 charts/hour)
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain high quality standards of 95% or greater
  • Proficient in utilizing technology (computer, VPN, MS Office, coding software) to perform responsibilities
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Must have ICD-10 coding experience and have completed an ICD-10 course

Job Description:

GDIT is looking for a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our National Institutes of Health (NIH)CIT Hosting and Storage Services Program.


We are seeking a collaborative and technically curious cloud engineer who can help design, automate, and deliver secure, reliable, and scalable cloud infrastructure solutions across AWS and Azure. Our ideal candidate combines hands-on cloud and infrastructure experience with a strong automation mindset and an interest in solving customer challenges. As a member of our Cloud DevOps team, this engineer will contribute to the development of standardized cloud infrastructure services and reusable automation while also supporting custom solutions for customers with unique application and data hosting requirements. The successful candidate will independently deliver well-defined engineering solutions, collaborate with senior engineers on more complex designs, and work with customers and team members to translate requirements into effective cloud solutions. They will apply sound engineering practices with consideration for security, scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and operational efficiency.


Location: 100% remote


This role will require you to obtain and maintain a Public Trust and will require you to provide onsite fingerprinting at a designated facility.  This investigation may review personal and criminal behavior, financial conduct, foreign influence, as well as other adjudications.


Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and support secure, reliable, and scalable cloud infrastructure solutions in AWS and Azure for hosting applications and data, working with customers and engineers to understand requirements and deliver appropriate solutions.
  • Develop and enhance standardized, reusable cloud infrastructure services and automation using Terraform, Ansible, and related technologies, contributing to shared modules and enterprise code repositories.
  • Configure and integrate cloud compute, storage, database, identity, networking, security, monitoring, backup, and related services to support application hosting requirements.
  • Develop and support automation and CI/CD capabilities that streamline infrastructure provisioning and application deployments, reduce manual effort, and improve reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, operating system, automation, application hosting, and cloud integration issues, collaborating across engineering disciplines to drive problems through resolution.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, implementation procedures, and security and compliance artifacts necessary to support cloud services and maintain authorization.
  • Participate in Agile activities, technical design discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement efforts that enhance engineering practices, service delivery, and the customer experience.

Required Qualifications:

  • BS/BA in Information Technology or related field and 2+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience engineering and supporting cloud or enterprise infrastructure solutions within a professional IT environment.
  • Experience independently implementing well-defined technical solutions while collaborating with senior engineers on larger or more complex designs and initiatives.
  • Experience working collaboratively with technical teams, customers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver technical solutions.

Required Skillsets and Experience:

  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, including compute, storage, databases, networking, identity and access management, security, monitoring, and related cloud platform services.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, and automation using technologies such as Terraform and Ansible, including developing or modifying reusable modules and working within shared, Git-managed codebases.
  • Working knowledge of Windows and Linux systems administration and supporting technologies, including patching, monitoring, certificate management, data protection, backup, and application hosting.
  • Working knowledge of cloud networking and security concepts, including virtual networks/VPCs, load balancing, VPNs, firewalls, IAM/RBAC, encryption, and secure connectivity.
  • Experience with CI/CD and scripting or automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies to automate infrastructure provisioning, deployment, and operational activities.
  • Experience using cloud-native monitoring and logging capabilities to troubleshoot issues spanning cloud infrastructure, operating systems, networking, automation, and application hosting.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and analytical skills, with experience working within Agile and DevOps practices and the ability to communicate technical solutions, issues, and recommendations to customers and other engineers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 4+ years experience preferred, in related field
  • AWS Certified; Experience supporting application hosting architectures, cloud migrations, or custom cloud solutions and working directly with customers to understand and implement their technical requirements.
  • Experience with cloud-native, containerized, or data-intensive workloads and technologies supporting modern application deployment and operations.
  • Relevant AWS, Microsoft Azure, Terraform, DevOps, or infrastructure certifications, and experience supporting technology solutions within federal government, healthcare, life sciences, or similarly regulated environments.

Bilingual Dispatcher (Uzbek and English)

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and communicative Bilingual Dispatcher fluent in Uzbekistan and English to coordinate daily operations, manage schedules, and ensure efficient communication between clients, drivers, and internal teams. The ideal candidate will possess strong multitasking skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and dispatch drivers or service personnel according to schedules and client requirements.
  • Communicate clearly in both Uzbek and English to relay instructions, updates, and route information.
  • Monitor ongoing operations to ensure timely service delivery and resolve any logistical issues.
  • Maintain accurate records of dispatch activities, schedules, and client communications.
  • Provide real-time support and updates to management and field teams.
  • Handle incoming calls, emails, and messages professionally and efficiently.
  • Prepare daily and weekly reports on dispatch performance and service outcomes.
  • Collaborate with other departments to optimize workflow and resource allocation.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Communications, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in dispatching, coordination, or customer service roles.

Skills & Competencies

  • Fluency in both Uzbek and English (spoken and written) is required.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and dispatch management software.
  • Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience in logistics, transportation, or service coordination.
  • Strong sense of responsibility and reliability.
  • Ability to adapt to different time zones and operational demands.

Windows Team Lead Engineer

Wilmington, DE

Remote

This group is responsible for supporting the Windows Server compute elements consumed by the enterprise both on premise and in the cloud including the design, delivery and management of the infrastructure. The team is involved in cloud services, domain services, DFS namespace and managing the full Windows Server product life cycle globally. The team leverages automation with MECM, Azure DevOps, PowerShell Universal and Ansible.

Some of the things you will be doing:

  • Providing technical leadership for Expert Engineers based in North America.
  • Manage engineers by creating and maintaining goals, performance reviews and delegating project tasks and operational incidents and requests.
  • Manage and support on premise and Azure based compute infrastructure.
  • Collaborating with global infrastructure team leads and engineers, project managers, and internal customers.
  • Participate and lead projects related to our team as required, balance engineering resource management.
  • Validate and approve change requests related to team efforts.
  • Delegate routine operational tasks, customer requests and incidents and ensure SLAs are met.
  • Lead the team to follow policies and procedures for time tracking, security, change control, problem / root cause analysis investigations and incident management.
  • Guide the team for efficient security vulnerability remediation.
  • Act as the escalation point for the engineers that participate in the 24x7 On-Call rotation and planned maintenance activities after hours and on weekends when necessary.
  • Govern P1 / P2 escalations related to our team and products that we own.
  • Champion new ideas and strategies to drive forward continued transformation of the team.
  • Develop and maintain ongoing roadmaps for Run, Grow and Transform level initiatives.
  • Work with teams to proactively plan and reduce technical debt to avoid security risks.
  • Submit project demands related to our key initiatives and represent them in project intake.
  • Manage Windows Server for Microsoft licensing renewals and true ups, including ESU (extended security updates) for supporting technical debt.
  • Celebrate team milestones with recognition.

What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent industry experience
  • 10+ years of experience in Infrastructure & Operations
  • 7-10+ years of Microsoft Windows Server experience
  • 3-5 years of experience as a technical lead with peer mentorship
  • High level of collaboration, communication, and critical thinking
  • Ability to build a ring of influence with peers and customers
  • Need working technical, communication and business knowledge of the following items:
  • Cloud experience – Microsoft Azure or Amazon AWS, compute, hybrid architecture with on prem and cloud, migration of applications to cloud
  • Automation of Infrastructure (Ansible, PowerShell, Azure DevOps) - Workflow orchestration, Server builds, Cloud components and post deployment configurations
  • Scripting with PowerShell, Python or YAML
  • Active Directory, Group Policy and general Windows Server Infrastructure in a multi domain environment
  • Virtual servers – Nutanix AHV hypervisor and Azure Portal based Windows Servers
  • Working knowledge of MECM/SCCM using ADR’s (automatic deployment rules) required.
  • Assist or lead troubleshooting escalated problems related to Windows infrastructure services.
  • Hypervisor experience for virtual machines running a variety of Windows Server OS.
  • Perform technical writing of policies, procedures and configuration of systems by authoring, updating and maintaining all related documentation.
  • Candidate must be a team player but also should be able to work independently and think creatively to work past obstacles and roadblocks.

Experience and skills preferred:

  • ServiceNow
  • ITIL \ DevOps philosophies
  • Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity
  • OSD using MECM/SCCM
  • Nutanix AHV Hypervisor
  • GitHub - Source code management and version control
  • Container technology such as Red Hat OpenShift or Kubernetes

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

About the Team:

We build the shared ML and AI capabilities that power experiences across our consumer products. Our work spans the platform that enables teams to develop, evaluate, and deploy models, and the intelligence that helps those models understand content, people, and communities. We partner with consumer product teams and infrastructure engineering to turn advances in ML and AI into reusable capabilities that improve discovery, personalization, and other consumer experiences.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a senior individual contributor to lead product strategy across ML Platform and ML Understanding. Reporting to Consumer product leadership, you’ll shape the foundations that help teams build better products: from reliable, efficient model development and deployment to richer classifications and representations of content and users.

This role combines technical depth, consumer product judgment, and organizational influence. You’ll connect needs across applications, identify the investments with the greatest shared value, and align product and engineering leaders around a coherent strategy with measurable outcomes.

What You'll Do:

  • Set the strategy for shared AI foundations. Define a multiyear vision and prioritized roadmap spanning ML platform capabilities and content and user understanding.
  • Connect foundational investments to consumer outcomes. Translate needs across recommendations, search, discovery, and emerging AI experiences into clear requirements and investment priorities.
  • Advance content and user understanding. Guide investments in classification, taxonomies, embeddings, multimodal understanding, and representations of user interests and intent.
  • Improve the ML development lifecycle. Partner with engineering on capabilities for data and feature access, training, inference, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Make shared capabilities useful and widely adopted. Establish clear interfaces, onboarding paths, and feedback mechanisms that help application teams build on common foundations.
  • Lead investment and technical tradeoffs. Align senior partners on sequencing, dependencies, and decisions involving model quality, flexibility, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Define and demonstrate success. Measure platform adoption, development velocity, model and representation quality, operational efficiency, and downstream improvements in consumer experiences.

What We're Looking For:

  • A track record of leading complex ML or AI products, with experience in shared platforms, recommendation systems, search, or related technical domains.
  • Strong technical fluency across the ML lifecycle and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and applied science partners on architecture and investment decisions.
  • Experience with content understanding, classification, embeddings, or user representations, and an understanding of how their quality affects consumer products.
  • Product judgment that connects foundational capabilities to concrete user needs, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish direction across multiple teams, resolve competing priorities, and influence senior leaders without direct authority.
  • Comfort defining strategy in ambiguous spaces while maintaining clear priorities, credible execution plans, and accountability for outcomes.
  • Sound judgment about evaluation, data quality, privacy, and the responsible use of content and user signals.

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit .

$260,800—$365,100 USD

Parexel FSP is seeking Regulatory Affairs Associates to join our Team in Brazil. This is a sponsor dedicated role. Candidates should have at least 2-3 years of experience and advanced/fluent english.


About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights‑driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient‑focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.


About the Role

The Regulatory Affairs Associate supports local regulatory activities related to market authorizations (MAA), product registrations, and control changes in Brazil. The role ensures compliance with ANVISA requirements by preparing submissions, maintaining regulatory records, and supporting product lifecycle management at the affiliate level.

Key Accountabilities:

Regulatory Submissions and Lifecycle Management

  • Support preparation and coordination of local regulatory submissions, including MAAs and control changes, in accordance with ANVISA requirements
  • Track and monitor the status of submitted regulatory activities with local health authorities
  • Assist in preparing module 1 documentation and other country-specific submission components

Regulatory Compliance and Intelligence

  • Monitor ANVISA regulatory updates and communicate relevant changes to internal teams
  • Support audit and inspection readiness activities and assist with timely CAPA closure
  • Assist in interpreting local regulations and regulatory agency expectations

Labeling and Promotional Materials

  • Support labeling updates including SmPC, PIL, and packaging in line with local requirements
  • Assist in the review of promotional materials against applicable regulations and approved labeling

Regulatory Systems and Reporting

  • Maintain and update Veeva Vault with accurate local regulatory activity and submission data
  • Support tracking of compliance KPIs and regulatory milestones

Skills

  • Knowledge of ANVISA regulations and Brazilian regulatory submission processes
  • Experience with Veeva Vault or similar regulatory management systems
  • Proficiency in MS Office suite
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Portuguese
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in documentation
  • Good organizational and time management skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional environment

Knowledge and Experience

  • 2 to 3 years of regulatory affairs experience with direct exposure to ANVISA and Brazilian regulatory requirements
  • Experience supporting MAAs and/or control changes
  • Familiarity with labeling requirements and submission documentation standards
  • Experience with Veeva Vault preferred

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in natural sciences, pharmacy, biology, chemistry, or a related field
  • Advanced degree is a plus
  • Regulatory Affairs certification is advantageous (e.g., RAC or equivalent)

raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As Customer Value Consultant, you will be the primary post-sales owner for customer success, helping customers realize measurable business value from their investment in Tricentis. This role exists to strengthen customer outcomes, increase adoption, reduce renewal risk, and support sustainable growth across Direct-Led, Co-Sell, and Opportunistic customer segments.


You will own the Customer Success Plan, build trusted relationships from operational stakeholders through VP and C-level sponsors, and orchestrate the Tricentis and partner resources needed to move customer outcomes forward. Success is measured through customer value realization, adoption, portfolio health, retention performance, executive alignment, and the expansion opportunities that follow demonstrated value.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Own the Customer Success Plan for each customer, defining outcomes, milestones, and accountable actions that connect adoption to measurable business value.
  • Drive value realization by evidencing progress against agreed outcomes and translating adoption and utilization data into credible ROI narratives.
  • Lead Executive Business Reviews and build relationships across the customer organization that connect realized value to future priorities.
  • Manage the transition from go-live into ongoing adoption, agreeing success criteria early and intervening promptly when early milestones slip.
  • Maintain a holistic view of customer health across adoption, utilization, technical health, support experience, and commercial standing.
  • Identify renewal risks early, flagging material risk at least 120 days out with a documented mitigation plan, clear owners, and escalation paths.
  • Partner across Account Executives, Renewals, Technical, Support, Advisory, Professional Services, Product, and partners to create one coordinated customer experience.
  • Spot and qualify expansion signals based on demonstrated value, whitespace, and adoption maturity, and hand them to the Account Executive with a clear value rationale.
  • Feed customer product feedback and unmet needs back into the business through the right channels.

CHALLENGES YOU'LL HELP SOLVE

  • Convert technology adoption into measurable business outcomes and credible executive value narratives.
  • Apply the right depth of engagement across a portfolio that varies by value, complexity, risk, and segment.
  • Surface and address adoption gaps and stakeholder changes early enough to protect renewals and trusted relationships.
  • Connect retention priorities and expansion opportunities so that growth follows demonstrated value.
  • Align internal teams and partner organizations around shared customer outcomes, clear ownership, and clean handoffs, while respecting partner delivery boundaries on Co-Sell accounts.

SKILLS FOR SUCCESS


Required Skills

  • Customer success and value realization: Demonstrated success improving adoption, demonstrating customer value, and managing a portfolio of recurring-revenue customers, typically across 5 to 8+ years in Customer Success, Value Consulting, Account Management, Technical Account Management, or a comparable enterprise SaaS post-sales role.
  • Executive stakeholder engagement: Executive presence and proven ability to establish credibility and lead outcome-focused conversations with VP and C-level stakeholders.
  • Value and ROI storytelling: Ability to translate technology adoption into business outcomes, executive value narratives, and credible investment cases built from customer evidence.
  • Retention and risk management: Experience identifying customer risk, building mitigation and recovery plans, and supporting customers through critical escalations.
  • Commercial acumen: Understanding recurring-revenue models, retention drivers, renewal risk, and expansion signals.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Ability to align Sales, Technical, Support, Services, Product, Renewals, and partners without direct authority.
  • Product and technical fluency: Enough product knowledge to connect customer goals to Tricentis capabilities and resolve common first-line questions, engaging credibly with business and technical stakeholders without becoming the delivery resource.
  • Execution and data-driven prioritization: Disciplined in maintaining success plans, risk visibility, commitments, and next steps, using health indicators, adoption metrics, and judgment to focus where impact is greatest.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in software testing, quality assurance, or a related technology domain.
  • Experience supporting strategic enterprise customers in a SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with executive business reviews, customer success planning, and value realization methodologies.
  • Experience with partner-led or co-sell customer engagement models.
  • Comfort constructively challenging customers and stakeholders where decisions are limiting outcomes.

SUCCESS IN YOUR FIRST YEAR


First 90 Days

  • Build trusted relationships with your Account Executives, cross-functional partners, and key customer contacts.
  • Assess your portfolio's health, adoption status, and renewal timeline, and build or refresh Customer Success Plans for priority accounts.
  • Establish a clear success cadence and engagement approach appropriate to each segment.

Six Months

  • Keep Customer Success Plans current, outcome-based, and actively used to manage customer progress.
  • Surface material renewal risks at least 120 days out with documented mitigation plans, owners, and escalation paths.
  • Complete required executive engagements and document alignment on priorities, value, and next actions.

Twelve Months

  • Deliver measurable progress against customer outcomes, adoption milestones, and portfolio health targets.
  • Achieve or exceed the applicable Gross Revenue Retention target, minimizing preventable churn through proactive intervention.
  • Consistently identify and transfer qualified expansion signals, with health, risks, and commitments accurately maintained in designated systems.

raw.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Make a meaningful regulatory impact

At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures. We support clients to navigate complex regulatory pathways for health products including prescription and non-prescription drugs (small molecule and biologics), medical devices, natural health products (NHPs), and cosmetics so that important therapies can reach the people who need them.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Regulatory Affairs with a clinical focus to provide strategic, client-facing regulatory consulting across the health product lifecycle. In this role, you will lead complex regulatory projects, shape practical regulatory strategies, and act as a trusted partner to clients, Regulatory Authorities (Health Canada and U.S. FDA) and cross-functional colleagues.

This is an opportunity for a regulatory professional who combines technical knowledge with sound commercial judgement, confident client leadership and a practical approach to solving complex problems.


What you’ll do

As Senior Manager, Regulatory Affairs, you will:

  • Lead and manage regulatory strategy and consulting engagements for life sciences clients.
  • Direct the planning, preparation, review and maintenance of regulatory submissions and associated documentation, including as applicable:
    • Clinical Trial Applications (CTAs)
    • Investigational New Drug applications (INDs)
    • New Drug Submissions (NDSs)
    • New Drug Applications (NDAs) and supplements
    • Product Licence Applications (PLAs)
    • DIN Submissions
    • Regulatory responses, amendments and post-approval activities
  • Lead due diligence reviews
  • Develop product labeling
  • Support product launch planning and advertising/promotional material review
  • Serve as a principal point of contact for assigned clients and support productive interactions with Regulatory Authorities.
  • Lead or support agency meetings, develop briefing materials and provide strategic recommendations on emerging regulatory issues.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to integrate regulatory strategy with development, quality, clinical, medical, commercial and business objectives.
  • Interpret evolving regulatory requirements and translate regulatory intelligence into clear, actionable guidance for clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple projects to agreed scope, timelines, budgets and quality expectations.
  • Identify and resolve regulatory risks, issues and competing priorities using sound judgement and a solutions-focused approach.
  • Ensure deliverables meet applicable client requirements, standard operating procedures and quality expectations, while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to the growth of the practice by supporting proposals, presentations, new-business discussions and development of client relationships.
  • Share expertise through internal training, mentoring, industry presentations, publications or webinars.
  • Manages decision-making and conflict resolution surrounding regulatory issues for assigned projects and within their team
  • Participate in professional activities such as offering industry training, conference presentations, publications and webinars as applicable
  • Engage in continuous learning in order to provide effective consulting services and train/coach colleagues.
  • Other duties as assigned

What you’ll bring

Required qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a life-sciences discipline; an advanced degree in a relevant scientific or regulatory field is preferred.
  • 5–8 years of direct regulatory affairs experience across the health product lifecycle
  • Clinical research or regulatory consulting experience preferred
  • Demonstrated experience developing pre-market submissions and managing product lifecycle submissions/post-market changes
  • Strong working knowledge of Canadian regulatory requirements and Health Canada processes, with familiarity with relevant ICH requirements. Experience with FDA, EMA and other international regulatory environments is an asset.
  • Experience managing or supporting interactions with Regulatory Authorities.
  • Proven ability to lead several concurrent client projects while managing timelines, scope, quality and budget considerations.
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical judgement and problem-solving capability.
  • Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex regulatory issues clearly to varied audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with clients and collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong business acumen and an interest in contributing to proposals, client development and practice growth.
  • French-English bilingualism preferred, written and spoken.
  • Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) and prior people-leadership or consulting experience are assets.

What will help you succeed

You will thrive in this role if you are someone who:

  • Enjoys translating complex regulatory requirements into practical paths forward.
  • Balances scientific and regulatory rigour with client, patient and business needs.
  • Is comfortable taking ownership of client relationships and senior-level conversations.
  • Brings calm, structure and sound judgement to ambiguous or time-sensitive regulatory challenges.
  • Is motivated by continuous learning and sharing expertise with colleagues and clients.

Why join Cencora?

You will join a purpose-driven organisation working to create healthier futures. In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Influence regulatory strategy on a diverse range of client and product-development challenges.
  • Work with experienced regulatory, scientific and commercial colleagues in a collaborative environment.
  • Build your consulting, leadership and business-development capability alongside your regulatory expertise.
  • Contribute to work that supports access to therapies and healthcare products.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more.

Full time

Equal Employment Opportunity

Cencora is committed to providing equal employment opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or membership in any other class protected by federal, state or local law.

The company’s continued success depends on the full and effective utilization of qualified individuals. Therefore, harassment is prohibited and all matters related to recruiting, training, compensation, benefits, promotions and transfers comply with equal opportunity principles and are non-discriminatory.

Cencora is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities during the employment process which are consistent with legal requirements. If you wish to request an accommodation while seeking employment, please call 888.692.2272 or email . We will make accommodation determinations on a request-by-request basis. Messages and emails regarding anything other than accommodations requests will not be returned

Accessibility Policy

AmerisourceBergen is committed to fair and accessible employment practices. When requested, AmerisourceBergen will accommodate people with disabilities during the recruitment, assessment and hiring processes and during employment.

About Pilotbase:

Aviation has a remarkable future ahead of it. The systems that support pilots and the businesses developing them have not always kept pace. Pilotbase is working to change that. We're bringing together aviation's most trusted software brands, including Flight Schedule Pro and LogTen, and introducing new experiences that connect pilots, schools and the broader industry throughout the pilot journey. More than 1,400 flight schools rely on our technology. Tens of thousands of pilots subscribe to our products. We have established brands, deep customer relationships, an expanding portfolio and the ambition to build aviation's leading Pilot Experience Platform.

Job Overview:

This product marketer will decide how pilots understand our products, how they recognize differentiated value, and why they adopt, upgrade and stay. You will influence product direction through deep market insight, define compelling commercial stories and help establish a new aviation category. We want someone who can make complex software feel intuitive, valuable and personal to pilots.

Responsibilities:

Own positioning and messaging. Create accurate, memorable positioning for Pilotbase Pilot, Essential, Elite, and LogTen, tailored by pilot segment, stage, and motivation. Build message architecture and proof that stay true to the real product experience, and own approved claims for every pilot campaign.

Be the voice of the pilot. Run ongoing research with aspiring pilots, students, instructors, recreational pilots, and professionals. Turn interviews, feedback, objections, churn signals, and behavioral data into segments the whole team can use.

Track the competitive landscape. Monitor competitors and market shifts across EFB, logbook, and ground school, and turn them into insight that informs product, pricing, positioning, and go-to-market decisions.

Lead launches and go-to-market. Own audiences, value propositions, launch narratives, and commercial readiness for new pilot experiences, major releases, and subscription offers. Define launch hypotheses and measure adoption, engagement, and subscription impact.

Shape subscription value and pricing. Partner with Product and Pilot Growth on free-versus-paid value, upgrade messaging, pricing and packaging research, trials, and monetization experiments, assessing conversion and retention by cohort.

Convert pilots after graduation. Many pilots start using our app because their school requires it. Define the messaging and offers that help them see enough lasting value to subscribe on their own, across direct, flight school, and product-led channels.

Grow across the portfolio. Build a portfolio story that respects LogTen’s trust and equity while introducing Pilotbase Pilot to the right subscribers, judging success on pilot lifetime value across products.

Direct creative and content. Write and direct product narratives and briefs for launches, campaigns, landing pages, onboarding, and customer stories. Partner with our Creative & Brand team to connect pilots’ love of aviation to real reasons to adopt and pay.

Build trusted product knowledge, scaled with AI. Own the approved claims, value propositions, and competitive facts every team and AI workflow draws from. Use AI to scale research, competitive monitoring, and message testing, measured by better insight and commercial impact rather than content volume.

Qualifications:

REQUIRED

  • Substantial software product marketing experience
  • Repeated examples of differentiated positioning, segmentation and messaging
  • Customer research and competitive intelligence
  • GTM ownership and launches; subscription and lifecycle awareness
  • Strong Product partnership
  • Excellent writing, analysis and creative briefing; fluency with adoption, conversion, retention and product behavior metrics.
  • Evidence of using AI to improve customer research, competitive analysis or launch execution, with clear judgment about where it should not be trusted.

PREFERRED

  • Direct-to-consumer subscriptions, mobile apps, PLG, freemium, upgrades and trials;
  • Multi-product portfolios;
  • B2B2C or education and training distribution;
  • Specialized professional communities; pricing and packaging research
  • AI-driven research and experimentation
  • Aviation expertise helpful, not essential

Benefits:

  • Full benefits package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, Life Insurance, 401(k) plan)
  • Equity Appreciation Plan
  • Flexible Time Off policy
  • Seven (7) company-wide paid holidays + two (2) floating holidays
  • Two (2) wellness days
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Home Office Stipend

Compensation:

The salary range for this role starts at $120,000 annually. The final agreed-upon compensation is based on a number of factors, including but not limited to: individual education, qualifications, skills, prior work experience, competencies, and geographic work location. The above salary range represents the Company’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.

Travel Requirements:

  • Occasional business travel may be required for on-site events and conferences.

Deadline for Applications:

  • The company will accept ongoing applications until the role is filled. There is no deadline to apply for this position.

Pilotbase is an equal opportunity employer and encourages all qualified individuals to apply. If you're excited about this role, we'd love a chance to review your resume. We value a diverse and inclusive work environment and look for passionate people who are ready to do great things. If there is a required or preferred location for an open role, it will be listed in the job description. All applicants for employment must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Pilotbase does not provide work visa sponsorship at this time.

This employer participates in the Electronic Employment Verification Program. Please visit for more information.

Pilotbase welcomes all direct applicants, but does not utilize recruiting services from external agencies.
