raw.description:
NAMSA a été la première entreprise indépendante au monde à se concentrer exclusivement sur la sécurité des dispositifs médicaux. NAMSA a commencé à tester les dispositifs médicaux avant que la Food and Drug Administration (FDA) aux États-Unis ne commence à réglementer ces produits en 1976.

Chez NAMSA, nous façonnons l’industrie du dispositif médical car notre entreprise a joué un rôle clé dans l’élaboration des méthodes d’essai qui régissent désormais notre activité, activité au sein de laquelle nous sommes devenus leader. De plus, nous accompagnons nos clients à chaque étape du cycle de développement des produits.

Venez travailler pour une organisation riche de valeurs :

Une vision : inspirer des solutions novatrices pour l’industrie médicale afin de faire progresser les soins de santé à l’échelle mondiale, d’améliorer la vie des patients et d’accélérer la réussite de nos clients

Une mission : fournir les meilleures solutions de développement de l’industrie médicale à l’échelle mondiale grâce à nos équipes, notre expertise et nos technologies

Des valeurs :

  • Agir avec intégrité dans tout ce que nous faisons

  • Offrir la meilleure expérience à nos clients

  • Développer des talents et fournir une expertise

  • Réagir avec agilité et offrir des résultats pertinents

  • Encourager la collaboration, la diversité des opinions et des idées

Description du poste :

Who are we?

NAMSA is the European leader in consulting and evaluation services for medical devices and associated biotechnologies.

NAMSA was the world’s first independent company to focus exclusively on medical device safety. The company began testing medical devices even before the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) started regulating these products in 1976.

At NAMSA, we help shape the medical device industry. Our organization has played a key role in developing the testing methods that now govern our field—an area in which we have become a recognized leader. In addition, we support our clients at every stage of the product development lifecycle.

Who are we looking for?

You hold a Master’s degree (M2) with a specialization in Biology or any related discipline.

Ideally, you have some knowledge of medical devices.

You are detail‑oriented, dynamic, and well organized.

You demonstrate a strong team spirit and good adaptability.

You are able to work in strict compliance with procedures, protocols, and deadlines.

Proficiency in office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) is required.

You have a good command of scientific English, both written and spoken.


Your duties :

Support the delivery of high‑quality service at assigned locations, contributing to positive client experiences and satisfaction.

Assist in the preparation of technical and commercial proposals within a core laboratory functional area, including gathering information, supporting study design, and assisting with cost development.

Collaborate with Technical Sales Advisors, subject matter experts (SMEs), and operational teams to help ensure proposal content aligned with client needs and technical requirements.

Gain exposure to technical and regulatory review processes, including understanding proposal accuracy requirements and ISO 17025 compliance principles.

Help prepare and organize new and revised proposals for delivery to clients, including outlining next steps for proposal acceptance and sample submission.

Follow up on proposal requests to help collect missing information required for proposal development.

Support tracking and follow‑up of pending proposals for designated clients to assist in progressing opportunities toward closure.

Build cross‑functional relationships with Operations, Sales & Marketing, and Technical Sales Advisors to support a collaborative client-focused workflow.

Assist the Commercial and Laboratory teams in identifying potential Laboratory and Consulting opportunities.

Work alongside Business Development Executives and Commercial leadership to support regional sales objectives and pipeline activities.

Contribute to early-stage opportunity identification by researching client needs and escalating potential opportunities to senior team members.

Support SMEs and operational management in the costing and development of complex or non-standard proposals.

Help ensure technical documentation and proposal justifications were properly saved and available for Operations handoff.

Maintain opportunity updates in Salesforce, supporting accurate tracking of proposal status (e.g., pending, closed won, closed lost).

Assist with proposal revisions based on laboratory feedback or client requests.

Develop technical knowledge and commercial awareness by supporting Sales & Marketing teams and participating in cross‑functional discussions.


Practical Information

Contract: fixed term contract or permanent contract.

Location: Ideally would be able to work at Chasse‑sur‑Rhône near Lyon, otherwise, we would also be able to consider remote.

Accessibility: Easily accessible from Lyon (departures from Lyon 7 Jean‑Macé or Perrache). The NAMSA site is located just a 5‑minute walk from Chasse‑sur‑Rhône train station.

Benefits: 50% reimbursement of public transportation subscription, meal voucher card, internship allowance.


NAMSA is committed to promoting diversity, professional equality, and the inclusion and retention of people with disabilities in the workplace. So don’t hesitate, apply now!

Qualifications et compétences :


• Bachelor’s degree in scientific discipline or 3+ years of relevant experience required.
• Basic understanding of the Product Development Life Cycle.
• Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain relationships with clients and internal Associates.
• Working knowledge of standards, sales and proposals.
• Firm understanding of the sales process preferred.
• Previous experience in a related field preferred.
• Fluency in English and local language, if different, required.

• Some travel required 10%.

• Knowledge of ISO, GLP, GMP, GCP, AAMI, ASTM, European and USP standards/regulations relating to medical device development.
• Demonstrated knowledge of scientific applications, GLP regulations (if applicable), experimental design, data evaluation, metric system, and technical writing.
• Familiarity with medical device development process from pre-clinical to commercialization.

raw.excerpt: About OsanoOsano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right.
raw.description:
About Osano

Osano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right. Since day one, we’ve been focused on giving modern enterprises the ability to innovate quickly, stay competitive, and earn customer trust by respecting data privacy and complying with consent guidelines. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape.

About the Role

Osano is looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own and optimize our digital marketing programs, drive qualified pipeline, and maximize the return on our marketing investments.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and analytics. You'll take ownership of our paid media programs, from campaign development and audience targeting to budget management, experimentation, and performance optimization.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just understand performance marketing in theory but has experience getting into the platforms, building campaigns, analyzing results, and making adjustments that drive measurable business outcomes.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Content, and Revenue Operations to ensure our digital marketing investments are reaching the right audiences, generating qualified opportunities, and contributing to revenue growth.

What You'll Do

  • Own and execute Osano's paid media strategy across Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and emerging advertising channels, including YouTube, Reddit, and AI-driven platforms.
  • Manage paid campaigns directly within advertising platforms, including campaign setup, keyword research, audience targeting, bidding strategies, budget allocation, and ongoing optimization.
  • Develop and execute performance marketing programs designed to generate qualified leads, increase conversions, and contribute to sales pipeline and revenue.
  • Monitor and optimize key performance indicators, including cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), conversion rates, return on ad spend (ROAS), and pipeline contribution.
  • Manage paid media budgets, continuously evaluating channel performance and reallocating spend to maximize marketing efficiency and return on investment.
  • Build and execute A/B tests across ad creative, messaging, landing pages, audiences, and conversion paths to improve campaign effectiveness.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Content to develop compelling advertising messages, creative assets, and landing pages tailored to target audiences.
  • Analyze website traffic, landing page performance, and conversion funnels to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Work closely with Revenue Operations to ensure accurate campaign tracking, lead attribution, CRM integration, and performance reporting.
  • Leverage HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, and other marketing tools to measure campaign effectiveness and understand how marketing investments influence pipeline.
  • Develop audience segmentation and retargeting strategies to engage high-value prospects throughout the buyer journey.
  • Support account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives through targeted digital advertising campaigns.
  • Explore emerging advertising channels, AI-powered marketing tools, and automation opportunities to improve campaign execution and performance.
  • Create and maintain performance dashboards that provide clear visibility into campaign results, marketing spend, and pipeline contribution.
  • Share insights and recommendations with Marketing and Sales leadership, translating performance data into actionable business decisions.
  • Stay current on digital advertising trends, platform changes, and performance marketing best practices.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, paid media, digital marketing, growth marketing, or a related field, preferably within B2B SaaS or technology.
  • Demonstrated success managing and optimizing paid digital advertising campaigns that generate qualified leads, pipeline, and measurable business results.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads is required, including building, launching, managing, and optimizing campaigns directly within the platforms.
  • Experience managing paid media budgets and making data-driven decisions to improve campaign efficiency and ROI.
  • Strong understanding of paid search, paid social, audience targeting, retargeting, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization.
  • Experience analyzing performance metrics such as CPL, CPA, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, and marketing-sourced pipeline.
  • Proficiency with marketing analytics and reporting tools, including Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, and advertising platform reporting.
  • Experience working with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as HubSpot and Salesforce.
  • Understanding of the B2B SaaS buyer journey, lead generation, attribution, and pipeline development.
  • Experience developing and executing A/B tests to improve advertising performance, landing page conversions, and campaign effectiveness.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, diagnose performance issues, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
  • Comfortable managing campaigns independently, balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, budgets, and competing priorities.
  • Collaborative mindset and experience partnering with Sales, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, and Content teams.
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new advertising channels, emerging technologies, and AI-powered marketing tools.
  • Clear communication skills with the ability to explain campaign performance and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role isn't measured simply by how much advertising we run or how many leads we generate. It's about building an efficient, scalable performance marketing program that consistently turns marketing investments into meaningful business results.

You'll be successful when you're:

  • Generating a consistent flow of qualified leads and pipeline through paid marketing channels.
  • Improving campaign efficiency by reducing acquisition costs and increasing conversion rates.
  • Demonstrating clear ROI and pipeline contribution from marketing investments.
  • Building scalable, repeatable paid media programs that support Osano's growth goals.
  • Using testing, experimentation, and analytics to continuously improve campaign performance.
  • Providing clear visibility into marketing spend, channel effectiveness, and business outcomes.
  • Identifying new opportunities to reach high-value audiences and expand our digital marketing presence.

Who You Are

You're a data-driven marketer who loves turning insights into action. You enjoy digging into campaign performance, identifying opportunities, testing new approaches, and seeing the measurable impact of your work.

You're equally comfortable developing a performance marketing strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute it. You know your way around advertising platforms, understand what drives conversions, and aren't afraid to experiment when something isn't working.

You understand that successful performance marketing isn't about generating the most clicks or leads. It's about reaching the right audiences, creating meaningful engagement, and turning marketing investment into qualified pipeline and revenue.

Most importantly, you're someone who takes ownership. You don't need a large team or agency to execute your ideas. You're energized by building, optimizing, collaborating, and finding

Why Us

  • A well-defined career path that’s not just “climbing the ladder” - learn different competencies, skills, and concepts as you progress and get recognized for it.
  • Supportive leadership and peers - from sales engineering and product marketing to sales development and demand generation - you’re never in this alone.
  • You’ll be stepping into a space that’s on fire – the privacy and regulatory landscape is only growing with a ton of opportunity in front of us.
  • You’ll become a privacy expert, including the opportunity to receive your Certified Information Privacy credential.
  • You’ll be representing a product that makes prospects say, “This is so awesome” when you demo it.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation + ownership interest for an early stake in our success!
  • Unlimited paid time off with a requirement to take at least two weeks off per year.
  • We're continuously a Best Place for Working Parents and offer paid parental leave for all new parents + believe that family, however you define it, comes first.
  • Osano sponsors individual premiums for base plans at 100% and dependent premiums at 50% for Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance via Aetna.
  • A fully, permanently remote company so you can work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • Receive a MacBook + $600 to craft your home workspace
  • Annual company trip designed to foster connection, creativity, and fun together!
  • Mental health benefits with free memberships to mindfulness + talk therapy services

A Bit More About Osano

Osano is a leading data privacy platform that helps organizations quickly and confidently comply with laws like GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regulations. From consent management to vendor risk monitoring, Osano makes complex privacy tasks refreshingly simple, so companies can focus on what they do best, while we handle the rest.

We’re backed by top-tier investors including Baird Capital, Jump Capital, and LiveOak, and we’re scaling fast with a multi-year runway and ambitious growth plans. We’ve also been recognized as a Great Place to Work for four years running, with 97% of employees saying Osano is a great place to work.

As we grow, we're looking for individuals who lean into modern technologies and smarter systems to drive efficiency, clarity, and speed; both in our product and in how we operate. If you're excited by the idea of helping build a high-growth, privacy-first company that embraces thoughtful automation, emerging tech, and intentional collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

Osano is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

raw.title: Senior Node.js Developer (Portugal)
raw.excerpt: Who We AreFlosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

How you'll make an impact


  • Daily Outreach & Queue Execution: Work your assigned daily outreach queue with discipline — prioritizing high-risk accounts, running outreach sequences consistently, and ensuring no account is left untouched without clear documentation. Set the standard for consistent, high-energy outbound engagement.
  • Proactive Customer Engagement & Value Delivery: Conduct outbound calls to at-risk fleet account owners. Actively listen to diagnose root-cause concerns, explain the full value of WEX solutions, and address objections to rebuild customer commitment before disengagement occurs.
  • Risk Diagnosis & Save Execution: Identify key risk drivers early in conversations (e.g., declining vehicle activity, fee sensitivity, competitive proposals). Lead with value and tailored account adjustments to secure saves directly during the conversation.
  • Escalation Management & Value Desk Partnership: Recognize when a customer scenario exceeds standard advisor parameters (such as explicit intent to cancel requiring custom counter-pricing). Document key details quickly and escalate cleanly to the Value Desk for rapid resolution.
  • Cross-Sell & Expansion Signal Identification: Recognize expansion and cross-sell opportunities during retention discussions. Qualify customer needs for complementary products or services and pass clean, actionable referrals to growth partners.
  • Data Quality & CRM Compliance: Log every call, interaction outcome, risk signal, and status update accurately and promptly in the CRM and engagement tools. Maintaining clean data is critical to enabling analytics and refining overall retention strategies.
  • Coaching & Continuous Development: Participate actively in regular 1-on-1 coaching, call reviews, and team playbook sessions. Apply real-time feedback to continuously improve outbound conversation skills and retention performance.
  • Customer Satisfaction & Experience: Own the customer experience on every interaction. Ensure every customer feels heard, respected, and supported, leaving a positive impression regardless of whether the account is retained immediately
  • Activity Levels: Sustained, high-volume daily outbound calls and sequence execution across assigned queues.
  • Contact & Conversation Rates: High rate of meaningful conversations with primary fleet account decision-makers.
  • Account Saves: Consistently meeting or exceeding targets for retained accounts and preserved revenue.
  • Data Quality & Compliance: Timely, accurate, and complete call logging and status updates in CRM without gaps.
  • Escalation Quality: Escalations are documented thoroughly, timely, and routed correctly to the Value Desk.
  • Cross-Sell Referral Quality: Well-qualified expansion referrals that translate into high conversion rates.
  • Customer Satisfaction: Consistently strong customer feedback and satisfaction signals during calls.

Tools You Will Use Every Day

  • CRM Platform: Daily queue management, account risk tracking, interaction logging, and pipeline visibility.
  • Sales Engagement Platform: Outreach sequencing, dialer execution, call activity tracking, and workflow efficiency.
  • Call Monitoring / Coaching Tools: Live call recording, feedback review, and playbook reference.

Experience you'll bring


  • Must be fluent in French
  • 1–3+ years of experience in high-volume outbound sales, retention, account management, or customer success.
  • Proven ability to handle objections, engage decision-makers, and lead conversations with value.
  • Active listening skills to diagnose customer friction points and risk factors quickly.
  • Strong operational discipline — clean pipeline tracking and consistent, accurate CRM documentation.
  • Clear, confident, and professional phone and written communication skills.
  • Goal-driven mindset with a commitment to meeting activity standards and save targets.
  • Continuous improvement attitude — open to call reviews, coaching, and testing new approaches.

Nice to Have

  • Background in fleet, payments, fintech, or subscription B2B services.
  • Experience using Salesforce, Salesloft, or similar CRM and engagement platforms.
  • Experience operating in a fast-paced, scaling team environment.

This Role Is Not For You If:

  • You prefer waiting for inbound customer support inquiries rather than driving proactive outbound calls.
  • You view CRM data logging and activity tracking as optional busywork.
  • You are uncomfortable having direct conversations about pricing, service concerns, or competitive offers.

What WEX Offers


What You Get

  • Real ownership over account retention outcomes and client relationships
  • Dedicated 1-on-1 coaching and continuous professional skill development
  • Competitive compensation package with base salary plus variable performance incentives
  • Direct exposure and career path opportunities within Retention & Customer Success

Why This Role Matters

  • You are the frontline contact for customers who otherwise receive no proactive outreach
  • Your daily conversations directly protect company revenue and prevent churn
  • You help shape the habits, playbooks, and foundation of a fast-growing function
  • You serve as the voice of WEX during pivotal moments in the customer lifecycle

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. About UBQ.io
UBQ.io is a global technology service provider dedicated to building a more sustainable, independent, and equitable future. We partner with global companies across industries, including AI, blockchain, software, biotech, and education, to transform bold ideas into real, meaningful solutions.

Our expertise spans technology consulting, AI and Machine Learning development, Blockchain integration, and global team collaboration. With a worldwide network of specialists, we help organizations stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

At UBQ.io, we don’t just advise, we collaborate. Our commitment to innovation, sustainability, and social responsibility guides everything we do as we help clients build technologies that empower people, communities, and industries to thrive.

About the role

We are seeking an organized, commercially minded, and detail-oriented Project & Billing Operations Manager to oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of our client engagements. In this role, you will bridge client communication, project delivery, and financial operations. You will be responsible for scoping and estimating project budgets, interacting with clients’ representatives about service quality and respective billing, supervising internal team time logging, and ensuring accurate, timely billing.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced service environment, possesses strong interpersonal skills for client interactions, and brings rigorous operational discipline to track billable hours, prevent scope creep, and safeguard project profitability.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Client Relationship & Budget Estimation

    • Act as the primary point of contact for clients from initial scope discussions through project completion.

    • Gather project requirements, analyze resource needs, and create comprehensive project estimates and formal proposals (Statement of Work).

    • Establish clear timelines, deliverables, and budget caps with clients prior to project kick-off.

    • Conduct regular status updates with clients to ensure expectations, timelines, and satisfaction align with project goals.

  2. Team Oversight & Time Tracking Management

    • Monitor day-to-day team allocation and work progress to ensure deliverables stay on schedule.

    • Enforce time-tracking protocols across internal teams, ensuring hours are logged accurately against correct project codes daily/weekly.

    • Review and approve team timesheets, verifying that logged hours reflect actual work performed with the internal team heads.

    • Identify resource bottlenecks early and adjust project schedules or resource assignments accordingly.

  3. Financial Oversight, Scope Control & Billing

  • Track real-time project spend against approved budgets to catch overages before they occur.

  • Identify scope creep promptly, draft change orders, negotiate additional budget with clients, and gain approval before additional work begins.

  • Reconcile logged billable hours, expense receipts, and milestone completions to prepare monthly/project-based billing reports.

  • Work closely with the accounting/finance team to generate precise invoices and resolve any billing discrepancies with clients.

4. Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

  • Conduct post-project reviews (post-mortems) to measure final profitability against initial estimates.

  • Analyze historical time and cost data to continuously refine future budget estimation models.

  • Maintain high client retention rates by proactively identifying issues and delivering excellent service quality.

Requirements

Mandatory Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: 3–5+ years in project management, operations management, or client account management within a professional services, agency, consulting, or technical service environment.

  • Financial Acumen: Proven experience creating project budgets, tracking billable hours, and managing burn rates/profit margins.

  • Software Proficiency: Hands-on experience with time-tracking and project management tools and invoicing software.

  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a track record of handling high-value client relationships.

  • Leadership: Strong team-coordination skills with the ability to hold team members accountable for process adherence without sacrificing morale.

  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical capability to spot financial variances, resolve client concerns, and streamline operational workflows.

Core Values

  • Authenticity – Be steadfast and genuine with actions and communication.
  • Curiosity – Seek the "why" behind problems, trends, and decisions.
  • Focus – Remain accountable and devoted to delivering excellence.
  • Humility – Recognize that "we" is always greater than "I."
  • Happiness – Prioritize passion and love for what we do.

The Role

Digible, Inc. is looking for a Manager, Client Services to join our team!

The Manager, Client Services is responsible for leading, growing, and developing a high-performing team of 6-8 client service professionals, driving process innovation and strategy, while ensuring every client receives best-in-class experience that upholds our Digible standards.

What you’ll do:

Portfolio Growth, Retention & Expansion

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with corporate and executive client contacts, owning escalations, strategic communication, and account-wide initiatives

Team Leadership & Development

  • Partner cross-departmentally to deliver performance excellence, working selflessly with other teams to provide the best client experience
  • Ensure case studies and success stories are developed from the team’s wins, reinforcing client investment and elevating Digible’s market presence
  • Contribute to company-level initiatives that fuel long-term departmental and business growth

Product & Platform

  • Champion Fiona adoption across the team’s client base, ensuring every team member is equipped to demo, onboard, and drive ongoing platform use
  • Partner with Product and Development teams to translate aggregated client needs and usage patterns into feature enhancements and roadmap priorities

  • Response time SLA: <5 hours

  • Multifamily/Senior Living/Student Housing experience is a strong plus

Built by HR professionals for HR professionals, we’re proud of where we’ve been and even more excited about where we’re going.

We’re seeking a Major Accounts Account Executive to play a key role in driving new business growth with organizations in the large-market segment. This role manages the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through product demonstrations, negotiations, and deal closure. The ideal candidate brings experience selling SaaS solutions to larger organizations, excels at consultative selling, and thrives in building trusted relationships with HR and business leaders.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 4–7 years of SaaS sales experience with a proven record of success
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and close deals with mid-to-large organizations
  • Strong consultative selling skills and the ability to communicate business value
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and negotiation skills
  • Experience using CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) for pipeline management and forecasting
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across functions to drive results

Why join us

At AbsenceSoft, we LEAD with our values:

Lead with Innovation - We create meaningful change through intelligence, focus and passion.We embrace curiosity, data, and insight to shape the future of our industry. Always innovating, learning and evolving.

raw.excerpt: About the RoleThe Wales RESP needs to reflect national characteristics and priorities, driving whole energy considerations across all energy vectors.
raw.description:
About the Role

The Wales RESP needs to reflect national characteristics and priorities, driving whole energy considerations across all energy vectors. Think renewables, heat decarbonisation, hydrogen, energy networks, transport and flexibility! And how Wales needs differ, yet come together with the other nation and regions to form the Great British energy plan.

To achieve this, we have national and regional based teams – to work alongside our other teams in forming the hub and spokes needed for energy planning to benefit from and reflect local inputs.

Developing the RESP will require us to work with organisations at a local level (‘local actors’) including local government and gas and electricity networks, to improve understanding of the infrastructure needed in different parts of the country and attract investment for projects. Stakeholder engagement will be key to unlocking the benefits of integrated regional energy planning.

The purpose of this job is to lead engagement with technical audiences and coordinating technical and data interfaces with the Hub and other national / regional teams in developing RESPs.

Having an understanding and lived experience of Wales will be key.

Our focus in the immediate term is to build trust with our stakeholders, establish our process and methodology, and grow our capability in whole energy systems to best support local actors and industry stakeholders in developing credible plans to support net zero.

Climate change is the challenge of a generation, and the time to act is now. Join us and you won’t just be touching the lives of almost everyone in Great Britain – you will be shaping the way we use and consume energy for generations to come.

Key Accountabilities

  • Own and understand technical specific aspects of Wales’ energy system planning inputs into developing the RESP – e.g., understanding the data flows and design of the RESP products, as well as understanding the whole energy system (electricity networks, gas networks, other vectors)
  • Develop, consult and implement parts of the RESP methodology within Wales
  • Ownership of obtaining and validating national geospatial energy inputs
  • Work in matrix style structure within the wider RESP team
  • Represent NESO’s RESP function to local government and energy stakeholders
  • Understand, engage and gain required and beneficial inputs from stakeholders
  • Work with the Hub team in developing geospatial visualisations to support national insights
  • Create new ways to analyse and present problems and potential solutions

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK by the start of employment. Visa sponsorship may not be available for this role and will be considered in line with business requirements.

About You

We’re forging the path, and we know we cannot do it alone. That is why we need visionary minds like yours to join us on this transformative journey. In this case, we are looking for someone who has:

  • Understanding and lived experience of Wales
  • Technical experience within and knowledge of the energy sector, including of energy scenarios
  • Understanding of the ‘whole energy system’ with experience in one of the energy vectors
  • Experience working with or within energy distribution and/or transmission companies
  • Understanding and experience of geospatial data modelling, ideally applied in energy planning
  • Understanding and experience of applying comment methods and assumptions and validation of data
  • Ability to translate complex and technical information into easily understandable messaging for non-technical audiences
  • Experience of communicating with and influencing internal and external stakeholders
  • Project management, coordination and planning skills
  • An inquisitive mind with the ability to join the dots and a willingness to learn

What You'll Get

A competitive salary of £56,000 - £66,000 dependent on experience and capabilityAs well as your base salary, NESO's core benefits are the essential perks and advantages that form part of your employee package. - You will receive a bonus based on company performance- 26 days annual leave as standard - A competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. - Annual Enrollment to NESO Savings Plan, when you save between £20- £500 a month from your take-home pay, we will pay a 50% matching contribution.

NESO's flexible benefits programme provides you with more flexibility around your health, lifestyle and protection benefits, here's just a few available:
- Flexible Bank Holidays & Holiday Trading

- Additional Birthday Day Off

  • Cycle to Work Scheme, Retail & Gym Discounts
    - Private Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance & Personal Accident Insurance

About Us


At the National Energy System Operator (NESO), we play a vital role in tackling climate change and securing Great Britain's energy future. We already operate the world's fastest decarbonising electricity system and are working towards our ambition to run it carbon-free for a short period this year - provided the market supplies electricity exclusively from renewable sources. Alongside this, we provide expert advice to government on how to deliver a clean power system by 2030.

In autumn 2024, the Electricity System Operator (ESO) transitioned to become NESO - an independent, expert public corporation with a whole-system view across electricity, gas, and hydrogen. NESO operates independently and transparently, always acting in the best interests of all energy users.

Licensed and regulated by Ofgem, we make impartial decisions that balance sustainability, affordability and security. Our organisation is fully independent from government, the regulator and all commercial interests, with a clear focus on system-wide benefit, long term thing and public value.

The time to deliver is now. Join the energy transformation and help shape the future.

Your energy. Our future. Together


National Energy System Operator (NESO) recognises the potential of bright and talented individuals, and we encourage you to join us as Great Britain’s energy system undergoes an ambitious, exciting, and vital transformation. Together with industry, we are creating a cleaner, more sustainable energy future.

More Information

This role closes at 23:59, on the day before date shown above, however we encourage candidates to submit their application as early as possible and not wait until the published closing date as this can vary.

Research shows that some people may hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At NESO, we believe potential comes in many forms and we're committed to a fair, inclusive recruitment

We're committed to building a workforce that represents the communities we serve, and a working environment in which each individual feels valued, respected, fairly treated, and able to reach their full potential. If this role sparks your interest but you're not sure you tick every box, we still want to hear from you. process where everyone has the opportunity to show their talents. We celebrate the difference people can bring into our organisation, and welcome and encourage applicants with diverse experiences and backgrounds.

We are seeking Mandarin-speaking Generalists to contribute to an AI development project focused on training and improving next-generation AI systems.

  5. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to analyze lengthy, nuanced conversations.
  6. Strong written and verbal communication skills in Mandarin and English.

raw.description:
About Yotta Energy
Yotta Energy is building toward a world powered by dispatchable distributed energy resources. We design and manufacture rooftop solar-plus-storage systems for commercial and industrial buildings, and we offer financing and energy-as-a-service options so customers can deploy without heavy upfront cost. We are headquartered in Austin, Texas, with projects across California and other key U.S. markets.

Position Summary
Strategic Accounts Manager - C&I Energy - Your mission is to originate and close multi-site commercial and industrial (C&I) energy projects with organizations that control large portfolios of commercial rooftops. We sell portfolios of many small rooftop solar-plus-storage systems, backed by financing and energy-as-a-service options. The value comes from repeating the same deployment across dozens or hundreds of buildings under one relationship. You will be the person who builds those relationships.

Key Responsibilities
  • Build relationships at the corporate and portfolio level, rather than chasing individual sites.
  • Identify organizations with repeatable rooftop opportunities and get Yotta specified into their energy programs.
  • Originate portfolio-level agreements that turn one relationship into many projects.
  • Own each account and its revenue from first conversation to close, across a long sales cycle.
  • Partner with our sales and technical teams, who support site-by-site design, development and execution.
  • Create new business from scratch in the markets and segments where we see the best opportunities.

Who You'll Sell To
  • Primary: industrial and warehouse portfolio owners, grocery and retail chains, and the ESCOs, third-party owners, developers, buyer's agents and consultants who specify projects for large portfolios.
  • Also: corporate real estate, facilities and energy teams at multi-site organizations.
  • Secondary: K-12 and the public sector, mainly through ESCO relationships.

What You Bring

Required
  • You have personally originated and closed multi-site or portfolio energy business.
  • You understand how large multi-site customers buy energy projects.
  • You can get access to corporate decision makers and develop an account over a long sales cycle.
  • You are a hunter who is energized by creating business from scratch, not waiting for projects to come to you.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Existing relationships with portfolio owners, ESCOs, developers or buyer's agents.
  • Experience with solar, storage, or energy-as-a-service and financed project structures.

What you don't need to be: a battery expert, a deep technical engineer, or a traditional territory rep whose experience is mainly selling individual projects through local installers, distributors and EPCs. Our technical team has you covered.

Location and Compensation
  • Location: Ideally based in California (not required), with national account responsibility. Regular travel to customer sites and industry events.
  • Compensation: Base salary of $120,000 - $150,000, plus commission. Final pay depends on experience and location.

Work Authorization Requirement   
Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future employer sponsorship  

Why Join Yotta Energy  
At Yotta Energy, you'll have the opportunity to help build the workplace that supports the future of clean energy. As our Strategic Accounts Manager, you'll play a critical role in creating a safe, efficient, and technology-enabled environment where our teams can do their best work.

What You Will Do:

The Cash Posting Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the daily cash posting and payment reconciliation functions for hospital and healthcare revenue cycle operations. This position ensures that patient and payer payments, adjustments, denials, and other financial transactions are posted accurately, timely, and in accordance with established policies, procedures, and internal controls.


The supervisor provides day-to-day leadership to the Cash Posting team, monitors productivity and quality, ensures daily deposits and payment activity are balanced and reconciled, resolves posting discrepancies, and partners with Revenue Cycle, Patient Financial Services, Finance, and other operational teams to address issues impacting cash reconciliation.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with strong cash posting and reconciliation experience, excellent critical-thinking skills, and experience working within hospital patient accounting systems, including Epic, MEDITECH Magic, and MEDITECH 6.x/Expanse environments.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Cash Posting Operations

· Supervise daily hospital cash posting activities involving insurance, patient, electronic, and manual payments.

· Ensure payments, contractual adjustments, denials, recoupments, refunds, and other transactions are posted accurately and timely.

· Monitor Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA), Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT), lockbox, credit card, and manual payment workflows.

· Ensure unapplied, unidentified, and misapplied cash is researched and resolved promptly.

· Review posting exceptions and complex accounts requiring additional research or escalation.

· Ensure deposits and payment batches are processed according to established departmental procedures and deadlines.

· Identify opportunities to improve cash posting accuracy, efficiency, and automation.

Balancing and Reconciliation

· Oversee daily balancing of posted payments against bank deposits, remittance documentation, lockbox activity, and system totals.

· Perform and/or review daily, weekly, and monthly cash reconciliations.

· Investigate variances between bank deposits, payment files, and patient accounting system transactions.

· Ensure discrepancies are appropriately documented, researched, corrected, and escalated when necessary.

· Monitor outstanding reconciliation items and ensure timely resolution.

· Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails supporting posted and reconciled transactions.

· Partner with Finance and Revenue Cycle leadership to resolve complex reconciliation issues.

Staff Management and Leadership

· Provide direct supervision, coaching, training, and development for Cash Posting staff.

· Assign daily workloads and adjust staffing based on payment volumes, backlogs, and operational priorities.

· Monitor individual and team productivity, quality, attendance, and performance.

· Establish clear performance expectations and provide regular feedback to employees.

· Conduct quality reviews to identify errors, process gaps, and training opportunities.

· Support onboarding and ongoing training of new and existing employees.

· Address performance concerns and implement corrective action plans when appropriate.

· Promote accountability, teamwork, accuracy, and continuous improvement within the department.

Quality and Performance Management

· Monitor key performance indicators related to cash posting productivity, accuracy, reconciliation, aging, and outstanding exceptions.

· Prepare and communicate daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports.

· Analyze trends and identify root causes of posting errors, reconciliation issues, or workflow delays.

· Develop corrective action plans when performance or quality falls below established standards.

· Work with leadership to establish productivity and quality benchmarks.

· Ensure departmental procedures remain current and consistently followed.

Critical Thinking and Problem Resolution

· Analyze complex payment and reconciliation discrepancies and determine appropriate corrective action.

· Research payment issues across multiple systems, facilities, payers, and bank transactions.

· Identify recurring operational problems and recommend sustainable process improvements.

· Escalate financial, system, or compliance concerns appropriately.

· Exercise sound judgment when resolving exceptions that could impact patient balances, payer balances, or financial reporting.

Systems and Technology

· Utilize hospital patient accounting and revenue cycle applications to manage cash posting and reconciliation activities.

· Preferred experience with:

o Epic

o MEDITECH Magic

o MEDITECH 6.x / Expanse

· Work with ERA/EFT files, lockbox platforms, payer portals, banking applications, and other revenue cycle technologies.

· Assist with system testing, upgrades, workflow changes, and implementation activities affecting cash posting.

· Identify opportunities for automation and workflow optimization.

What You Will Need:

· Bachelor’s Degree & 5 Years of Relevant Experience OR High School Diploma/GED & 9 Years of Relevant Experience in lieu of higher education

· 5 years of healthcare revenue cycle, hospital cash posting, payment posting, or related patient financial services experience.

· 2+ years of supervisory or team-lead experience

· Prior experience with cash balancing and reconciliation.

· Demonstrated understanding of insurance and patient payment posting processes.

· Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

· Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

· Ability to research and resolve payment discrepancies independently.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other standard business applications.

What Would Be Nice to Have:

· Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.

· Hospital or multi-facility healthcare cash posting experience.

· Experience with Epic, MEDITECH Magic, and/or MEDITECH 6.x/Expanse.

· Experience managing high-volume cash posting operations.

· Knowledge of ERA/EFT, lockbox, electronic payment, and automated cash posting workflows.

· Strong knowledge of hospital cash posting and patient accounting workflows.

· Strong balancing and reconciliation skills.

· Understanding of third-party payer remittances and patient payments.

· Strong leadership and staff-management capabilities.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

· Ability to analyze data and recognize trends or discrepancies.

· Ability to manage productivity and quality standards across a team.

· Ability to collaborate effectively with Revenue Cycle, Finance, Patient Financial Services, IT, and operational leadership.

· Ability to work successfully in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.

· Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive financial and patient information.

· Cash posting timeliness

· Posting accuracy and quality

· Daily cash reconciliation accuracy

· Outstanding/unapplied cash levels

· Exception and variance resolution

· Team productivity

· Employee quality performance

· Backlog management

· Timely escalation and resolution of operational issues

· Compliance with established procedures and internal controls

raw.description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit . Come join us.

About the Team:

The Revenue Operations team at AlphaSense drives productivity and improves efficiency for our account executives, account managers, and sales development reps. We create and implement operational reporting and analytics, improve processes, and enable strategic initiatives that impact the revenue organization. At our core, we are a dynamic team of highly driven self-starters who are passionate about operations and thrive in a fast-paced, challenging environment.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Principal Revenue Applications Developer to serve as the senior technical authority for the systems that power AlphaSense's revenue engine. You will set the architectural direction for our go-to-market tech stack (Salesforce and the connected applications around it), lead our most complex builds and integrations, and raise the technical bar for the team through design reviews, standards, and mentorship. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Engineering to turn business needs into scalable, secure, and well-documented solutions, and help shape business operations policy alongside Revenue Operations leadership. This is a high-impact, highly visible role with global reach and the autonomy to influence how we scale.

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years of experience working with or within a revenue organization, playing a key role in driving productivity
  • 6+ years as an administrator and developer in Salesforce, including leading technical implementations and architecture decisions
  • 3+ years of experience developing in a modern high-level language such as Java or Python
  • Deep expertise in the Salesforce platform, including Apex, SOQL, LWC, and SFDX
  • Experience designing and building integrations using REST and SOAP APIs
  • Strong grasp of software design patterns, systems architecture, and security and access models
  • Proven ability to weigh multiple solutions, anticipate conflicts, and make sound technical trade-offs
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and work effectively with business teams at all levels
  • A self-starter who thrives with minimal supervision in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • A creative problem solver who finds new and innovative ways to drive sales productivity

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical architecture and roadmap for Salesforce and the surrounding revenue tech stack, including Jira, Google Cloud, Heroku, Outreach, Marketo, and other internal business applications
  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of complex customizations and integrations (Apex, LWC, REST/SOAP APIs, SFDX), setting engineering standards, code review practices, and release processes
  • Partner with revenue leadership to gather and translate business requirements into scalable solutions, and to prioritize work against capacity and impact
  • Evaluate, refine, and rationalize the technology stack, workflows, and data flows to create cohesive solutions and reduce technical debt
  • Participate in vendor selection and evaluation, and recommend third-party solutions that enhance sales productivity and business processes
  • Define and maintain security models, access control, permissioning, and sharing rules across supported applications
  • Mentor developers and admins on the team, providing technical guidance and design reviews on cross-functional projects
  • Monitor and troubleshoot systems, and lead resolution of critical issues that impede development or day-to-day operations
  • Stay ahead of new platform features and emerging capabilities (including automation and AI), and keep stakeholders informed of enhancements and their impact
  • Be the "go-to person" for revenue organization technical needs, contributing to worldwide projects and to the team's operating policies

Technical Qualifications

  • Familiarity with cloud development, including GCP or AWS, and Docker
  • Working knowledge of git, Jira, Zendesk, and similar corporate tooling
  • Experience with revenue-adjacent tools, including Marketing and Finance platforms
  • Understanding of web technologies: HTML, JavaScript, jQuery, CSS
  • Salesforce Developer and/or Architect certifications are a plus

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

Prazer, nós somos a NEXDOM Healthtech 🤝🏽

Você está preparado para fazer parte de uma empresa que promove inovação e qualidade na gestão de operadoras de planos de saúde, oferece um completo pacote de benefícios, plano de desenvolvimento e está há mais 20 anos no mercado?

Aqui, o nosso compromisso é criar um ambiente positivo e sustentável! E muito mais do que oferecer soluções inovadoras, queremos fazer parte de grandes sonhos e que gerem valor para todos.

Estamos sempre dispostos a aprender e reconhecer nossos erros. Valorizamos o conhecimento e a troca de perspectivas, reconhecendo que o resultado é gerado de forma coletiva.

Nossos líderes diariamente incentivam a criatividade e a busca contínua por ideias e soluções que transformem nossos produtos, serviços e processos, fortalecendo a nossa cultura de atuar com excelência! 🤩

Somos #remotefirst! Incentivamos a liberdade geográfica para você atuar de onde quiser, tendo uma rotina com mais flexibilidade e qualidade para alcançarmos grandes resultados juntos.

A nossa missão é promover inovação e qualidade na gestão de operadoras de planos de saúde!E para esse time ficar completo, só falta você! 💚

  • Prestar suporte na identificação e solução de incidentes e/ou problemas nos sistemas NEXDOM, com foco em rotinas contábeise integrações entre sistemas.
  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre funcionalidades dos sistemas.
  • Sugerir melhorias de fluxos e processos com base nos atendimentos prestados.
  • Manter comunicação ativa durante os atendimentos via chat, e-mail, telefone e demais canais.
  • Reclassificar a severidade e o tipo de chamado, garantindo o fluxo correto de atendimento.
  • Registrar de forma completa a evolução e solução dos chamados, permitindo acompanhamento pelo solicitante.
  • Atuar com base em evidências dos incidentes, buscando atendimento assertivo.
  • Contribuir com a manutenção da biblioteca de pesquisa e gestão do conhecimento.
  • Cumprir e propor melhorias nos fluxos e diretrizes internos.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento com a equipe e manter atuação harmônica com os colegas.
  • Prestar atendimento com respeito, profissionalismo e empatia, visando uma experiência positiva.
  • Demonstrar escuta ativa, empática e objetiva com foco na resolução de problemas.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas conforme solicitação da liderança.
  • Atuar sob orientação e supervisão próxima e contínua.
  • Manter-se atualizado com procedimentos, treinamentos e certificações da área.
  • Garantir o tratamento de chamados dentro do SLA acordado.
  • Interagir com áreas solucionadoras para tratativas conjuntas.
  • Estudar e analisar as demandas, encaminhando-as se necessário.
  • Ensino Superior em curso em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas.
  • Mínimo de 1 ano de atuação com suporte a sistemas, atendimento técnico ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento prático em integrações de sistemas(análise de logs e erros de integração, consumo/envio via APIs, estruturas XML/JSON ou troca de arquivos).
  • Conhecimento sólido em rotinas contábeis(plano de contas, lançamentos, conciliação e fechamento contábil).
  • Perfil analítico para investigação de causa raiz e atuação orientada a evidências.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em clareza e resolução de problemas.

Informações adicionais

Será um diferencial:

  • Conhecimento no ERP Pirâmide (especialmente módulos contábil, financeiro e suas integrações).
  • Conhecimento nos sistemas NEXDOM e familiaridade com processos de operadoras de planos de saúde.
  • Noções de banco de dados (consultas SQL para apoio na investigação de incidentes) e ferramentas de teste de API (ex.: Postman).
  • Vivência com plataformas de atendimento/gestão de demandas (como Zoho Desk e Jira) e metodologias ágeis.

    • Os benefícios de trabalhar na NEXDOM são:

    • Plano de Saúde para você e dependentes (sem mensalidade 👀);
    • Plano Odontológico para você e dependentes (sem mensalidade 👀);
    • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
    • Totalpass;

    • Seguro de Vida;
    • Day off no mês do aniversário;
    • Bolsa de estudos;
    • Auxílio Home Office;
    • Vale transporte;
    • Auxílio Estacionamento;
    • Flexibilidade de trabalho híbrido ou remoto.


    E mais:

    • Ambiente leve e descontraído;
    • Cultura focada em Inovação, Excelência, Comprometimento e Trabalho em Equipe; 🚀
    • Empresa em grande desenvolvimento.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description: We are seeking a proactive, hands-on Cloud Security Engineer to serve as the primary security partner for our Engineering and DevOps teams.

raw.title: Cloud Security Engineer
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a proactive, hands-on Cloud Security Engineer to serve as the primary security partner for our Engineering and DevOps teams.
raw.description:
We are seeking a proactive, hands-on Cloud Security Engineer to serve as the primary security partner for our Engineering and DevOps teams. In this role, you will be the "North Star" for secure cloud configuration, moving beyond simple alert triaging to building sustainable security foundations. You will bridge the gap between high-level security architecture and daily engineering execution, ensuring our AWS and Azure environments are resilient, compliant, and automated.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Cloud Governance & Guardrails: Lead the deployment and optimization of AWS Control Tower, Security Hub, and AWS WAF to establish a secure multi-account strategy.

  • Cloud Security Platform Ownership: Own cloud security outcomes across AWS (primary), Azure (secondary), and limited GCP, including secure landing zone standards, guardrails-as-code, detection coverage, and remediation automation.

  • Secure-by-Default Engineering: Design and implement reusable, secure-by-default cloud patterns that allow engineering teams to deploy safely without constant security intervention. Establish hardened Terraform modules, reference architectures, and baseline configurations so the secure path becomes the easiest path for teams building in AWS.

  • Container Security: Collaborate with the AppSec Architect to secure EKS and ECS environments, focusing on runtime protection, image scanning, and least-privilege orchestration.

  • Security Assessment & Roadmap: Perform a comprehensive baseline assessment of the current cloud environment to identify gaps and provide actionable, prioritized recommendations.

  • Identity & Access Management: Lead design and enforcement of least-privilege IAM architecture across AWS accounts and workloads.

  • Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain secure configuration standards, documentation, and operational procedures that enable engineering teams to consistently deploy and operate cloud services securely.

  • Detection & Telemetry Ownership: Partner with security operations to ensure security telemetry from AWS environments is complete, centralized, and actionable (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow logs, etc.)

  • Cloud Security & Compliance Alignment: Ensure cloud configurations and controls align with internal security standards and external compliance requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, etc.). Partner with Security and GRC teams to implement audit-ready controls, automate evidence collection where possible, and maintain clear documentation of cloud security control coverage.

  • Third-Party Integration: Manage secure access and configuration for security vendor tools (vulnerability scanners, assessment platforms, etc.) within the cloud environment.

  • Incident Response: Participate in an on-call rotation for one week at a time and serve as primary SME for cloud security incidents (IAM compromise, exposed keys, misconfigurations, etc.).

  • Vulnerability & Exposure Management: Build and run the cloud vulnerability management program for AWS and Azure workloads, container images, and base AMIs. Define severity-based SLAs, implement scalable scanning and patch workflows (e.g., AWS Inspector, ECR scanning, hardened base images), and partner with Engineering to reduce exploitable exposure.

  • Cloud Security Tooling Ownership: Own onboarding, coverage validation, and tuning of CSPM and MDR integrations across AWS, Azure and GCP. Drive measurable improvement in signal quality, alert fidelity, and remediation workflows through automation and engineering partnerships.

  • Secrets, Keys, and Credential Hygiene: Design and enforce secure secrets management patterns (AWS Secrets Manager/Parameter Store/Vault), automated rotation, and least-privilege secret access. Own KMS key strategy and governance (key policies, grants, rotation, separation of duties) and ensure no long-lived credentials in CI/CD.

  • CI/CD and Supply Chain Security: Secure the software delivery pipeline end-to-end, including identity federation for CI/CD, policy-as-code enforcement for Terraform and Kubernetes, artifact integrity controls (signing/provenance), and secure dependency/source controls. Ensure security guardrails are automated and developer-friendly.

  • Cloud Incident Readiness & Exercises: Build cloud-native incident playbooks (IAM compromise, crypto-mining, data exposure, suspicious network activity) and run periodic tabletop exercises. Ensure forensics readiness through log retention standards, immutable/auditable logging where appropriate, snapshot/containment procedures, and break-glass access controls.

  • Multi-Cloud & Hybrid Baselines: Establish minimum viable security baselines for Azure and GCP (identity, logging, storage, network, key management) and ensure telemetry parity into centralized detection. Partner with operation teams to secure hybrid connectivity with data center environments (segmentation, identity boundaries, secure administrative access).

  • Security Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Define and report on key cloud security metrics (coverage, misconfiguration trends, MTTR, control adoption, vulnerability SLAs). Use metrics to prioritize work, demonstrate risk reduction, and drive engineering alignment.

  • Leadership and Execution: Mentor other engineers and raise baseline security literacy in platform/DevOps teams through patterns, reviews, and internal enablement.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Information Security, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on AWS Cloud Security.

  • AWS Deep Dive: Deep hands-on experience designing and securing AWS environments, core services (IAM, VPC, S3, KMS) and security-specific services (GuardDuty, Inspector, Config).

  • IaC Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience with Terraform for managing cloud infrastructure.

  • Containerization: Proven experience securing containerized workloads in EKS or ECS.

  • Azure Knowledge: Willingness to provide basic security support/maintenance for an existing Azure environment (Deep expertise not required; AWS is the priority).

  • Consultative Mindset: Ability to assess a complex environment and provide a "roadmap to green" rather than just identifying problems.

  • Collaborative Partnership: Ability to work side-by-side with engineers, speaking their language and helping them solve problems rather than just "blocking" tickets.

  • Strategic Documentation: Capability to translate technical configurations into clear, repeatable processes and procedures.

  • Automation First: A drive to automate manual security tasks to increase efficiency and reduce human error.

  • Education/Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field or equivalent work experience.

  • Industry certifications such as Azure security certification, AWS Certified Security – Specialty or related are highly desirable.

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:

• We are laid back but buttoned up. We offer a casual work environment and remote work flexibility and have a passion for developing creative, innovative best in class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers
• We care deeply and deliver service and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses
• We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust
• Teamwork and collaboration is key to help our colleagues and customers solve their challenges
• Our team is energetic, fun, naturally inquisitive and eager to make an impact, we invite you to join us!

LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT:

• Join our Remote-First Global Work Community: WorkWave provides an innovative and dynamic remote-first Global Work Community that encourages growth, creativity, and collaboration. No matter what stage of your career or where you live, WorkWave is your place to be part of a global company with a startup feel, where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority.

A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:

• We know that there are benefits of being in the office and working from home. WorkWave promotes a healthy work/life balance and provides employees with the flexibility of collaborating in the office or the option to work virtually if desired. Our teams are well versed at working collaboratively in a fully virtual environment.
• Our HQ is based at our state of the art home office in the historic Bell Works complex located in Holmdel Township, New Jersey. We keep our offices available to all to use when working remotely isn’t feasible, or to help with cross training, team building and/or brainstorming.
• We have employees in over 30 states, 7 countries and many regional offices - each with their own set of perks and opportunities to give back to the local community.
• Whether you work remotely or take advantage of one of our offices, you’ll find a community of WorkWavers that value diversity, and care deeply about our products, clients, our communities and each other.

RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED:

• Employees can expect a robust benefits package, including health and dental and 401k with company match

AND BEYOND...

• Find your perfect work/life balance with our Flexible Time Off policy or generous PTO plan (role dependent) and paid holidays
• Up to 4 weeks paid bonding leave
• Tuition reimbursement
• Robust Employee Assistance Program through TotalCare offering free counseling 24/7/365, plus financial counseling, legal guidance, adoption assistance services and much more!
• 24/7 access to virtual medical care with Teladoc
• Quarterly awards based on peer nominations
• Regional discounts and perks
• Opportunities to participate in charitable events and give back to the community

GROW WITH US:

• We understand the impact of attracting and keeping top talent and reward intellectual curiosity and a thirst for personal and professional growth
• Encouraging our employees that already have an intimate knowledge of and passion for our products to apply for other roles within our walls just makes sense!
• Our employees have access to extensive video libraries for soft skill and role specific training available 24/7 and live trainings are provided throughout the year

JOIN OUR WINNING TEAM!

• 10 Time winner of Best Place to Work in New Jersey by NJBiz!
• WorkWave has been recognized with multiple awards for its outstanding products, growth and culture, including the Inc. 5000, SaaS Award, IT World Awards, Globe Awards, Silver Stevie Award for Employer of the Year, and Best Place to Work Inc. Magazine
• Named one of The Software Report's 3rd annual list of the Top 100 Software Companies of 2022 (worldwide!)
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status: Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At WorkWave, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you feel like you could make a great impact in this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!
