raw.description:
About Smartwyre

Founded in 2018, Smartwyre is a venture-financed SaaS business delivering enterprise software to large agricultural businesses, operating in a $400 billion global industry. With an estimated 5 million farmers and over 5,000 distributors globally, Smartwyre works across the agricultural supply chain, from large corporations to local farms. Presently, we work from the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, and South America.

We are building a B2B SaaS platform to network together the commercial operations of the companies that supply the world’s farmers with seeds, fertilizer, chemicals, and services, with their target markets being the United States, Europe, and Latin America. We aim to first offer SaaS applications to solve key commercial pain points (pricing, costing, quoting), then network these companies using a common data platform (transactional data exchange, product information publication, people networking, and user analytics), and finally empower the network to facilitate new business model amongst network participants.

About the role

  • Overview: A remote, permanent, full-time Cloud Platform Team Lead reporting to the SVP of Engineering, requiring working-hours overlap across the UK and US. You will lead the cloud team and own the Azure platform.
  • The Mission: A hands-on role combining infrastructure design and operations with team leadership. You will provide secure hosting for internal agents and MCP workloads, own SOC 2 infrastructure compliance, and drive developer self-service so other teams can deploy independently.

What you'll do

  • Hands-On Infrastructure & Terraform: Design, write, and review modular Terraform across multiple environments, and operate core production Azure services (App Service, Functions, PostgreSQL, Key Vault).
  • Developer Self-Service & CI/CD: Build versioned infrastructure templates and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) to empower engineering teams to provision and deploy services independently.
  • AI & Agentic Workloads: Own secure, repeatable hosting and deployment patterns for internal agents and MCP workloads, partnering with Architecture on network guardrails and cost controls.
  • Team Leadership & Delivery: Run team ceremonies, 1:1s, performance reviews, and capacity planning while actively mentoring and developing engineers.
  • Security & SOC 2 Compliance: Maintain first-class cloud security (least-privilege IAM, network isolation) and own the infrastructure controls, audit evidence, and pen-test remediation for SOC 2.
  • FinOps & Cost Reporting: Track cloud spend, drive optimisations (reservations, rightsizing), and coordinate consolidated monthly cost reports across Azure, Snowflake, and Estuary.

Experience

  • Proven experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, or DevOps, including leading engineers and owning team delivery.
  • Strong production experience with Azure across multiple subscriptions and environments (networking, Entra ID identity, PaaS data services, cost management).
  • Expert-level Terraform skills (reusable modules, state management, multi-environment deployments, line-by-line plan review).
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps, plus reusable infrastructure patterns for other teams.
  • Strong scripting capabilities in PowerShell, Bash, or Python (heavy usage of PowerShell).
  • Hands-on security and compliance experience (SOC 2 or ISO 27001 control ownership, audit evidence, access reviews, pen test remediation).
  • Demonstrated leadership in capacity planning, developing engineers, driving adoption, and engaging senior stakeholders.
  • Practical background in platform monitoring, incident response, backups, and tested recovery procedures.
  • Clear written communication skills for RFCs, runbooks, and executive reports, alongside participation in on-call rotations.

Desirable

  • Experience with AI/agent platforms (Azure AI Foundry, MCP) and daily use of AI coding assistants.
  • Deep PostgreSQL operations and FinOps practice.
  • Containerisation proficiency (Docker, Azure Container Apps) and monitoring expertise (Grafana, Azure Monitor, SLOs).

Benefits

Competitive salary

Private Health (UK - BUPA) / Competitive Health Insurance (US)

Short Term / Long Term Disability Cover (US)

Critical Illness and Income Protection (UK)

Self-directed PTO

Flexible Work Location

Flexible Hours

Pension (UK) / 401k (US)

A minimum of five years working as an admissions officer/reader at a selective college including but not limited to experience as a high school counselor, independent counselor, or college counseling professional in a business setting

A thorough understanding of the high school curriculum, AP, IB, all standardized tests including the ACT, SAT, and other standardized tests

Experience working with students 7th -12th grade, transfer applications, and private/boarding school applicants

Proven track record of student success with all different types of academic programs, including specializations, direct med, engineering, etc...

Successful methods with how to differentiate a students application and build an incredible portfolio

Experience with athletic recruitment and other specialized endeavors.

Excellent writer and understanding of the current admissions landscape

Fun, knowledgeable, a motivator, and team builder

Expertise with the differences between public, private, charter,and boarding school environments

Expert knowledge of Naviance, Scoir, and other college admissions software

Expertise with all application platforms (Common App, Coalition App, Apply Texas, and school specific applications)

Thorough knowledge of the college process, different types of schools, resources, and environments

A proven track record with placing students in selective colleges, prestigious high school internships and other extra curricular activities

In-depth knowledge with the financial aid process, scholarship options, and other aid.

Ability to create individualized plans for high school students with course selection, academic interest exploration, extracurricular activities and summer programs

Familiarity with the academic and social demands of the high school culture and the competitive college admissions landscape

Conduct ongoing research on school profiles, course catalogs and academic programs to provide well-informed responses to individual student’s needs

Knowledge with academic programs and contests such as DECA, Science/Math Olympiads, AMC math competitions, Science Fairs, STEM competitions, etc.

A leader with great communication,organization, and writing skills to guide families and mentor students through the entire admissions process

Creative, driven, with endless energy to build life skills, self-esteem, and confidence through positive reinforcement

Proficient with using technology

Patient, passionate, versatile, and dedicated to helping kids excel

Strong desire to grow in a fast-paced startup environment with high levels of autonomy

Be involved with a team that has bold ideas with the goal of reinventing education across the globe

A compensation package that is one of the best in the industry, along with performance based bonuses and tremendous growth opportunities

Flexible hours to fit your schedule

Extra Credit:

M.Ed. and Ph.D in education

Benefits

We provide industry leading compensation and performance bonuses

This is a contractual opportunity and should be viewed as supplemental income

This is not a FTE position

Flexible work schedule with a growing company

All applicants must be a U.S. Citizen or National of the U.S., an alien lawfully admitted for permanent residence, or an alien authorized to work in the U.S. for this employer.

Paralegal with a talent for customer service (LegalTech)

As a LegalTech company, we operate at the intersection of legal drafting and review, customer communication, and technical support. This is a dynamic, multifaceted role where legal expertise meets technology and client engagement. We're searching for a talented Paralegal with a genuine passion for customer service - someone who is detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to excel in a fast-paced SaaS environment. If you enjoy combining legal precision with problem-solving and client interaction, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

We’ll be accepting applications over the next two months and will appoint the right candidate as soon as we find the ideal fit.


Role Description

As a Paralegal with a talent for customer service within the Customer Success team, this role is crucial in ensuring customers attain their desired outcomes using our product or service. This responsibility is pivotal for enhancing customer satisfaction and retention. You will act as an essential bridge between our company and its customers, championing customer success and satisfaction. Additionally, the duties shall include conducting legal research, drafting legal documents, and offering support on legal matters, contributing significantly to our overall service quality.


Key Responsibilities

Legal Drafting/Review

  • As part of our service customers require written agreements incorporating their requirements. You’ll be managing this process by drafting the legal language to fit those requirements

  • You’ll be preparing the required documents, which will then be checked by your manager before it is shared with the client

Customer Service

  • You’ll be receiving requests from users and leads, asking questions about the services we offer and how to manage their Codekeeper account

  • Since we operate a full service model, you’ll be making sure their requests are handled quickly and correctly

Tech Setup Support

  • Customers will also be required to set up connections between their source code management platform

  • You will support them in this process and make sure everything is administered correctly on our side

Sales Support

  • Since in our view customer success starts from the very first contact, you’ll also be working with leads who have questions, guiding them about our service

  • This is done via email and website chat

Report Drafting

  • Some of our customers require us to inspect information they provide

  • You draft the reports and send them back to them


About the Company

Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art software escrow solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our app.


What We Offer

  • Passionate and fun-loving colleagues

  • Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth

  • Regular team activities and gatherings

  • Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period

  • A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback

  • A chance to excel in your career and make a difference


What We Are Looking For

We are seeking a motivated individual ready to embrace this challenge. While extensive legal or technical experience is not expected, familiarity with LegalTech concepts is crucial for success in this role.

  • Prior experience in customer success or similar role is preferred

  • Proficiency in drafting legal documents

  • Exposure to working with diverse companies of varying sizes and industries


Additional Requirements

  • Analytical thinking, and a proactive attitude

  • Excellent written English communication skills

  • Proficiency in modern web tools like Google Docs and similar platforms

  • Highly organized with a strong attention to detail

  • Comfortable adapting and multitasking in a fast-paced environment


Additional Info

  • Job Location: Remote

  • Join us to shape the future of software escrow!


How to Apply

To apply, use the Apply button on this listing. In your application, tell us how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. Show us your role in our company’s future and our role in yours, address some of the work we do, and introduce yourself as a colleague.

Please note: Applications and follow-ups sent through any other channel, such as our customer website chat, support email or direct messages to team members, won’t be considered. Need an accessibility adjustment to apply? Visit Our Careers Page for how to reach us.

At Assurant, we're seeking a strategic and execution-focused Director, Client Solutions Delivery to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of client solutions that drive growth, enhance customer experiences, and deliver measurable business results. This role serves as a critical bridge between clients and internal teams, translating complex business requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring flawless delivery and long-term success.


As a key leader within our OEM and Connected Living business, you'll collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Operations, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain, Business Development, and Account Management while partnering with some of the world's most recognized brands.


What Makes Us Different?

At Assurant, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Influence growth strategies and client solutions for major global OEM and retail brands.
  • Lead highly visible initiatives that directly impact client satisfaction, retention, and business growth.
  • Operate with autonomy while partnering across a large, matrixed organization.
  • Help shape innovative programs, launches, and strategic initiatives that support evolving customer needs.
  • Work in a remote-friendly environment that values collaboration, flexibility, and results.

What Will Be My Duties and Responsibilities in This Job?

  • Lead the development and execution of client solution strategies that align business objectives, client needs, and product priorities.
  • Partner directly with clients to understand business challenges, identify opportunities, and design scalable solutions.
  • Drive complex client implementations, program launches, enhancements, and solution delivery from design through operational readiness.
  • Lead cross-functional teams across Product, Technology, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Account Management to ensure seamless execution.
  • Develop business cases, scope documents, requirements, solution recommendations, and executive-level communications.
  • Manage client relationships and build credibility with senior stakeholders while balancing client expectations with business objectives.
  • Monitor program performance, profitability, and key success metrics, implementing improvements as needed.
  • Lead and coach team members while influencing numerous matrixed resources across the organization.
  • Communicate risks, priorities, decisions, and progress clearly to executives, clients, and business partners.

What Are the Requirements Needed for This Position?

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in client solutions, implementation, program management, and team leadership.
  • OEM and/or retail industry experience required.
  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale client implementations and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Proven consulting, stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to influence across matrixed organizations and drive decisions in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • Experience developing scalable solutions and implementation strategies based on client needs.
  • Effective executive communication skills with the ability to engage clients, leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  • Analytical problem-solving skills with a focus on execution and results.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.

What Other Skills/Experience Would Be Helpful to Have?

  • MBA or other advanced degree.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Strong solution design and implementation leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated success building consensus among diverse stakeholders and leading through influence.
  • Experience with AI-assisted documentation, business process improvement, journey mapping, or operational transformation initiatives.
  • Bilingual capabilities may be beneficial.

How Much Should I Expect to Travel?

  • This position requires approximately 20% travel based on client, business, implementation, and program needs. Travel may include client meetings, program launches, stakeholder workshops, and strategic planning sessions.

Healthcare’s helping hand.

CHG shook things up in 1979 by inventing the locum tenens staffing model. We connect doctors with patients who need their care. As the largest physician staffing firm in America, our providers treat millions of patients each year.

Our industry is growing and demand is high. This means you’ll have plenty of opportunities to grow and develop in your career. Keeping healthcare healthy can be as fun as it is rewarding

The Vice President of Advisory Services provides executive leadership over CHG's Advisory Services offering and team, and serves as CHG's executive sponsor of the Client Advisory Board. This role is accountable for establishing Advisory Services as a durable, revenue-generating growth engine for CHG, and for elevating CHG's position with the largest health systems in the country from a transactional locums vendor to a strategic, trusted workforce partner. The Vice President sets the vision, strategy, and financial goals for the Advisory Services practice; leads and develops the Advisory Services team, is responsible for direct and indirect revenue growth attributed to the Advisory Services team; and personally builds and maintains C-suite relationships with Client Advisory Board members and other top health system executives, positioning CHG as a leading voice on the future of the physician and APP workforce.


This role requires a deep understanding of healthcare market dynamics, physician workforce strategy, workforce management solutions, industry best practices and standards, and the competitive advisory/consulting landscape. The Vice President works closely with Marketing, Product, Finance, Sales, and Enterprise Client Solutions leadership to align the Advisory Services offering and the Client Advisory Board with CHG's overall business objectives. This is a key executive leadership role within Enterprise Client Solutions and reports to the SVP, ECS.


Position Scope

  • Executive sponsorship of an eight-member Client Advisory Board comprising C-suite leaders from the nation's leading health systems, spanning a multi-year (18+ month) engagement arc of onsite, virtual, and digital touchpoints.
  • Accountability for an Advisory Services book of business and pipeline representing well in excess of $300M in identified opportunity spend across current and prospective enterprise health system relationships.
  • Growth and expansion of existing CHG and Advisory Services relationships in existing ECS clients, new customers and new markets. Determined by contract, team and revenue growth.
  • Identification of new products, services and market opportunities tied directly to innovation and growth.
  • Direct leadership of the Advisory Services practice, including people leaders and individual-contributor consultants; indirect influence over ECS account teams engaged in advisory-related client work.
  • Enterprise-level visibility, with regular reporting to CHG's executive leadership team (SVP, ECS and above) on advisory revenue, Client Advisory Board program health, and market intelligence.

Responsibilities

Strategic & Financial Leadership

Team Leadership & Talent Development

Develops leaders who can independently lead client engagements, build executive relationships, and grow the Advisory Services business while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Governance

  • Serves as the executive voice for Advisory Services across CHG, influencing enterprise priorities through market intelligence, executive client insights, and emerging healthcare workforce trends.

Supervisory Responsibility: Provides executive leadership for the Advisory Services practice through the Sr. Director of Advisory Services and consulting leadership team, ensuring strong organizational performance, leadership development, succession planning, consulting excellence, and business growth across the practice. Partners in a matrixed capacity with ECS Account Management, Marketing, Product, and Finance leaders to advance enterprise objectives and deliver exceptional client outcomes.

Position Overview:

Woolpert is hiring a CAD Technician to join our dynamic Survey & Geomatics team. The Survey CAD Technician will work collectively with the Survey Team Leader, Phase Manager, and cross-functional internal departments. This individual will create, collect, analyze and validate enterprise asset data and associated land data within the CAD, enterprise geographic information system (GIS), or other asset information storage databases. Our Survey CAD Technician is responsible for reduction of field data, land record research, preparation of boundary surveys, and topographic maps to meet internal and external customer requirements. Our Survey CAD Technician will have a proven ability to work with and directly interact with cross-functional internal contacts to execute the required work, interact with the client staff in a professional and proactive manner to resolve issues, track progress, perform QA work associated with the requirements, make necessary corrections, and continually manage schedule and ensure quality.

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already possess work authorization in the country the job is located.

  • Process daily field data in Trimble Business Center, including but not limited to GPS Static files, RTK Conventional files, and Conventional Total Station files.
  • Convert data between standard spatial data formats including but not limited to AutoCAD, Esri geodatabase feature classes, and ESRI shapefiles.
  • Prepares highway right-of-way map deliverables.
  • Prepares ALTA boundary survey plat deliverables.
  • Prepares topographical surfaces from field data and corresponding map deliverables.
  • Prepares subdivision plats as needed, including replats.
  • Research and interpret government files, utilities, and public record documentation.
  • Produce accurate and legible maps, survey reports and legal descriptions, or displays for various departments.
  • Verify map feature and attribute accuracies.
  • Identify and recommend process improvements and enhancements on existing projects.

What You Will Bring:

  • Demonstrated knowledge of AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and Trimble Business Center
  • Able to review, process and close traverse data, control networks
  • Experience using MicroStation with GeoPak and/or OpenRoads
  • GIS related experience a plus
  • Licensed Surveyor in Training (L.S.I.T) Certificate is a plus
  • Knowledge of reading highway plans, plats and deeds
  • Able to graphically present information clearly and concisely
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
  • Ability to provide excellent customer service
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a dynamic environment
  • Strong organizational, time management, attention to detail and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment; offer constructive feedback and direction to support goal

raw.title: Innovation Engineer — VDI
raw.excerpt: OverviewMacStadium is the leading managed Mac hosting solution in the world and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
raw.description:
Overview

MacStadium is the leading managed Mac hosting solution in the world and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA. We offer the only enterprise-class hosting solution for Apple Mac computers, providing critical infrastructure for iOS and macOS developers at leading tech companies, big enterprises, and more. MacStadium is part of an ecosystem where apps and programs are built that are changing the way people live. It’s likely that numerous apps on your iPhone were built or tested in MacStadium’s data centers.

What we need:

The Innovation team builds the next generation of those solutions, and we are hiring an Innovation Engineer to work with our Innovation Lead on taking our macOS VDI solution to market.

The role is split about 50/50 between development and implementation and support of the product. You will build features, stand the solution up for customers, support it once it is running, and bring what you learn back into the code. If you have worked at a startup or small company where the person who wrote the feature also manages it, then you understand the environment you’ll be in.

What you will be building:

MacStadium VDI gets macOS to a distributed team quickly and securely, without the complex project work that IT and Security normally have to manage. It is in use with early stage customers now and we are taking it to GA.

The solution has a few layers, and you will work across all of them:

  • Virtualization. Virtual machines running macOS across a fleet.
  • Connectivity. Streaming technology that gets a user from wherever they are to a macOS desktop, hosted with us, their provider, or on their own hardware.
  • Management. A web console where IT builds images, creates desktops, and manages access
  • macOS. Native components and automation on the desktop itself, running on Apple silicon.
  • Identity. SSO integration with the identity providers enterprises already use.

Beyond VDI, the Innovation team is building additional emerging AI-related products that leverage Mac to deliver agents, inference, and other capabilities to customers. As VDI goes GA, your work extends into those.

What will you do:

Your time is split about evenly between building the product and getting it into customers’ hands. The two halves feed each other. Needs in a customer environment are usually the next thing you address in the product.

Development

  • Build and ship features across the stack: the streaming and connectivity layer, the web console, and native components on macOS.
  • Expand the identity and access work that expanded use cases demand.
  • Extend what is already there (reliability, updates, logging, and the monitoring a small team needs to support customers at scale).
  • Use Claude, Codex, or other AI tools for agentic development as a normal part of writing, testing, reviewing, and documenting code.
  • Automate and improve (builds, test environments, customer provisioning, diagnostics).

Implementation and support

  • Stand up early GA customers, hosted with us or in their own environment, and get them working.
  • Own the technical side of customer check-ins. Reproduce what they report, find the root cause, fix it or improve it, and close the loop with them and product.
  • Troubleshoot the full path, from the customer’s network and identity provider through to macOS on Apple silicon and the console in between.
  • Write and maintain the documentation that lets customers and the rest of MacStadium succeed without you on the call: setup guides, run books, known issues, and release notes.
  • Bring what you learn in the field back to Product and the Innovation Lead. You will have input into what gets built next.

What we're looking for:

  • 2 to 4 years of professional software engineering experience, with some of it at a product team, small company, or start up where you built, shipped, and then supported what you built.
  • Full stack, with a focus on streaming technology, modern web development, and Apple technology.
  • Strong root cause troubleshooting. You keep going past the symptom, across layers, until you can find and explain the core issue.
  • Fluency with Claude, Codex, or other AI tools for agentic development, and a habit of automating repetitive work.
  • Strong written and spoken English. You will write customer-facing documentation and explain technical problems to people who are not engineers.
  • Strong documentation and problem solving skills.

Who you are:

Assertive. You say what you think the problem is and what you would do about it, and you proactively ask for what you need.
Curious. You want to understand how the whole solution works, not just your piece of it.
Flexible. Some days you are deep in code and some days you are on a customer call, and both are the job.
An owner. You build it, you run it, and you improve it.
Good in a small, fast team. Direct feedback, early communication when something is slipping, and not much process needed to do good work.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with VDI, remote desktop, or streaming products.
  • Identity provider integrations (Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace, or similar).
  • MDM or server management tool experience.
  • Experience with virtualization tools and technology.
  • Development of early stage products.
  • Building tools on top of LLMs or agent frameworks.

Salary Range: $100,000-$115,000

MacStadium has a defined Information Security Policy and all employees are required to adhere to this policy and sign an acknowledgment and receipt of this policy upon hire.

Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. Since we launched Mercury in 2019, our customer base has grown to over 450,000 startups and small businesses from all around the world. With growth comes the need to ensure our customer experience is top of mind even in the most challenging scenarios.

We’re working to build something like magic for a really wide range of startup businesses. A key piece of the magic we’ve built thus far has been smart, product-driven support, and we’re looking to bring on an operational-focused, thoughtful Support Manager to help us continuously improve our Customer Support experience as we scale quickly.

You’ll join as a manager on our Customer Support team, partnering closely with our existing Customer Support Leadership team to execute the operational function of the team and support the wider strategic vision. You’ll manage your own cohort of specialists who are dedicated to managing customer interactions and operational tasks across key customer workstreams. You’ll work closely with our Voice of the Customer, Customer Trust, Operations, WFM and CX Eng teams to improve our product and general customer-facing processes to provide clear, thoughtful, and accurate support systems to help customers.

You’ll need to understand how our products and internal teams work in detail. Banking* has a lot of moving pieces, so this is harder than it might seem. Finding efficient, elegant solutions for problems stemming from the oft-convoluted U.S. financial system isn’t always easy, but if you’re good at your job, our users will never know it.

Your Role:

  • Lead & Develop: Hire, mentor, and manage a customer support team that excels in product knowledge, user support, and the US banking* system
  • Performance Management & Development: Own team performance management by setting clear goals, tracking key metrics, and driving continuous improvement across your team. Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth within your team, providing regular feedback and coaching
  • Process Improvements, AI & Automation: Refine and evolve our support processes, building workflows that drive efficiency and effectiveness across the organization including AI tools and automation to make Support faster and more effective. Take ideas from pilot to production while keeping every workflow within our compliance, privacy, and regulatory standards
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with compliance, engineering, product, and banking partners to resolve complex issues, improve our product based on Customer Support interactions, and implement changes that make for a better customer experience
  • Customer Advocacy: Champion our customers by advocating for their needs with data-driven insights and compelling narratives
  • Hands-On Leadership: Be ready to dive into tickets alongside your team during peak times or critical issues, be a sounding board for escalations, and help wherever the team needs as a leader on the front lines

What we’re looking for:

  • 3+ years of experience leading customer support or other user-facing teams, preferably in high-growth technology companies
  • A collaborative leadership style and comfort sharing ownership of a function with a peer manager
  • Expertise in adding structure for support teams growing quickly
  • Enjoyment in teaching and mentoring others on how to become really skilled at support
  • Previous experience partnering cross-functionally with engineering, product, risk, and compliance teams
  • Comfort navigating data visualization tools (Omni, Metabase, etc.)
  • Experience managing complex operational projects that affect multiple teams
  • Consistent empathy while helping entrepreneurs build successful businesses
  • The ability to break down hard problems into clear, understandable pieces, and to use data to drive decisions (even when the data is not perfect)
  • A penchant for questioning the first answer, and enjoyment in going levels deeper to find all the edge cases
  • Rigor when designing new processes, and a high bar for the quality of your work
  • Creativity while working within difficult constraints

The ideal candidate may also have:

  • Experience managing or partnering with a BPO or outsourced support vendor, including quality programs, SLAs, and vendor performance management
  • Experience building or scaling proactive support, VIP, or high-touch/managed support programs (a plus)

*While we've received approvals from the OCC and FDIC, Mercury today is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Job Description: Clinical, Microbiome & Translational Research Scientist (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote (Worldwide)

About the Role

We are seeking PhD-level experts in clinical research, microbiome science, and translational bioinformatics to contribute their scientific expertise to the development and evaluation of next-generation AI systems.

In this role, you will create advanced scientific problems, evaluate AI-generated responses, and assess the accuracy, rigor, and depth of scientific reasoning. Your contributions will help ensure that AI systems deliver reliable, evidence-based insights across microbiome research, clinical bioinformatics, and translational life sciences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop challenging, expert-level scientific problems in microbiome research, metagenomics, clinical bioinformatics, and related life sciences, with clear and verifiable solutions.
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated outputs for scientific accuracy, methodological rigor, and depth of reasoning.
  • Identify subtle scientific errors, unsupported conclusions, and methodological limitations.
  • Develop detailed evaluation rubrics and reference answers grounded in primary literature and established research methodologies.
  • Apply domain expertise in areas such as 16S and shotgun metagenomics, virome and host-microbiome analysis, biomarker discovery, clinical genomics, and omics-driven precision medicine.
  • Provide clear, detailed written explanations of scientific reasoning to support expert review and validation.
  • Maintain high-quality standards through iterative feedback, revisions, and peer review.

Required Qualifications

  • PhD in Microbiology, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Biomedical Sciences, Immunology, Epidemiology, or a closely related field.
  • Hands-on research experience in an academic or industry laboratory. Wet lab experience is an advantage.
  • Professional written and spoken English proficiency (C1 level or higher).

Preferred Skills and Qualifications

  • Postdoctoral or industry research experience in microbiome, clinical, or translational research.
  • Peer-reviewed publications, preferably as a first author in relevant scientific journals.
  • Experience with microbiome analysis tools such as QIIME2, Kraken2, MetaPhlAn, HUMAnN, MAG assembly and binning, or virome analysis tools.
  • Clinical and translational research experience involving TCGA, UK Biobank, biomarker discovery, survival analysis, electronic health record (EHR) and omics integration, or oncology and immunology genomics.
  • Strong knowledge of statistics and machine learning methods for high-dimensional biological data.
  • Programming proficiency in Python and/or R, with familiarity with Bash and workflow management tools.
  • Experience reviewing, benchmarking, or developing scientific content.
